source_translations.CPU 产生了内核无法处理的陷阱（参数 1 为陷阱号，0x8 表示双重错误）。: The CPU raised a trap the kernel could not handle (parameter 1 is the trap number; 0x8 means double fault).
source_translations.CRT 检测到无效参数并主动终止进程。: The CRT detected an invalid parameter and terminated the process.
source_translations.DPC 例程中发生了非法的线程切换（等待/挂起）。: An illegal thread switch (wait/suspend) occurred inside a DPC routine.
source_translations.DPC 或高 IRQL 代码执行超时（参数 1 为 0 表示单个 DPC 超时）: DPC or high-IRQL code ran too long (parameter 1 = 0 means a single DPC timed out).
source_translations.NTFS 文件系统驱动内部错误，可能与磁盘损坏或过滤驱动有关。: Internal error in the NTFS file system driver; possibly disk corruption or a filter driver.
source_translations.PatchGuard 检测到内核关键结构被修改（内核补丁保护）。: PatchGuard detected modification of critical kernel structures (Kernel Patch Protection).
source_translations.R0 IRP 目录枚举通信失败：Win32=%1；%2: R0 IRP directory enumeration I/O failed: Win32=%1; %2
source_translations.R0 IRP 解析%1；目标层=%2；接收驱动=%3；文件系统=%4；条目=%5: R0 IRP parsing %1; target layer=%2; receiving driver=%3; file system=%4; entries=%5
source_translations.R0 IRP 解析（内核自建 IRP 直发基础文件系统设备，绕过过滤层）。\n: R0 IRP parsing (kernel-built IRP sent directly to the base file system device, bypassing filter layers).
source_translations.R0 无法用自建 IRP 枚举目录：queryStatus=%1；create=: R0 could not enumerate the directory with a self-built IRP: queryStatus=%1; create=%2; last=%3.
source_translations.R0 驱动目录解析，强制按 NTFS/FAT32/exFAT 解析，\n: R0 driver directory parsing, forced NTFS/FAT32/exFAT interpretation,
source_translations.TRIAGE_DUMP64 稳定前缀必须是 0x78 字节: TRIAGE_DUMP64 stable prefix must be 0x78 bytes
source_translations.USB 驱动栈内部错误。: Internal error in the USB driver stack.
source_translations.USB3 驱动栈内部错误。: Internal error in the USB3 driver stack.
source_translations.WFP（Windows 过滤平台）非法操作。: Invalid operation in WFP (Windows Filtering Platform).
source_translations.[FileDock] 纯MFT解析发现目录枚举不可见的条目, path=: [FileDock] MFT-only parsing found entries invisible to directory enumeration, path=
source_translations.作为MFT解析（仅 NTFS：卷偏移直读 $MFT，禁用一切 WinAPI/FS: Parse as MFT (NTFS only: read $MFT directly at volume offsets, all WinAPI/FSCTL fallbacks disabled),
source_translations.使用了无效的内核对象句柄。: An invalid kernel object handle was used.
source_translations.关键系统进程（如 csrss/wininit/svchost）异常退出，参数 1: A critical system process (e.g. csrss/wininit/svchost) exited unexpectedly; parameter 1 is the process object.
source_translations.内存不足：无法分配所需的虚拟内存或页面文件配额。: Out of memory: the required virtual memory or pagefile quota could not be allocated.
source_translations.内存区域过多，仅展示前 %1 / %2 条。: Too many memory regions; only the first %1 of %2 are shown.
source_translations.内存压缩存储组件发生意外异常，常与磁盘/存储驱动相关。: The memory compression store hit an unexpected exception; often disk/storage driver related.
source_translations.内存管理器内部一致性错误，可能由驱动破坏或物理内存故障引起。: Memory manager internal consistency error; possibly caused by a driver or faulty RAM.
source_translations.内核 fail-fast：安全检查（列表损坏/栈 cookie/越界）失败，参数: Kernel fail-fast: a security check (list corruption/stack cookie/out-of-bounds) failed; parameter 1 is the subtype.
source_translations.内核堆管理器检测到堆损坏。: The kernel heap manager detected heap corruption.
source_translations.内核数据页无法从页面文件/磁盘读入，常见于磁盘或存储驱动故障。: A kernel data page could not be read from the pagefile/disk; usually a disk or storage driver fault.
source_translations.内核模式异常未被处理（参数 1 为异常码）。: A kernel-mode exception was not handled (parameter 1 is the exception code).
source_translations.单步陷阱：TF 标志置位后执行了一条指令。: Single-step trap: one instruction executed with the TF flag set.
source_translations.参数 1：0 表示单个 DPC 超时，1 表示系统累计处于 DISPATCH_L: Parameter 1: 0 means a single DPC timed out; 1 means cumulative DISPATCH_LEVEL time exceeded
source_translations.参数 1：引发问题的异常码（NTSTATUS）\n: Parameter 1: the exception code that caused the problem (NTSTATUS)
source_translations.参数 1：损坏类型（3 表示 LIST_ENTRY 损坏，2 表示栈 cooki: Parameter 1: corruption type (3 means LIST_ENTRY corruption, 2 means stack cookie corruption)
source_translations.参数 1：池违规类型（如 0x7 表示重复释放）\n: Parameter 1: pool violation type (e.g. 0x7 means double free)
source_translations.参数 1：被访问的内存地址\n: Parameter 1: the memory address that was referenced
source_translations.参数 1：负责恢复的内部上下文（TDR 恢复上下文）地址\n: Parameter 1: address of the internal recovery context (TDR recovery context)
source_translations.参数 1：退出的关键进程对象（EPROCESS）地址\n: Parameter 1: address of the critical process object (EPROCESS) that exited
source_translations.参数 1：错误源类型（0 表示机器检查异常 MCE）\n: Parameter 1: error source type (0 means Machine Check Exception)
source_translations.参数 1：陷阱号（0x0 除零，0x8 双重错误，0xD 一般保护错误）\n: Parameter 1: trap number (0x0 divide-by-zero, 0x8 double fault, 0xD general protection fault)
source_translations.参数 2-4：与违规类型相关（通常含池块地址与内容）: Parameters 2-4: depend on the violation type (usually pool block address and contents)
source_translations.参数 2-4：与陷阱类型相关: Parameters 2-4: depend on the trap type
source_translations.参数 2：0 表示进程退出，1 表示线程退出\n: Parameter 2: 0 means process exit, 1 means thread exit
source_translations.参数 2：WHEA_ERROR_RECORD 结构地址\n: Parameter 2: address of the WHEA_ERROR_RECORD structure
source_translations.参数 2：出错显示驱动的入口地址\n: Parameter 2: entry address inside the failing display driver
source_translations.参数 2：异常发生的指令地址\n: Parameter 2: instruction address where the exception occurred
source_translations.参数 2：引发异常的指令地址\n: Parameter 2: instruction address that raised the exception
source_translations.参数 2：访问时的 IRQL\n: Parameter 2: IRQL at the time of access
source_translations.参数 3-4：错误记录的高低位摘要: Parameters 3-4: high/low digest of the error record
source_translations.参数 3：0 表示读取，1 表示写入，8 表示执行\n: Parameter 3: 0 means read, 1 means write, 8 means execute
source_translations.参数 3：异常记录地址（0x7E）或参数 0（0x1E）\n: Parameter 3: exception record address (0x7E) or parameter 0 (0x1E)
source_translations.参数 3：引发错误的指令地址\n: Parameter 3: instruction address that caused the fault
source_translations.参数 3：错误码高位\n: Parameter 3: high part of the error code
source_translations.参数 4：上下文记录地址（0x7E）或参数 1（0x1E）: Parameter 4: context record address (0x7E) or parameter 1 (0x1E)
source_translations.参数 4：访问该内存的指令地址: Parameter 4: instruction address that referenced the memory
source_translations.后两种会与常规视图对照，把只有绕过路径可见的条目标为疑似隐藏项。: The latter two are compared against the regular view; entries visible only via bypass paths are flagged as suspected hidden items.
source_translations.向系统服务传入了无效参数。: An invalid parameter was passed to a system service.
source_translations.在后台解析转储结构，不会修改目标文件: Parse the dump structure in the background; the target file is never modified
source_translations.堆损坏：堆管理器检测到堆结构被破坏（常见于越界写/双重释放）。: Heap corruption: the heap manager detected damaged heap structures (typically out-of-bounds writes or double free).
source_translations.定位到系统蓝屏转储目录（C:\\Windows\\Minidump）: Browse the system BSOD dump directory (C:\Windows\Minidump)
source_translations.对不可继续的异常执行了继续操作。: Execution continued after a noncontinuable exception.
source_translations.已识别转储格式，但内容损坏或截断：%1: Recognized dump format, but the content is corrupted or truncated: %1
source_translations.异常处理器返回了无效的处置值。: An exception handler returned an invalid disposition.
source_translations.当前 KswordARK 驱动不支持 R0 IRP 目录枚举，请重新部署本次构建: The current KswordARK driver does not support R0 IRP directory enumeration; redeploy the driver from this build.
source_translations.找不到需要加载的 DLL。: A required DLL could not be found.
source_translations.把当前解析结果的全文报告保存为文本文件: Save the full text report of the current result to a file
source_translations.按名称导入的函数在目标 DLL 中不存在。: A function imported by name does not exist in the target DLL.
source_translations.按序号导入的函数在目标 DLL 中不存在。: A function imported by ordinal does not exist in the target DLL.
source_translations.换页错误：访问的页面无法从后备存储（文件/页面文件）读入。: In-page error: the referenced page could not be read from backing storage (file/pagefile).
source_translations.数据区越界（文件截断）: Data area out of bounds (file truncated)
source_translations.数组越界（BOUND 指令检查失败）。: Array bounds exceeded (BOUND instruction check failed).
source_translations.整数运算溢出（INTO 指令触发）。: Integer overflow (raised by the INTO instruction).
source_translations.文件系统过滤管理器（FltMgr）检测到不可恢复错误。: The file system filter manager (FltMgr) hit an unrecoverable error.
source_translations.断点指令（int 3）被执行，且没有调试器接管。: A breakpoint instruction (int 3) executed with no debugger attached.
source_translations.无法打开文件（可能被占用或权限不足）：%1: Cannot open the file (it may be in use or access is denied): %1
source_translations.无法识别的文件签名 %1：既不是 MDMP 用户态转储，也不是 PAGEDUMP: Unrecognized file signature %1: neither an MDMP user-mode dump nor a PAGEDUMP/PAGEDU64 kernel dump.
source_translations.显卡驱动超时且恢复（TDR）失败，参数 1 为出错的显示驱动上下文。: The display driver timed out and recovery (TDR) failed; parameter 1 is the failing display driver context.
source_translations.栈缓冲区被破坏或 fail-fast：GS 安全检查、__fastfail 等主: Stack buffer overrun or fail-fast: GS security check, __fastfail or similar deliberate termination.
source_translations.模块数 %1 超过解析上限，仅展示前 %2 条。: Module count %1 exceeds the parsing limit; only the first %2 are shown.
source_translations.流 %1 的数据区越界，相关内容可能缺失。: Data area of stream %1 is out of bounds; related content may be missing.
source_translations.浮点结果无法精确表示。: The floating-point result cannot be represented exactly.
source_translations.特权指令：在用户态执行了需要内核权限的指令。: Privileged instruction: a kernel-only instruction executed in user mode.
source_translations.特殊池检测到驱动越界/释放后使用。: Special pool detected a driver out-of-bounds access or use after free.
source_translations.用户手动触发的崩溃（CrashOnCtrlScroll 或调试工具）。: A crash triggered manually (CrashOnCtrlScroll or a debugging tool).
source_translations.目录路径为空，无法执行 R0 IRP 解析。: The directory path is empty; R0 IRP parsing cannot run.
source_translations.硬件报告了不可纠正错误（WHEA），常见于 CPU/内存/总线故障，参数 2 为: Hardware reported an uncorrectable error (WHEA); usually CPU/RAM/bus faults; parameter 2 is the error record address.
source_translations.系统发生致命异常复位。: The system hit a fatal abnormal reset.
source_translations.系统服务例程中发生异常（参数 1 为异常码，参数 2 为出错指令地址）。: An exception occurred in a system service routine (parameter 1 is the exception code, parameter 2 the faulting instruction address).
source_translations.系统线程抛出未处理异常（参数 1 为异常码，参数 2 为地址）。: A system thread raised an unhandled exception (parameter 1 is the exception code, parameter 2 the address).
source_translations.纯 MFT 解析；条目=%1；未取得目录枚举对照: MFT-only parsing; entries=%1; no directory enumeration baseline obtained
source_translations.纯 MFT 解析；条目=%1；目录枚举视图=%2；仅 MFT 可见=%3: MFT-only parsing; entries=%1; directory enumeration view=%2; MFT-only visible=%3
source_translations.纯MFT解析仅适用于 NTFS 卷，当前卷类型为 %1。: MFT-only parsing works only on NTFS volumes; the current volume type is %1.
source_translations.纯MFT解析未能在 $MFT 中定位该目录（扫描窗口不足或目录记录已损坏）。: MFT-only parsing could not locate the directory in $MFT (scan window too small or the directory record is corrupted).
source_translations.线程名条目必须是 pack(4) 的 12 字节: Thread name entry must be 12 bytes with pack(4)
source_translations.线程数 %1 超过解析上限，仅展示前 %2 条。: Thread count %1 exceeds the parsing limit; only the first %2 are shown.
source_translations.线程栈溢出：通常由无限递归或超大栈上分配导致。: Thread stack overflow: usually caused by unbounded recursion or huge stack allocations.
source_translations.线程释放了不属于它的 ERESOURCE。: A thread released an ERESOURCE it did not own.
source_translations.虚拟化环境看门狗超时。: Watchdog timeout in a virtualized environment.
source_translations.访问了非法系统内存地址（参数 1 为地址），常见于驱动缺陷或内存故障。: An invalid system memory address was referenced (parameter 1 is the address); usually a driver defect or faulty RAM.
source_translations.访问违例：读写了无权访问的虚拟地址，是最常见的崩溃原因。: Access violation: a virtual address was read or written without permission; the most common crash cause.
source_translations.试图执行不可执行内存（DEP 违规，参数 1 为地址）。: Attempted to execute non-executable memory (DEP violation; parameter 1 is the address).
source_translations.请选择一个存在的转储文件。: Please choose an existing dump file.
source_translations.选择一个转储文件开始解析：支持应用崩溃 MDMP 与系统蓝屏 DMP。: Choose a dump file to start: application-crash MDMP and system BSOD DMP files are supported.
source_translations.选择一个转储文件进行只读解析: Choose a dump file for read-only parsing
source_translations.选择要解析的转储文件（应用崩溃 .dmp / 蓝屏 Minidump / MEM: Choose a dump file to parse (application crash .dmp / BSOD Minidump / MEMORY.DMP)
source_translations.长按电源键触发的手动崩溃转储。: Manual crash dump triggered by holding the power button.
source_translations.非法指令：CPU 无法译码执行当前指令。: Illegal instruction: the CPU could not decode or execute the instruction.
source_translations.非法的池操作（重复释放、释放无效地址等），参数 1 为违规类型。: Invalid pool operation (double free, freeing an invalid address, etc.); parameter 1 is the violation type.
source_translations.驱动卸载时没有取消挂起的操作（定时器/DPC/工作项等）。: A driver unloaded without cancelling pending operations (timers/DPCs/work items).
source_translations.驱动向只读内存页写入（参数 1 为目标地址）。: A driver wrote to a read-only memory page (parameter 1 is the target address).
source_translations.驱动在 DISPATCH_LEVEL 及以上访问了分页/无效内存（参数 4 为出: A driver accessed pageable/invalid memory at DISPATCH_LEVEL or above (parameter 4 is the faulting instruction address).
source_translations.驱动在电源状态切换（睡眠/唤醒/关机）时超时或行为异常。: A driver timed out or misbehaved during a power state transition (sleep/wake/shutdown).
source_translations.驱动持有取消锁返回。: A driver returned while holding the cancel lock.
source_translations.驱动数 %1 超过解析上限，仅展示前 %2 条。: Driver count %1 exceeds the parsing limit; only the first %2 are shown.
source_translations.驱动破坏了内核池结构，高 IRQL 访问了无效池内存。: A driver corrupted kernel pool structures or touched invalid pool memory at high IRQL.
source_translations.驱动访问了已释放的特殊池内存（释放后使用）。: A driver referenced freed special pool memory (use after free).
source_translations.驱动越过分配末尾访问内存（越界读写）。: A driver accessed memory beyond the end of its allocation (out-of-bounds access).
source_translations.驱动验证器捕获到 DMA 违规。: Driver Verifier caught a DMA violation.
source_translations.驱动验证器捕获到驱动违规（参数 1 为违规子类型）。: Driver Verifier caught a driver violation (parameter 1 is the violation subtype).
source_translations.高 IRQL 下访问了分页内存或无效地址，多为驱动缺陷。: Pageable or invalid memory was accessed at high IRQL; usually a driver defect.
source_translations.；已回退到栈顶，本次未绕过过滤层: ; fell back to the stack top, filter layers were not bypassed this time
source_translations.；栈顶不可见条目=%1: ; entries invisible at the stack top=%1
source_translations.线程列表：每个线程的 ID、TEB、栈范围与上下文位置: Thread list: each thread's ID, TEB, stack range and context location
source_translations.模块列表：加载模块的基址、大小、版本与 PDB 信息: Module list: base, size, version and PDB info of loaded modules
source_translations.内存列表：转储中包含的内存范围（小型转储）: Memory list: memory ranges captured in the dump (minidump)
source_translations.异常信息：崩溃线程 ID、异常码、地址与参数: Exception: faulting thread ID, exception code, address and parameters
source_translations.系统信息：CPU 架构、逻辑处理器数与操作系统版本: System info: CPU architecture, logical processor count and OS version
source_translations.扩展线程列表：带背景通道信息的线程数组: Extended thread list: thread array with backing-store info
source_translations.64 位内存列表：完整内存转储的数据范围目录: Memory64 list: data range directory of a full memory dump
source_translations.ANSI 注释：写转储时附加的说明文字: ANSI comment: note attached when the dump was written
source_translations.Unicode 注释：写转储时附加的说明文字: Unicode comment: note attached when the dump was written
source_translations.句柄数据：崩溃时打开的内核对象句柄: Handle data: kernel object handles open at crash time
source_translations.函数表：动态函数表（RtlAddFunctionTable）信息: Function table: dynamic function table (RtlAddFunctionTable) info
source_translations.已卸载模块列表：进程生命周期内卸载过的模块: Unloaded module list: modules unloaded during the process lifetime
source_translations.杂项信息：进程 ID、启动时间、CPU 时间与频率: Misc info: process ID, start time, CPU time and frequency
source_translations.内存信息列表：所有虚拟内存区域的状态/保护/类型: Memory info list: state/protection/type of all virtual memory regions
source_translations.线程信息列表：线程起始地址、CPU 时间与调度信息: Thread info list: thread start address, CPU time and scheduling info
source_translations.句柄操作列表：句柄跟踪（htrace）记录: Handle operation list: handle trace (htrace) records
source_translations.系统内存信息：系统级内存性能计数: System memory info: system-wide memory performance counters
source_translations.进程 VM 计数：进程虚拟内存统计: Process VM counters: process virtual memory statistics
source_translations.线程名列表：线程 ID 与线程描述名: Thread name list: thread IDs and description names
source_translations.崩溃处理器的 CONTEXT 副本: CONTEXT copy of the crashing processor
source_translations.崩溃处理器 KPRCB 副本: KPRCB copy of the crashing processor
source_translations.崩溃时当前 EPROCESS 副本: Current EPROCESS copy at crash time
source_translations.崩溃时当前 ETHREAD 副本: Current ETHREAD copy at crash time
source_translations.崩溃线程内核栈原始字节: Raw kernel stack bytes of the faulting thread
source_translations.附加抓取的内存块目录: Directory of additionally captured memory blocks
source_translations.文件不存在或不是普通文件。: The file does not exist or is not a regular file.
source_translations.文件过小，不可能是有效转储。: The file is too small to be a valid dump.
source_translations.文件映射失败（文件过大或系统资源不足）。: File mapping failed (file too large or insufficient system resources).
source_translations.文件过小，无法读取 MDMP 头。: The file is too small to read the MDMP header.
source_translations.流目录越界，转储文件已截断或损坏。: Stream directory out of bounds; the dump file is truncated or corrupted.
source_translations.PAGEDU64 头读取失败。: Failed to read the PAGEDU64 header.
source_translations.文件小于 0x2000 字节，PAGEDU64 头不完整。: The file is smaller than 0x2000 bytes; the PAGEDU64 header is incomplete.
source_translations.文件小于 0x1000 字节，PAGEDUMP 头不完整。: The file is smaller than 0x1000 bytes; the PAGEDUMP header is incomplete.
source_translations.系统信息流长度不足，已跳过。: System info stream too short; skipped.
source_translations.杂项信息流长度不足，已跳过。: Misc info stream too short; skipped.
source_translations.线程列表流头部读取失败。: Failed to read the thread list stream header.
source_translations.模块列表流头部读取失败。: Failed to read the module list stream header.
source_translations.线程条目越界，列表提前结束。: Thread entry out of bounds; the list ended early.
source_translations.模块条目越界，列表提前结束。: Module entry out of bounds; the list ended early.
source_translations.驱动条目越界，列表提前结束。: Driver entry out of bounds; the list ended early.
source_translations.TRIAGE 区读取失败，文件可能被截断。: Failed to read the TRIAGE area; the file may be truncated.
source_translations.32 位内核转储仅解析头部关键信息，不解析 TRIAGE 区。: 32-bit kernel dumps only have their header parsed; the TRIAGE area is skipped.
source_translations.已开启背景透明：Windows 分层窗口不会绘制插件的原生子窗口，Tab 插件可: Background transparency is enabled: Windows layered windows do not paint the plugin's native child window, so Tab plugins may fail to display or render incorrectly. To use them, turn off background transparency in Settings - Appearance and restart.
source_translations.显示调度器内部错误；参数 1 是子类型。: Display scheduler internal error; parameter 1 is the subtype.
source_translations.Visual C++ 线程命名异常：调试器用来设置线程名，不是崩溃。: Visual C++ thread-naming exception: used by the debugger to set a thread name, not a crash.
source_translations.映像格式非法：多为 32/64 位混用或文件损坏。: Invalid image format: usually 32/64-bit mixing or a corrupted file.
source_translations.访问越过了分配的末尾（越界读写），由驱动验证器捕获。: The access ran past the end of the allocation (out-of-bounds read/write), caught by Driver Verifier.
source_translations.页面的引用计数出现非法值。: The page reference count holds an invalid value.
source_translations.参数 1 若是 0xC0000005，按访问违例排查；若是 0x80000003: If parameter 1 is 0xC0000005, investigate it as an access violation; if it is 0x80000003, code reached a breakpoint instruction.
source_translations.错误状态高 32 位（MCi_STATUS）: High 32 bits of the error status (MCi_STATUS)
source_translations.这是主动终止而非被动崩溃：参数 1 的 fast-fail 子码说明了触发的具体: This is a deliberate termination rather than a passive crash: the fast-fail subcode in parameter 1 identifies the specific security check that fired.
source_translations.驱动在电源状态切换（睡眠/唤醒/关机）时超时或状态不一致。: A driver timed out or reported an inconsistent state during a power transition (sleep/resume/shutdown).
source_translations.x64 CONTEXT.MxCsr 偏移必须是 0x34: The x64 CONTEXT.MxCsr offset must be 0x34
source_translations.无响应处理器的 KPRCB 地址: KPRCB address of the unresponsive processor
source_translations.看调用栈里出现的第三方驱动：存储、网络与虚拟化驱动是常见肇事者。: Look at the third-party drivers on the call stack: storage, network and virtualization drivers are the usual culprits.
source_translations.同一个 IRP 被完成了两次：典型的驱动栈协作缺陷。: The same IRP was completed twice: a classic driver-stack cooperation defect.
source_translations.栈缓冲区溢出触发的致命退出。: Fatal exit triggered by a stack buffer overrun.
source_translations.线程的处理器亲和性集合非法。: The thread's processor affinity set is invalid.
source_translations.内核补丁保护（PatchGuard）发现关键结构被修改；参数 4 指明被改的区域: Kernel Patch Protection (PatchGuard) detected modification of a critical structure; parameter 4 identifies the type of region that was changed.
source_translations.对象引用计数非法。: The object reference count is invalid.
source_translations.OutputDebugStringA 产生的调试输出异常，不是崩溃。: Debug output exception raised by OutputDebugStringA, not a crash.
source_translations.未被接住的 C++ 异常：崩溃点是 throw 的位置，: Unhandled C++ exception: the crash point is where the throw occurred,
source_translations.关键进程退出通常是被外力终止或自身初始化失败：先看系统事件日志中同一时刻的应用程: A critical process usually exits because it was killed externally or failed its own initialization: start with the application errors logged at the same time in the system event log.
source_translations.托管调用栈与异常类型需要用 SOS/dotnet-dump 分析同一份转储。: The managed call stack and exception type require analyzing the same dump with SOS/dotnet-dump.
source_translations.MSVC C++ 异常记录（带 pForwardCompat 扩展）: MSVC C++ exception record (with pForwardCompat extension)
source_translations.setjmp/longjmp 的跳转缓冲区被破坏。: The setjmp/longjmp jump buffer was corrupted.
source_translations.如果多份转储的出错地址毫无规律，优先跑 MemTest86 排查物理内存。: If the faulting addresses across several dumps follow no pattern, run MemTest86 first to rule out physical memory.
source_translations.收集多份转储交叉比对，反复出现的模块才是可靠线索。: Collect several dumps and cross-compare them; only a module that keeps reappearing is a reliable lead.
source_translations.与子类型相关（多为物理设备对象）: Depends on the subtype (usually the physical device object)
source_translations.检查是否存在无限递归：崩溃线程的调用栈里会出现同一模块的地址反复出现。: Check for infinite recursion: the faulting thread's call stack shows addresses from the same module repeating over and over.
source_translations.系统配置信息损坏（注册表 SYSTEM 单元有问题）。: System configuration information is corrupted (a problem in the registry SYSTEM hive).
source_translations.LIST_ENTRY 双向链表损坏：插入/删除时前后指针对不上，典型的释放后使用: LIST_ENTRY doubly linked list corruption: the forward and back pointers disagree during an insert or remove - typical of a use-after-free or an out-of-bounds write.
source_translations.全 1 无效值（常见于未设置或已失效的指针/句柄）: All-ones invalid value (common for unset or stale pointers/handles)
source_translations.试图释放的池地址非法。: The pool address being freed is invalid.
source_translations.试图释放的地址不在任何池区间内。: The address being freed does not fall inside any pool range.
source_translations.更新存储控制器驱动；NVMe 固态盘还要检查固件版本。: Update the storage controller driver; for NVMe SSDs also check the firmware version.
source_translations.设备队列状态与预期不符（设备队列本应处于忙状态）。: The device queue state does not match expectations (the device queue should have been busy).
source_translations.该停止码由硬件错误报告机制产生，通常不是某个驱动的代码缺陷，: This stop code comes from the hardware error reporting mechanism and is usually not a code defect in any driver,
source_translations.%1；崩溃点位于系统模块 %2，通常说明真正的触发者在调用链更上游。: %1; the crash point is in system module %2, which usually means the real trigger lies further up the call chain.
source_translations.在错误的 IRQL 上释放分页池。: Paged pool was freed at the wrong IRQL.
source_translations.系统缺少异常处理支持。: The system lacks exception handling support.
source_translations.对内核句柄执行了非法操作（关闭了受保护句柄或使用了无效句柄）。: An invalid operation was performed on a kernel handle (a protected handle was closed, or an invalid handle was used).
source_translations.驱动卸载 / 资源泄漏类检查失败（卸载时仍持有资源或未取消挂起操作）。: Driver unload / resource leak check failed (resources still held or pending operations not cancelled at unload).
source_translations.运行 sfc /scannow 与 DISM /Online /Cleanup-: Run sfc /scannow and DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth to repair system files.
source_translations.这是人为触发的转储，不是系统故障，无需排查稳定性问题。: This dump was triggered manually, not by a system fault; no stability troubleshooting is required.
source_translations.这是驱动验证器主动抓到的违规，说明目标驱动确实违反了规则，可信度很高。: Driver Verifier actively caught this violation, so the target driver really did break a rule - confidence is high.
source_translations.在错误的 IRQL 上释放非分页池。: Non-paged pool freed at the wrong IRQL.
source_translations.检查是否在栈上分配了超大对象或用了过大的 alloca/可变长数组。: Check for oversized objects allocated on the stack, or excessively large alloca / variable-length arrays.
source_translations.栈指针不在合法的栈范围内。: The stack pointer is outside the valid stack range.
source_translations.这是启动阶段的失败：核对最近的驱动/系统更新，必要时用最后一次正确配置或安全模式: This is a boot-phase failure: review recent driver / system updates and, if needed, roll back with Last Known Good Configuration or Safe Mode.
source_translations.驱动在 DISPATCH_LEVEL 及以上访问了分页或无效内存；参数 4 是出: A driver touched paged or invalid memory at DISPATCH_LEVEL or above; parameter 4 is the faulting instruction address and points straight at the offending driver.
source_translations.驱动破坏了文件缓存所在的池区域。: A driver corrupted the pool region holding the file cache.
source_translations.关键系统进程（csrss/wininit/services 等）退出，系统无法继: A critical system process (csrss / wininit / services, etc.) exited and the system cannot keep running.
source_translations.HeapFree 已释放内存（Windows 调试堆填充），典型释放后使用: HeapFree freed memory (Windows debug heap fill pattern) - classic use-after-free
source_translations.线程栈保留大小不足时，可通过链接选项 /STACK 或 CreateThread: If the reserved thread stack is too small, enlarge it with the /STACK linker option or the CreateThread stack-size parameter.
source_translations.驱动验证器捕获到违规；参数 1 是违规子类型，直接指明了违反了哪条规则。: Driver Verifier caught a violation; parameter 1 is the violation subtype and names exactly which rule was broken.
source_translations.显示驱动初始化失败，系统无法进入图形模式。: Display driver initialization failed; the system could not enter graphics mode.
source_translations.驱动卸载时没有取消挂起的定时器/DPC/工作项，卸载后仍被回调。: A driver failed to cancel pending timers / DPCs / work items on unload and was still called back after unloading.
source_translations.内核栈上检测到不可执行内存的执行尝试。: An attempt to execute non-executable memory was detected on the kernel stack.
source_translations.这是加载期失败而非运行期崩溃：核对依赖 DLL 的位数、版本与部署路径。: This is a load-time failure rather than a run-time crash: check the bitness, version and deployment path of the dependent DLLs.
source_translations.ACPI 固件报告了致命错误。: The ACPI firmware reported a fatal error.
source_translations.互斥体获取顺序违反了层级约定（潜在死锁）。: Mutex acquisition order violated the level hierarchy (potential deadlock).
source_translations.设备对象引用计数在删除时仍不为零。: The device object reference count was still non-zero at deletion.
source_translations.转储写入器报告了非零状态（%1），本文件可能不完整，: The dump writer reported a non-zero status (%1), so this file may be incomplete,
source_translations.2 (DISPATCH_LEVEL) —— 此级别及以上禁止访问分页内存，也禁止: 2 (DISPATCH_LEVEL) - at this level and above, paged memory access and waiting are both forbidden
source_translations.这是硬件报告的错误，换驱动通常无效：先取消一切超频（CPU/内存/XMP-EXP: This error is reported by the hardware, so swapping drivers rarely helps: first remove all overclocking (CPU / memory / XMP-EXPO) and restore defaults.
source_translations.机器检查异常（MCE）：CPU 内部、缓存或内存控制器报告的错误。: Machine check exception (MCE): an error reported by the CPU core, cache or memory controller.
source_translations.崩溃线程内核栈原始字节（调用栈重建的数据源）: Raw kernel stack bytes of the crashing thread (source data for call stack reconstruction)
source_translations.请求的操作不受支持。: The requested operation is not supported.
source_translations.内核池块被破坏。: A kernel pool block is corrupted.
source_translations..NET 运行时抛出的托管异常（未被托管代码接住）。: Managed exception raised by the .NET runtime (not caught by managed code).
source_translations.试图执行不可执行的内存（DEP 违规）；参数 1 是目标地址。: Attempt to execute non-executable memory (DEP violation); parameter 1 is the target address.
source_translations.线程环境块（TEB）内容被破坏。: The thread environment block (TEB) contents are corrupted.
source_translations.驱动返回了非法的设备关系。: A driver returned an invalid device relation.
source_translations.转储自报的肇事驱动记录: Faulting driver record self-reported by the dump
source_translations.已修改的关键内核数据结构指针。: Modified pointer to a critical kernel data structure.
source_translations.重复释放同一个池块（double free），或释放了已被改写的池头。: The same pool block was freed twice (double free), or a pool header that had already been overwritten was freed.
source_translations.未收录的内存管理子码；该停止码整体指向内存管理结构不一致。: Uncatalogued memory manager subcode; the stop code as a whole points to inconsistent memory manager structures.
source_translations.已释放的堆内存（MSVC 调试堆释放填充），典型释放后使用: Freed heap memory (MSVC debug heap free fill) - a classic use-after-free
source_translations.驱动占用了过多系统页表项。: A driver consumed too many system PTEs.
source_translations.DPC 或高 IRQL 代码执行超时；参数 1 为 0 表示单个 DPC 超时，: A DPC or high-IRQL code path ran too long; parameter 1 = 0 means a single DPC timed out, 1 means the system stayed at high IRQL for an extended period.
source_translations.工作集链表损坏。: The working set list is corrupted.
source_translations.内核栈页面无法从页面文件读入：磁盘或存储驱动故障。: A kernel stack page could not be read back from the page file: disk or storage driver failure.
source_translations.子码为 CFG/间接调用检查失败时，查函数指针是否被覆盖或指向非法目标。: When the subcode is a CFG / indirect call check failure, verify whether the function pointer was overwritten or points to an invalid target.
source_translations.取消内存超频与 XMP/EXPO 配置，恢复 JEDEC 默认频率再观察。: Disable memory overclocking and XMP/EXPO profiles, revert to JEDEC default frequencies, then re-test.
source_translations.特殊池 / 池跟踪类检查失败（越界、释放后使用、池标记不符）。: Special pool / pool tracking check failed (overrun, use-after-free, pool tag mismatch).
source_translations.崩溃指令地址 %1（未落在任何已知模块区间内，可能是已释放的代码页或动态生成的代: Faulting instruction address %1 (outside every known module range - possibly a freed code page or dynamically generated code).
source_translations.1 —— 写入过程中出现错误，内容可能不完整: 1 - an error occurred while writing; the contents may be incomplete
source_translations.电源状态变更超时（设备栈长时间无响应）。: Power state transition timed out (the device stack stopped responding).
source_translations.转储自报的肇事驱动: Culprit driver reported by the dump itself
source_translations.访问地址落在 NULL 页时，检查该指针的来源函数是否漏判返回值失败。: When the accessed address falls in the NULL page, check whether the function that produced the pointer failed to test its return value.
source_translations.设备对象的即插即用状态机被违规驱动打乱。: A misbehaving driver corrupted the Plug and Play state machine of a device object.
source_translations.解析结果仅供参考。: Analysis results are for reference only.
source_translations.访问了守卫页（PAGE_GUARD）：栈自动扩展或自定义内存保护触发。: A guard page (PAGE_GUARD) was accessed: automatic stack growth or a custom memory protection was triggered.
source_translations.崩溃点指令指针: Instruction pointer at the crash site
source_translations.释放时的池类型与分配时不一致。: The pool type at free time does not match the type used at allocation.
source_translations.参数 3 是发起访问的指令地址，据此定位肇事驱动。: Parameter 3 is the address of the instruction that made the access; use it to locate the offending driver.
source_translations.2 —— 转储被截断（磁盘空间不足或页面文件太小）: 2 - the dump was truncated (insufficient disk space or the page file is too small)
source_translations.崩溃指令地址 %1 位于 %2。: Faulting instruction address %1 is located in %2.
source_translations.分配了大小为零的池块。: A pool block of zero size was allocated.
source_translations.释放时的池块头部已被破坏。: The pool block header was corrupted at free time.
source_translations.驱动在电源操作中完成了本不该完成的 IRP。: A driver completed an IRP during a power operation that it should not have completed.
source_translations.这是典型的“卸载时未清理挂起操作”缺陷。: This is the classic 'pending operations not cleaned up at unload' defect.
source_translations.本应可写的页面被发现是只读的（写时复制状态被破坏）。: A page that should have been writable was found read-only (the copy-on-write state is corrupted).
source_translations.内核栈溢出导致的栈切换失败：驱动递归过深或在栈上分配过大。: Stack switch failed because of a kernel stack overflow: driver recursion is too deep, or it allocated too much on the stack.
source_translations.参数 2 的 NTSTATUS 指明了具体的 I/O 失败原因，先看它。: The NTSTATUS in parameter 2 gives the specific I/O failure reason - start there.
source_translations.用 Application Verifier 打开堆检查，能在越界发生的那一刻断: Enable heap checking in Application Verifier to break at the exact moment the overrun occurs.
source_translations.重复获取已持有的互斥体。: Recursive acquisition of an already-held mutex.
source_translations.策略已锁定，运行期不可更改: Policy is locked and cannot be changed at runtime
source_translations.在 DPC 例程里执行了非法的线程切换（等待/挂起）。: An illegal thread switch (wait/suspend) was performed inside a DPC routine.
source_translations.在 DllMain 回调中执行了非法调用。: An illegal call was made from a DllMain callback.
source_translations.#DF 双重错误：处理一个异常时又发生了异常，内核栈溢出是最常见的原因。: #DF double fault: an exception occurred while another exception was being handled; kernel stack overflow is the most common cause.
source_translations.SMB 重定向器（网络文件系统客户端）内部错误。: SMB redirector (network file system client) internal error.
source_translations.驱动在 I/O 完成后没有解锁页面（MDL 泄漏）。: A driver failed to unlock pages after I/O completion (MDL leak).
source_translations.更新网卡、USB 与显卡驱动，这三类最常在睡眠/唤醒路径出问题。: Update network, USB, and display drivers - these three most often fail in the sleep/resume path.
source_translations.检测到可能的死锁（临界区等待超时）。: Possible deadlock detected (critical section wait timed out).
source_translations.崩溃点在第三方模块（注入的钩子、杀软、输入法、录屏组件）时，先在干净环境复现以排: When the crash site is in a third-party module (injected hooks, antivirus, IME, screen recorders), reproduce in a clean environment first to rule out interference.
source_translations.释放时的池块大小与分配时不一致。: The pool block size at free time does not match the size used at allocation.
source_translations.崩溃线程栈顶为 %1: Top of the crashing thread's stack is %1
source_translations.内核堆管理器检测到堆结构损坏。: The kernel heap manager detected heap structure corruption.
source_translations.无响应的显示驱动模块地址: Address of the unresponsive display driver module
source_translations.内核池释放填充（已释放的池块）: Kernel pool free fill (a freed pool block)
source_translations.试图释放一个未被映射的地址。: Attempted to free an address that is not mapped.
source_translations.用 chkdsk 检查目标卷，并查看磁盘 SMART 健康状态。: Run chkdsk on the target volume and review the disk's SMART health status.
source_translations.用同版本 PDB 在调试器中打开本转储，可把崩溃点从“模块+偏移”还原到具体函数: Open this dump in a debugger with matching-version PDBs to resolve the crash point from "module+offset" down to an exact function and line number.
source_translations.CDFS（光盘文件系统）内部错误。: Internal error in CDFS (the CD-ROM file system).
source_translations.页帧号数据库的引用计数出错。: Reference count error in the page frame number database.
source_translations.出错的显示驱动模块地址: Address of the faulting display driver module
source_translations.参数 1 是被访问的地址；若它接近 0 说明是空指针解引用，若是 0xFFFF…: Parameter 1 is the address that was accessed; a value near 0 indicates a null pointer dereference, while something like 0xFFFF... indicates a stale pointer.
source_translations.驱动没有正确处理即插即用 IRP。: A driver failed to handle a Plug and Play IRP correctly.
source_translations.即插即用管理器检测到致命错误；具体子码未收录。: The Plug and Play manager reported a fatal error; the specific subcode is not documented here.
source_translations.试图切换到的新线程对象: The new thread object being switched to
source_translations.检测到非法的跳转目标。: An invalid jump target was detected.
source_translations.本工具无法在没有符号的情况下枚举已加载驱动，归因能力有限。: Without symbols this tool cannot enumerate loaded drivers, so its attribution ability is limited.
source_translations.参数 1 的子类型直接说明了破坏形式（链表损坏 / 栈 cookie / 数组越: The subtype in parameter 1 names the corruption form outright (list corruption / stack cookie / array overrun) - start there.
source_translations.OutputDebugStringW 产生的调试输出异常，不是崩溃。: A debug output exception raised by OutputDebugStringW, not a crash.
source_translations.PTE 与 PFN 数据库内容不一致：驱动越界写或物理内存故障。: PTE and PFN database contents disagree: an out-of-bounds driver write or failing physical memory.
source_translations.系统页表项（PTE）耗尽：某个驱动大量映射内存后未释放。: System page table entries (PTEs) exhausted: a driver mapped large amounts of memory and never released it.
source_translations.检查内存、电源与散热；查看系统事件日志中的 WHEA-Logger 记录。: Check memory, power, and cooling; review the WHEA-Logger entries in the System event log.
source_translations.WinRT 错误起源标记，不一定是崩溃点。: A WinRT error origination marker, not necessarily the crash point.
source_translations.应用程序主动致命退出。: The application deliberately terminated with a fatal exit.
source_translations.最近卸载的驱动记录（含卸载前地址区间）: Recently unloaded driver records (including the address range held before unload)
source_translations.内存描述符（MDL）状态与页面实际状态不一致。: The MDL state does not match the actual state of the pages it describes.
source_translations.驱动向只读内存页写入；参数 1 是目标地址。: A driver wrote to a read-only memory page; parameter 1 is the target address.
source_translations.显卡驱动超时后恢复（TDR）失败；参数 2 指向出错的显示驱动。: Graphics driver Timeout Detection and Recovery (TDR) failed; parameter 2 points to the faulting display driver.
source_translations.#GP 一般保护错误：访问了非规范地址或违反了段权限。: #GP general protection fault: a non-canonical address was accessed or segment permissions were violated.
source_translations.控制流防护（CFG）间接调用检查失败：函数指针被改写成非法目标。: Control Flow Guard (CFG) indirect call check failed: a function pointer was overwritten with an invalid target.
source_translations.传入了非法的 fast-fail 子码。: An invalid fast-fail subcode was passed in.
source_translations.某个逻辑处理器没有响应时钟中断：多核死锁、虚拟化异常或 CPU 硬件问题。: A logical processor stopped responding to the clock interrupt: a multi-core deadlock, a virtualization fault, or a CPU hardware problem.
source_translations.配额记账下溢：进程释放的配额比申请的多。: Quota accounting underflow: a process returned more quota than it ever charged.
source_translations.延迟加载失败：找不到模块。: Delay load failed: module not found.
source_translations.子类型（0 工作项在可分页内存 / 1 工作项已排队）: Subtype (0 work item in pageable memory / 1 work item already queued)
source_translations.已修改的驱动映像代码段。: A driver image code section has been modified.
source_translations.通用硬件错误源（GHES，由固件描述）。: Generic Hardware Error Source (GHES, described by firmware).
source_translations.内存管理器发现内部结构不一致；可能是驱动越界破坏，也可能是物理内存故障。: The memory manager found its internal structures inconsistent; this can be out-of-bounds corruption by a driver or failing physical memory.
source_translations.试图写入配置管理器的只读存储。: Attempted to write to read-only configuration manager storage.
source_translations.检测到不安全的内核数据结构访问。: Unsafe kernel data structure access was detected.
source_translations.IRQL 出现了不该出现的值：驱动升降 IRQL 没有配平。: IRQL held an unexpected value: a driver raised and lowered IRQL without balancing the two.
source_translations.会话管理器初始化失败（常因系统文件缺失或损坏）。: Session manager initialization failed (commonly due to missing or corrupted system files).
source_translations.访问地址是哨兵值（0xCCCC…/0xDDDD…/0xFEEEFEEE）时，按“: When the accessed address is a sentinel value (0xCCCC.../0xDDDD.../0xFEEEFEEE), investigate along the "uninitialized memory" or "use-after-free" lines.
source_translations.页帧号列表损坏：多为驱动传入了错误的 MDL 或越界写。: PFN list corruption - usually a driver supplying a bad MDL or writing out of bounds.
source_translations.CPU 产生了内核无法处理的陷阱；参数 1 是陷阱号（0x8 双重错误常由内核栈: The CPU raised a trap the kernel cannot handle; parameter 1 is the trap number (0x8, double fault, is usually caused by kernel stack overflow).
source_translations.恢复所有默认频率与电压，取消超频。: Restore all default clocks and voltages; remove any overclock.
source_translations.无法把崩溃地址归属到具体驱动。: The crash address could not be attributed to a specific driver.
source_translations.低（仅按停止码分类推断，无地址级证据）: Low (inferred from the stop code alone, no address-level evidence)
source_translations.单处理器驱动被加载到多处理器系统上。: A uniprocessor-only driver was loaded on a multiprocessor system.
source_translations.人为触发的崩溃（键盘 CrashOnCtrlScroll 或调试工具），不是故障: Manually triggered crash (keyboard CrashOnCtrlScroll or a debugging tool), not a real fault.
source_translations.排除软件后测内存：随机比特翻转同样会触发内核安全检查。: Once software is ruled out, test the RAM: random bit flips will trip kernel security checks just as well.
source_translations.中（有地址级证据，但来自栈扫描或指向系统模块）: Medium (address-level evidence exists, but it comes from a stack scan or points at a system module)
source_translations.ACPI 固件不符合规范：优先更新 BIOS/UEFI。: The ACPI firmware is non-compliant - update the BIOS/UEFI first.
source_translations.这是一个未被接住的 C++ 异常：崩溃点是抛出点而不是缺陷点。: This is an uncaught C++ exception - the crash site is the throw point, not the defect.
source_translations.更新 BIOS/UEFI 与芯片组驱动。: Update the BIOS/UEFI and the chipset drivers.
source_translations.安全子系统内部错误。: Internal error in the security subsystem.
source_translations.按“肇事模块候选”里的第一名着手：更新、回滚或临时卸载该驱动。: Start with the top entry under "Suspect module candidates": update, roll back, or temporarily uninstall that driver.
source_translations.已修改的系统服务描述符表（SSDT）。: The System Service Descriptor Table (SSDT) has been modified.
source_translations.线程卡死在设备驱动里（多为显卡驱动无限等待硬件）。: A thread is stuck inside a device driver (usually a display driver waiting indefinitely on hardware).
source_translations.[疑似调用栈] 由栈内存扫描重建，无符号；顺序为近似值，可能含残留帧: [Probable call stack] Reconstructed by scanning stack memory, no symbols; ordering is approximate and stale frames may be present
source_translations.应用程序主动请求致命退出（fail fast）。: The application deliberately requested a fatal exit (fail fast).
source_translations.未初始化的堆内存（MSVC 调试堆新分配填充）: Uninitialized heap memory (MSVC debug heap fill for fresh allocations)
source_translations.常见肇事者是网卡、USB 控制器与显卡驱动：先更新这几类驱动。: The usual culprits are network, USB controller, and display drivers - update those first.
source_translations.自旋锁 / 同步对象类检查失败（锁未配平、在错误 IRQL 上使用同步原语）。: Spinlock / synchronization object check failed (unbalanced acquire and release, or a synchronization primitive used at the wrong IRQL).
source_translations.参数 1 的违规类型说明了是重复释放、标记不符还是释放了非池地址，方向完全不同。: The violation type in parameter 1 tells you whether this is a double free, a pool tag mismatch, or a free of a non-pool address - three completely different investigations.
source_translations.DMA 校验类检查失败（DMA 适配器、公共缓冲区或映射寄存器使用不当）。: DMA verification check failed (improper use of the DMA adapter, common buffer, or map registers).
source_translations.单个 DPC 例程执行时间超过了允许上限：某个驱动的 DPC 里做了耗时操作或死: A single DPC routine ran longer than the allowed limit - some driver is doing lengthy work or blocking inside its DPC.
source_translations.文件系统组件内部错误。: Internal error in a file system component.
source_translations.会话退出时仍有未释放的会话池（多为图形/打印驱动泄漏）。: Session pool was still allocated at session exit (usually a graphics or print driver leak).
source_translations.试图写入的虚拟地址: Virtual address of the attempted write
source_translations.关键系统服务启动失败。: A critical system service failed to start.
source_translations.通用数据区域被修改。: A generic data region has been modified.
source_translations.不可屏蔽中断报告的硬件故障。: Hardware fault reported by a non-maskable interrupt.
source_translations.用户态关键进程健康检查超时（多见于群集/服务器）。: Health check timeout on a critical user-mode process (most often seen on clusters and servers).
source_translations.系统发生了致命的异常复位。: The system underwent a fatal unexpected reset.
source_translations.这是 .NET 托管异常：本工具只能解析原生层信息，: This is a .NET managed exception - this tool can only decode native-layer information,
source_translations.用户回调（窗口过程等）中抛出了致命异常。: A fatal exception was raised inside a user callback (window procedure or similar).
source_translations.同一驱动反复出现在多份转储里，基本可以定案；只出现一次时先排除内存故障。: A driver that recurs across several dumps is all but confirmed; if it shows up only once, rule out memory faults first.
source_translations.引发异常的指令地址: Address of the instruction that raised the exception
source_translations.在错误的 IRQL 上申请分页池。: Paged pool allocated at the wrong IRQL.
source_translations.I/O 操作返回的 NTSTATUS: NTSTATUS returned by the I/O operation
source_translations.试图映射一个并不存在的物理页。: Attempted to map a physical page that does not exist.
source_translations.%1；本转储未能把崩溃地址归属到任何模块。: %1; this dump could not attribute the crash address to any module.
source_translations.显卡驱动在规定时间内没有响应（TDR 超时）。: The display driver did not respond within the allotted time (TDR timeout).
source_translations.参数 1 为 0xD（一般保护错误）时，多为访问了非规范地址，指针被破坏。: When parameter 1 is 0xD (general protection fault), a non-canonical address was usually accessed, meaning the pointer was corrupted.
source_translations.PatchGuard 报错说明内核关键结构被修改：优先排查带内核驱动的安全软件、: A PatchGuard error means critical kernel structures were modified - check security software with kernel drivers, game cheats and virtualization tools first.
source_translations.[肇事模块候选] 按证据权重降序: [Faulting module candidates] sorted by evidence weight, descending
source_translations.内核模式驱动框架（KMDF）检测到驱动违规。: The Kernel-Mode Driver Framework (KMDF) detected a driver violation.
source_translations.等待对象数量超过内核允许的上限。: The number of wait objects exceeds the kernel limit.
source_translations.虚表守卫检查失败：对象的虚表指针被改写。: VTable guard check failed - the object's vtable pointer was overwritten.
source_translations.内核数据页无法读入：参数 2 的 NTSTATUS 指明了具体 I/O 错误，多: A kernel data page could not be read in - the NTSTATUS in parameter 2 identifies the specific I/O error, usually a disk or storage driver failure.
source_translations.排查文件系统过滤驱动（杀软、备份、加密、虚拟磁盘），逐个临时卸载验证。: Investigate file system filter drivers (antivirus, backup, encryption, virtual disk) by temporarily unloading them one at a time to verify.
source_translations.PCI Express 总线报告的错误。: An error reported by the PCI Express bus.
source_translations.虚拟机里出现该码时，先排除宿主机的磁盘卡顿与 CPU 超配。: When this code appears inside a virtual machine, first rule out host disk stalls and CPU overcommit.
source_translations.内核池分配填充（未初始化的池块）: Kernel pool allocation fill (uninitialized pool block)
source_translations.处理器机器检查异常：CPU/内存/总线硬件故障，超频与供电不稳是常见诱因。: Processor machine check exception - a CPU, memory or bus hardware fault; overclocking and unstable power are common causes.
source_translations.进程退出时仍有被驱动锁定的页面未解锁。: Pages locked by a driver were still not unlocked when the process exited.
source_translations.旧版栈保护（/GS）检查失败：栈上缓冲区被写溢出。: Legacy stack protection (/GS) check failed - a stack buffer was overrun.
source_translations.当前 IRQL 低于操作所要求的级别。: The current IRQL is lower than the level the operation requires.
source_translations.内核映像代码段被修改（内核函数被打补丁）。: The kernel image code section was modified (a kernel function was patched).
source_translations.运行 sfc /scannow 与 DISM 修复系统文件。: Run sfc /scannow and DISM to repair system files.
source_translations.重复获取已经持有的自旋锁（自死锁）。: Reacquired a spin lock that is already held (self-deadlock).
source_translations.设置线程上下文被安全策略拒绝。: Setting the thread context was denied by security policy.
source_translations.工作线程返回时 IRQL 不正确：工作项回调升了 IRQL 没降回来。: IRQL was incorrect when the worker thread returned - a work item callback raised IRQL and never lowered it.
source_translations.先用 MemTest86 做一轮完整内存测试，排除物理内存故障。: Run a full MemTest86 pass first to rule out a physical memory fault.
source_translations.系统累计处于 DISPATCH_LEVEL 及以上的时间超限：可能是大量 DPC: The system spent too much cumulative time at DISPATCH_LEVEL or above - either a large DPC backlog or a spin lock held for too long.
source_translations.检查供电与温度：电源功率不足与散热不良都会导致不可纠正错误。: Check power delivery and temperature - insufficient PSU capacity and poor cooling both cause uncorrectable errors.
source_translations.#UD 无效操作码：执行到了不是指令的数据，多为函数指针被破坏。: #UD invalid opcode - execution reached data that is not code, usually a corrupted function pointer.
source_translations.用 chkdsk 与厂商工具检查磁盘健康（SMART 的重分配扇区计数是关键指标: Check disk health with chkdsk and vendor tools (the SMART reallocated sector count is the key indicator).
source_translations.临时禁用快速启动与混合睡眠，可判断是否为休眠路径特有的问题。: Temporarily disable Fast Startup and hybrid sleep to determine whether the problem is specific to the hibernation path.
source_translations.工作队列项非法：多为工作项被重复排队或已释放后仍在队列中。: Invalid work queue item - the work item was usually queued twice, or freed while still on the queue.
source_translations.APC 状态索引不匹配：内核 APC 禁用/启用调用未配对，多见于文件系统过滤驱: APC state index mismatch - kernel APC disable/enable calls are unpaired, most often in file system filter drivers.
source_translations.参数 1 为 0 时是单个 DPC 超时：看调用栈里的第三方驱动，常见于存储、网: Parameter 1 of 0 means a single DPC timed out - inspect third-party drivers on the call stack, commonly storage, network and virtualization drivers.
source_translations.设备的资源需求列表非法。: The device's resource requirements list is invalid.
source_translations.重点检查最近改动过的缓冲区拷贝、数组下标与 realloc 之后的旧指针使用。: Focus on recently changed buffer copies, array indices, and stale pointer use after realloc.
source_translations.WOW64 子系统中的断点：32 位进程在 64 位系统上命中 int 3。: Breakpoint in the WOW64 subsystem: a 32-bit process hit int 3 on a 64-bit system.
source_translations.驱动没有在规定时间内完成即插即用操作。: A driver did not complete a Plug and Play operation within the required time.
source_translations.期望 cookie 的按位取反: Bitwise complement of the expected cookie
source_translations.访问了已释放的特殊池内存（释放后使用），由驱动验证器捕获。: Freed special pool memory was accessed (use-after-free), caught by Driver Verifier.
source_translations.试图释放的地址位于内核栈上，而非池中。: The address being freed lies on the kernel stack rather than in pool.
source_translations.原线程的栈地址: Stack address of the original thread
source_translations.注册表（配置管理器）错误，可能是配置单元文件损坏或 I/O 失败。: Registry (Configuration Manager) error - possibly a corrupted hive file or an I/O failure.
source_translations.事件跟踪（ETW）子系统致命错误。: Fatal error in the Event Tracing (ETW) subsystem.
source_translations.高（崩溃指令直接落在该模块内）: High (the faulting instruction falls directly inside this module)
source_translations.虚拟机环境下先排除宿主机的存储卡顿与 CPU 超配。: In a virtual machine, first rule out host storage stalls and CPU overcommit.
source_translations.优先按内存/CPU/供电/超频方向排查。: Investigate memory, CPU, power delivery, and overclocking first.
source_translations.调用栈由栈内存扫描重建（无符号），共 %1 帧；顺序为近似值且可能含残留帧。: Call stack reconstructed by scanning stack memory (no symbols), %1 frames total; the order is approximate and may include stale frames.
source_translations.自动提升机制管理的锁被非法释放（释放者不是持有者）。: A lock managed by autoboost was released illegally (the releaser is not the owner).
source_translations.命名管道文件系统内部错误。: Internal error in the named pipe file system.
source_translations.排除硬件后，用驱动验证器的特殊池定位越界写的驱动。: Once hardware is ruled out, use Driver Verifier special pool to pinpoint the driver writing out of bounds.
source_translations.在已附加到其它进程时再次尝试附加进程上下文。: Attempted to attach to a process context while already attached to another process.
source_translations.驱动在池块释放之后又改写了它（释放后使用）。: A driver modified a pool block after it had been freed (use-after-free).
source_translations.驱动写爆了栈上的缓冲区，栈保护 cookie 校验失败。: A driver overran a stack buffer; the stack protection cookie check failed.
source_translations.试图释放一个尚未分配的地址。: Attempted to free an address that was never allocated.
source_translations.中断服务例程中的异常未被处理。: An exception raised in an interrupt service routine went unhandled.
source_translations.引用计数出现非法值（多减或溢出）。: The reference count reached an invalid value (over-decremented or overflowed).
source_translations.内核句柄表项被破坏。: A kernel handle table entry is corrupted.
source_translations.已修改的处理器控制块。: The processor control block (KPRCB) was modified.
source_translations.以 MUST_SUCCEED 语义申请池失败。: A pool allocation with MUST_SUCCEED semantics failed.
source_translations.线程退出时内核栈仍处于锁定状态。: The kernel stack was still locked when the thread exited.
source_translations.单比特翻转导致页面损坏：几乎可以确定是内存条硬件故障。: A single-bit flip corrupted a page - almost certainly a faulty memory module.
source_translations.驱动返回了非法的设备 ID。: A driver returned an invalid device ID.
source_translations.内核池空闲链表被破坏。: The kernel pool free list is corrupted.
source_translations.目标 MDL 太小，无法容纳要映射的数据。: The target MDL is too small to hold the data being mapped.
source_translations.旧版 .NET 运行时的托管异常。: Managed exception from a legacy .NET runtime.
source_translations.为避免继续执行造成更大危害而立即退出。: Terminated immediately to prevent further damage from continued execution.
source_translations.无法读入的虚拟地址: Virtual address that could not be read in
source_translations.检查供电与显卡温度；多屏、高刷新率与自定义分辨率也会诱发 TDR。: Check power delivery and GPU temperature; multiple monitors, high refresh rates, and custom resolutions can also trigger TDR.
source_translations.内核模式代码抛出了没有人处理的异常；参数 1 才是真正的异常码。: Kernel-mode code raised an exception that nobody handled; parameter 1 is the actual exception code.
source_translations.初始化例程被意外重复调用。: The initialization routine was unexpectedly called more than once.
source_translations.页帧号数据库的共享计数出错。: The PFN database share count is incorrect.
source_translations.USB 驱动栈内部错误；参数 1 是子类型。: Internal error in the USB driver stack; parameter 1 is the subtype.
source_translations.控制流防护（CFG）间接调用检查失败：函数指针被改写。: Control Flow Guard (CFG) indirect call check failed: the function pointer was overwritten.
source_translations.IRP 栈位置耗尽：驱动把 IRP 往下层转发时没有正确设置栈层数。: IRP stack locations exhausted: a driver forwarded the IRP to a lower layer without setting the stack count correctly.
source_translations.驱动持有取消自旋锁就返回了。: A driver returned while still holding the cancel spin lock.
source_translations.#DE 除法错误：除零或商溢出。: #DE Divide Error: divide by zero or quotient overflow.
source_translations.调用了非法的系统调用号。: An invalid system call number was invoked.
source_translations.中断关闭状态下发生了页错误。: A page fault occurred while interrupts were disabled.
source_translations.对象所在的驱动映像基址: Base address of the driver image containing the object
source_translations.释放的池块头部被破坏。: The header of the freed pool block is corrupted.
source_translations.Borland/其它编译器的 C++ 异常记录: C++ exception record from Borland or another compiler
source_translations.池损坏的崩溃点离真正的越界写很远：开启驱动验证器的特殊池能把现场提前到越界那一刻: The crash point for pool corruption is far from the actual out-of-bounds write; enabling Driver Verifier special pool moves the failure back to the moment of the overrun.
source_translations.确认崩溃地址所属模块：若是自家模块，用同版本 PDB 在调试器里定位到具体函数。: Identify the module that owns the crash address; if it is your own module, use the matching PDB in the debugger to pin down the exact function.
source_translations.内部内存管理断言失败。: An internal memory manager assertion failed.
source_translations.USB 3.0 驱动栈内部错误；参数 1 是子类型。: Internal USB 3.0 driver stack error; parameter 1 is the subtype.
source_translations.堆块守卫区（MSVC 调试堆 no-man's-land），典型越界读写: Heap block guard region (MSVC debug heap no-man's-land) - a typical out-of-bounds read or write
source_translations.池块头部被破坏：池分配的元数据被越界写覆盖。: Pool block header corrupted: the pool allocation metadata was overwritten by an out-of-bounds write.
source_translations.已修改的进程/线程回调列表。: The process/thread callback list was modified.
source_translations.参数 1 为 0x2（NMI）时按硬件方向排查。: When parameter 1 is 0x2 (NMI), investigate along hardware lines.
source_translations.控制流防护写检查失败。: Control Flow Guard write check failed.
source_translations.以错误的对齐方式释放池块。: A pool block was freed with the wrong alignment.
source_translations.设备对象在电源操作完成前被销毁。: The device object was destroyed before the power operation completed.
source_translations.怀疑对象明确后，用驱动验证器（verifier /standard /drive: Once the suspect is identified, reproduce it under Driver Verifier (verifier /standard /driver suspect.sys) to break in at the first instance of the overrun.
source_translations.访问发生时的 IRQL: IRQL at the time of the access
source_translations.参数 1 为 3 时，参数 4 指向被阻塞的电源 IRP，顺着它能找到卡住的设备: When parameter 1 is 3, parameter 4 points to the blocked power IRP; follow it to find the stalled device stack.
source_translations.参数 1 为 1 时是系统整体长时间处于高 IRQL：多为大量中断/DPC 堆积: Parameter 1 of 1 means the system stayed at high IRQL for an extended period - usually a backlog of interrupts and DPCs; check the disk or network adapter driver.
source_translations.取消显卡超频/降压，恢复默认设置。: Remove any GPU overclock or undervolt and restore default settings.
source_translations.NTFS 驱动内部错误：磁盘损坏、存储驱动故障或文件系统过滤驱动缺陷。: Internal NTFS driver error: disk corruption, a failing storage driver, or a defective file system filter driver.
source_translations.错误状态低 32 位（MCi_STATUS）: Low 32 bits of the error status (MCi_STATUS)
source_translations.MSVC C++ 异常记录（带 pCatchableTypeArray 扩展）: MSVC C++ exception record (with pCatchableTypeArray extension)
source_translations.阻塞的 IRP 或超时的设备栈: Blocked IRP or timed-out device stack
source_translations.线程退出时仍有挂起的内核 APC，通常是 APC 禁用计数没配平。: The thread exited with kernel APCs still pending, usually an unbalanced APC disable count.
source_translations.收集多份转储做交叉比对：反复出现同一个第三方驱动才算定案。: Collect several dumps and cross-compare them; only a third-party driver that shows up again and again counts as a verdict.
source_translations.驱动越过分配末尾访问内存（缓冲区溢出）。: A driver accessed memory past the end of its allocation (buffer overrun).
source_translations.系统页表项耗尽：某个驱动大量映射内存后没有释放。: System PTEs exhausted: a driver mapped large amounts of memory and never released it.
source_translations.更新主板 BIOS/UEFI 与芯片组微码；系统事件日志里的 WHEA-Logg: Update the motherboard BIOS/UEFI and the chipset microcode; WHEA-Logger entries in the System event log provide additional detail.
source_translations.延迟加载保护检查失败。: Delay load import protection check failed.
source_translations.内存错误校正码（ECC）报告的不可纠正错误。: Uncorrectable error reported by memory error correcting code (ECC).
source_translations.关键进程或线程被意外终止；参数 3/4 通常带有进程名与说明。: A critical process or thread was terminated unexpectedly; parameters 3 and 4 usually carry the process name and a description.
source_translations.内核模式栈上的返回地址被改写。: A return address on the kernel-mode stack was overwritten.
source_translations.检查线程入口/回调边界是否缺少 catch，跨模块抛异常尤其容易漏接。: Check whether thread entry points and callback boundaries are missing a catch; exceptions thrown across module boundaries are especially easy to miss.
source_translations.WOW64 子系统中的单步陷阱。: Single-step trap in the WOW64 subsystem.
source_translations.用 DDU 彻底卸载后重新安装显卡驱动。: Use DDU to fully uninstall the display driver, then reinstall it.
source_translations.排查完毕后记得关闭验证器：verifier /reset，否则系统会持续处于低性: Remember to turn the verifier off when you are done: verifier /reset, otherwise the system stays in a degraded-performance state.
source_translations.驱动验证器的 I/O 管理器检查捕获到违规；参数 1 是子类型。: Driver Verifier I/O manager checking caught a violation; parameter 1 is the subtype.
source_translations.完整/内核内存转储不含 TRIAGE 驱动列表，: Complete/kernel memory dumps do not contain the TRIAGE driver list,
source_translations.空指针解引用：指针本身为 NULL。: Null pointer dereference: the pointer itself is NULL.
source_translations.内核安全检查失败（链表损坏、栈 cookie、数组越界等）；参数 1 是具体的检: Kernel security check failure (list corruption, stack cookie, array bounds, and so on); parameter 1 is the specific check type.
source_translations.试图释放的地址不是有效的池地址。: The address being freed is not a valid pool address.
source_translations.对已释放的对象执行了操作。: An operation was performed on an already freed object.
source_translations.程序主动请求致命退出（abort/std::terminate 一类）。: The program deliberately requested a fatal exit (abort/std::terminate and similar).
source_translations.即插即用管理器内部错误。: Internal Plug and Play manager error.
source_translations.访问了无效的系统内存地址；常见于驱动缺陷、内存故障或杀软过滤驱动。: An invalid system memory address was accessed; usually caused by a driver defect, failing RAM, or an antivirus filter driver.
source_translations.地址命中了已卸载的模块 %1：驱动卸载后仍有代码/定时器/回调在执行，: The address falls inside unloaded module %1: code, timers, or callbacks are still running after the driver unloaded,
source_translations.类型索引表被修改。: The type index table was modified.
source_translations.内核池分配记账不一致。: Kernel pool allocation accounting is inconsistent.
source_translations.取消显卡超频与降压曲线，恢复默认频率再观察。: Remove GPU overclocks and undervolt curves, restore default clocks, then observe again.
source_translations.先看“肇事模块候选”与调用栈里出现的第三方模块。: Start with "Suspect module candidates" and any third-party modules that appear on the call stack.
source_translations.当前处理器不受该 Windows 版本支持。: The current processor is not supported by this version of Windows.
source_translations.范围检查失败（数组下标越界）。: Range check failure (array index out of bounds).
source_translations.释放互斥体的线程并不是它的持有者。: The thread releasing the mutex is not its owner.
source_translations.MSVC C++ 异常（throw）：崩溃点是抛出位置，真正的缺陷通常在更上游。: MSVC C++ exception (throw): the crash site is the throw location; the real defect is usually further upstream.
source_translations.NMI 不可屏蔽中断（硬件故障的强信号）。: NMI non-maskable interrupt (a strong indicator of hardware failure).
source_translations.只读数据段在被标记只读之后又被修改。: A read-only data section was modified after it had been marked read-only.
source_translations.本转储不含异常记录：多半是主动生成的快照（任务管理器/ProcDump），而不是: This dump has no exception record: it is most likely an on-demand snapshot (Task Manager/ProcDump) rather than a live crash.
source_translations.发生了内核无法归类的陷阱。: A trap occurred that the kernel could not classify.
source_translations.参数 2 是出错指令地址，把它归属到的模块作为嫌疑对象。: Parameter 2 is the faulting instruction address; treat the module it resolves to as the suspect.
source_translations.定时器或 DPC 对象位于已释放/可分页的内存中：驱动卸载时没有取消它们。: A timer or DPC object lives in freed or pageable memory: the driver did not cancel it on unload.
source_translations.HAL 与内核版本不匹配。: The HAL and kernel versions do not match.
source_translations.驱动验证器捕获到违规；具体子类型未收录，请以启用的验证选项为线索。: Driver Verifier caught a violation; the specific subtype is not catalogued - use the enabled verification options as the lead.
source_translations.驱动验证器特殊池的已释放填充，典型释放后使用: Driver Verifier special pool freed fill - a classic use-after-free
source_translations.人为哨兵值（常见于驱动/内核代码的显式标记）: Hand-placed sentinel value (common as an explicit marker in driver/kernel code)
source_translations.参数 4 是出错指令地址：把它归属到的驱动作为首要嫌疑，优先更新或回滚该驱动。: Parameter 4 is the faulting instruction address: treat the driver it resolves to as the prime suspect, and update or roll back that driver first.
source_translations.范围检查失败：数组下标越界被编译器插入的检查抓到。: Range check failure: a compiler-inserted check caught an out-of-bounds array index.
source_translations.返回用户态时 IRQL 仍高于 PASSIVE_LEVEL：驱动升了 IRQL: IRQL was still above PASSIVE_LEVEL on return to user mode: a driver raised IRQL and never lowered it.
source_translations.崩溃点栈指针: Stack pointer at the crash site
source_translations.这是进程主动终止，不是被动崩溃：安全检查发现状态已被破坏，: This is a deliberate process termination, not a passive crash: a security check found the state already corrupted,
source_translations.执行释放的线程对象: Thread object that performed the release
source_translations.线程释放了并不属于它的 ERESOURCE。: A thread released an ERESOURCE that it did not own.
source_translations.#MC 机器检查异常：CPU 报告的硬件故障。: #MC machine check exception: a hardware fault reported by the CPU.
source_translations.驱动访问了越过内核栈边界的地址。: A driver accessed an address past the kernel stack boundary.
source_translations.IRQL 与内存访问类检查失败（在过高 IRQL 上访问分页内存或调用受限例程）: IRQL and memory access checks failed (paged memory touched or a restricted routine called at too high an IRQL).
source_translations.HeapAlloc 分配块尾部守卫区（Windows 调试堆）: HeapAlloc block tail guard region (Windows debug heap)
source_translations.以非法的池类型请求了零字节分配。: A zero-byte allocation was requested with an invalid pool type.
source_translations.试图释放的地址不是分配的起始地址。: The address being freed is not the start of the allocation.
source_translations.内存压缩存储组件发生意外异常，常与存储驱动或磁盘故障相关。: The memory compression store component hit an unexpected exception, commonly tied to a storage driver or a failing disk.
source_translations.栈指针不在合法范围内。: The stack pointer is outside its valid range.
source_translations.只读数据段被修改。: A read-only data section was modified.
source_translations.查看模块列表里该 DLL 是否被加载到了非预期路径（DLL 劫持）。: Check the module list to see whether the DLL was loaded from an unexpected path (DLL hijacking).
source_translations.驱动破坏了内核池结构，随后在高 IRQL 上访问到了坏数据。: A driver corrupted kernel pool structures and later touched the bad data at high IRQL.
source_translations.栈上的数组越界（编译器插入的边界检查失败）。: Stack array out of bounds (compiler-inserted bounds check failed).
source_translations.缺陷通常在更上游；需要 PDB 才能还原异常类型名。: The defect is usually further upstream; PDBs are required to recover the exception type name.
source_translations.非法的池操作（重复释放、释放非池地址、标记不匹配等）；参数 1 是违规类型。: Invalid pool operation (double free, freeing a non-pool address, tag mismatch, and so on); parameter 1 is the violation type.
source_translations.%1 ← 该地址所属模块是首要嫌疑对象: %1 <- the module owning this address is the prime suspect
source_translations.即插即用管理器检测到致命错误；参数 1 是子类型。: The Plug and Play manager detected a fatal error; parameter 1 is the subtype.
source_translations.子码为栈 cookie 检查失败时，查栈上缓冲区的写入长度计算。: When the subcode is a stack cookie check failure, review the length calculation for writes into stack buffers.
source_translations.空指针解引用：基指针为 NULL，再加上约 0x%1 的成员偏移。: Null pointer dereference: the base pointer is NULL, plus a member offset of roughly 0x%1.
source_translations.释放时的池标记与分配时不一致：释放者与分配者不是同一个组件。: The pool tag used at free time differs from the one used at allocation: the freeing component is not the allocating one.
source_translations.长按电源键触发的手动崩溃转储，不是故障。: Manual crash dump triggered by holding the power button - not a fault.
source_translations.驱动没有在规定时间内完成电源 IRP：参数 4 指向被阻塞的 IRP，是排查的入: A driver failed to complete a power IRP within the allotted time: parameter 4 points to the stalled IRP and is the entry point for investigation.
source_translations.加密库内部一致性检查失败。: An internal consistency check in the cryptographic library failed.
source_translations.NULL 页地址，空指针解引用: NULL page address, null pointer dereference
source_translations.这三个停止码本身只说明“异常没人处理”，参数 1 的 NTSTATUS 才是真正: These three stop codes only say that "nobody handled the exception"; the real cause is the NTSTATUS in parameter 1, so start there.
source_translations.对照模块列表确认崩溃模块的版本，与已知问题的修复版本比对。: Confirm the crashing module's version against the module list and compare it with the version that fixes the known issue.
source_translations.使用了无效的内核对象句柄；开启句柄跟踪可定位是谁关闭了它。: An invalid kernel object handle was used; enable handle tracing to find out who closed it.
source_translations.硬件报告了不可纠正错误（WHEA）：CPU、内存、PCIe 总线或供电异常。: The hardware reported an uncorrectable error (WHEA): CPU, memory, PCIe bus, or power delivery fault.
source_translations.LocalAlloc/HeapAlloc 未初始化内存（Windows 调试堆填: LocalAlloc/HeapAlloc uninitialized memory (Windows debug heap fill)
source_translations.设备对象完成 I/O 后仍处于非法电源状态。: The device object is still in an invalid power state after completing I/O.
source_translations.影子栈（硬件 CET）校验失败：返回地址与影子栈不一致。: Shadow stack (hardware CET) check failed: the return address does not match the shadow stack.
source_translations.试图执行的虚拟地址: Virtual address of the attempted execution
source_translations.ACPI 驱动内部错误，多与固件（BIOS/UEFI）表有关。: Internal ACPI driver error, usually related to firmware (BIOS/UEFI) tables.
source_translations.延迟加载失败：模块中找不到导出函数。: Delay-load failure: the exported function was not found in the module.
source_translations.数据总线奇偶错误：内存或总线硬件故障的强信号。: Data bus parity error: a strong indicator of failing memory or bus hardware.
source_translations.32 位内核转储只解析头部信息：本格式不含 TRIAGE 驱动列表，: 32-bit kernel dumps are parsed for header information only: this format carries no TRIAGE driver list,
source_translations.HAL 映像代码段被修改。: The HAL image code section was modified.
source_translations.内部一致性检查发现非法参数。: An internal consistency check found an invalid parameter.
source_translations.在没有附加进程上下文时执行了分离操作。: A detach was performed while no process context was attached.
source_translations.参数 2 指向出错的显示驱动模块：先干净安装显卡驱动（用 DDU 彻底卸载后再装: Parameter 2 points to the failing display driver module: start with a clean install of the graphics driver (remove it completely with DDU, then reinstall).
source_translations.跑 MemTest86 至少一轮完整测试，多条内存时逐条排查。: Run at least one full pass of MemTest86; with multiple DIMMs installed, test them one at a time.
source_translations.无法访问启动设备：多因存储控制器驱动缺失或磁盘模式变更。: Boot device inaccessible - usually a missing storage controller driver or a changed disk controller mode.
source_translations.排查带内核驱动的安全软件、虚拟化工具与外挂类程序。: Investigate security software, virtualization tools, and game-hack style programs that load kernel drivers.
source_translations.系统线程抛出了未处理异常；参数 1 是异常码，参数 2 是出错地址。: A system thread raised an unhandled exception; parameter 1 is the exception code, parameter 2 is the faulting address.
source_translations.对可疑驱动启用驱动验证器（verifier /standard /driver: Enable Driver Verifier on the suspect driver (verifier /standard /driver name.sys) and reproduce; this catches the fault far closer to its origin.
source_translations.页表项（PTE）内容非法：多为驱动越界写覆盖了页表。: Invalid page table entry (PTE) contents - usually a driver out-of-bounds write that overwrote the page tables.
source_translations.双向链表节点损坏：多为释放后使用或越界写覆盖了链表指针。: Doubly linked list entry is corrupted - usually a use-after-free or an out-of-bounds write that clobbered the list pointers.
source_translations.MINIDUMP_PROCESS_VM_COUNTERS_1 必须是 pack(: MINIDUMP_PROCESS_VM_COUNTERS_1 must be 80 bytes under pack(4)
source_translations.参数里的异常对象指针配合 PDB 可以还原异常类型与消息。: The exception object pointer in the parameters, combined with PDBs, recovers the exception type and message.
source_translations.异常处理链（SEH 链）被破坏。: The exception handler chain (SEH chain) is corrupted.
source_translations.文件系统过滤管理器（FltMgr）遇到不可恢复错误。: The file system filter manager (FltMgr) hit an unrecoverable error.
source_translations.驱动验证器特殊池的未初始化填充: Driver Verifier special pool uninitialized fill pattern
source_translations.Windows 过滤平台（WFP）遇到非法操作，多为网络过滤驱动缺陷。: The Windows Filtering Platform (WFP) hit an illegal operation - usually a defect in a network filter driver.
source_translations.%1 —— 高于设备中断级别（32 位系统的时钟/IPI/电源级别）: %1 - above device IRQL (clock/IPI/power levels on 32-bit systems)
source_translations.本应为全零的页面里出现了非零数据：驱动越界写或物理内存故障。: Non-zero data found in a page that should be all zeros - a driver out-of-bounds write or failing physical memory.
source_translations.参数 1 为 0x8（双重错误）时最常见的原因是内核栈溢出：查调用栈里是否有深度: When parameter 1 is 0x8 (double fault), the most common cause is kernel stack overflow - look for deeply recursive drivers on the call stack.
source_translations.MSVC C++ 异常记录（VC6 起的经典布局）: MSVC C++ exception record (the classic layout since VC6)
source_translations.栈保护 cookie 被覆盖：栈缓冲区溢出。: The stack guard cookie was overwritten - stack buffer overrun.
source_translations.该停止码也可能由内存故障导致的随机比特翻转触发，排除软件后再测内存。: This stop code can also come from random bit flips caused by failing memory; once software is ruled out, test the RAM.
source_translations.HAL 无法分配所需内存。: The HAL could not allocate the memory it required.
source_translations.当前 IRQL 不是 DISPATCH_LEVEL，但代码要求处于该级别。: The current IRQL is not DISPATCH_LEVEL, but the code requires that level.
source_translations.执行系统服务例程时发生异常；参数 1 是异常码，参数 2 是出错指令地址。: An exception occurred while executing a system service routine; parameter 1 is the exception code, parameter 2 is the faulting instruction address.
source_translations.在错误的池类型上执行了操作。: An operation was performed on the wrong pool type.
source_translations.释放了并未持有的自旋锁。: Released a spin lock that was not held.
source_translations.对象引用计数出错（多为多减一次引用导致对象提前销毁）。: Object reference count error (usually one dereference too many, destroying the object early).
source_translations.驱动破坏了系统页表项。: A driver corrupted the system PTEs.
source_translations.执行体工作线程被非法终止。: An executive worker thread was terminated illegally.
source_translations.虚拟化环境的合成看门狗超时（宿主机调度或存储卡顿也会触发）。: Synthetic watchdog timeout in a virtualized environment (host scheduling or storage stalls can also trigger it).
source_translations.发起该访问的指令地址: Address of the instruction that made the access
source_translations.%1 —— 设备中断级别（DIRQL），禁止访问分页内存: %1 - device IRQL (DIRQL); paged memory must not be touched
source_translations.缓存管理器内部错误，多见于内存不足或文件系统故障。: Internal cache manager error - commonly low memory or a file system failure.
source_translations.已完成的 IRP 仍带有取消例程。: A completed IRP still had a cancel routine attached.
source_translations.人为触发的转储，无需排查稳定性问题。: Manually triggered dump - no stability issue to investigate.
source_translations.即插即用 / 电源类检查失败（设备栈状态机违规）。: Plug and Play / power check failed (device stack state machine violation).
source_translations.临时关闭快速启动与休眠，判断是否为特定电源路径的问题。: Temporarily disable Fast Startup and hibernation to determine whether a specific power path is at fault.
source_translations.在过高的 IRQL 上访问了分页内存或非法地址；绝大多数情况是驱动缺陷。: Paged memory or an invalid address was accessed at too high an IRQL; in the vast majority of cases this is a driver defect.
source_translations.ReFS 文件系统驱动内部错误。: Internal error in the ReFS file system driver.
source_translations.PCI/PCI-X 设备报告的错误。: Error reported by a PCI/PCI-X device.
source_translations.HTTP 内核驱动（http.sys）内部结构损坏。: Internal structure corruption in the HTTP kernel driver (http.sys).
source_translations.参数 1 的子类型直接对应违反的检查项，据此定位代码位置。: The subtype in parameter 1 maps directly to the violated check; use it to locate the offending code.
source_translations.非法的栈展开目标：栈上的展开信息已被破坏。: Invalid stack unwind target: the unwind information on the stack has been corrupted.
source_translations.用依赖查看工具比对目标机上的实际加载结果，注意 SxS/清单与运行库版本。: Use a dependency viewer to compare what actually loads on the target machine; watch for SxS/manifest and runtime library versions.
source_translations.排查安全软件与第三方 LSA/凭据提供程序，它们注入关键进程后崩溃会直接导致本停: Investigate security software and third-party LSA/credential providers; if they crash after injecting into a critical process, they trigger this stop code directly.
source_translations.CFG 间接调用检查被抑制后仍命中非法目标。: An indirect call hit an invalid target even after the CFG check was suppressed.
source_translations.引发问题的异常码: Exception code that caused the failure
source_translations.页表页本身已损坏。: The page table page itself is corrupted.
source_translations.驱动破坏了内存管理池。: A driver corrupted the memory manager pool.
source_translations.PCI/PCI-X 总线报告的错误。: Error reported by the PCI/PCI-X bus.
source_translations.IRP 状态与预期不符（驱动重复完成或改写了已完成的 IRP）。: IRP state does not match expectations (a driver completed an IRP twice or modified an already completed IRP).
source_translations.主动致命退出（__fastfail）：参数 1 的子码说明触发了哪条安全检查。: Deliberate fatal exit (__fastfail): the subcode in parameter 1 identifies which security check fired.
source_translations.栈保护 cookie 校验失败：典型的栈缓冲区溢出。: Stack protection cookie check failed: a classic stack buffer overflow.
source_translations.常见诱因还包括杀软/加密/虚拟磁盘等文件系统过滤驱动，可临时卸载验证。: Common triggers also include file system filter drivers from antivirus, encryption, or virtual disk products; uninstall them temporarily to verify.
source_translations.PCI 总线驱动内部错误。: Internal error in the PCI bus driver.
source_translations.线程数 %1 较多，只对前 %2 个线程重建了调用栈。: Thread count %1 is high; call stacks were rebuilt only for the first %2 threads.
source_translations.堆损坏的崩溃点通常离真正的越界写很远，必须开页堆定位：gflags /p /en: The crash point for heap corruption is usually far from the actual out-of-bounds write; enable page heap to locate it: gflags /p /enable <exe> /full.
source_translations.数据未按要求对齐。: The data is not aligned as required.
source_translations.在高 IRQL 上获取了受自动提升管理的锁。: A lock managed by autoboost was acquired at high IRQL.
source_translations.时钟中断超时的节拍数: Tick count for the clock interrupt timeout
source_translations.FAT 文件系统驱动内部错误，常伴随磁盘损坏。: Internal error in the FAT file system driver, often accompanied by disk corruption.
source_translations.特殊池检测到越界写：驱动写出了分配范围。仅在开启驱动验证器时出现。: Special pool detected an out-of-bounds write: a driver wrote past its allocation. Occurs only when Driver Verifier is enabled.
source_translations.没有可用的物理页：内存耗尽或页面文件不可用。: No physical pages available: memory is exhausted or the page file is unavailable.
source_translations.工作项或执行体工作线程对象非法（位于可分页或已释放内存中）。: The work item or executive worker thread object is invalid (it resides in pageable or freed memory).
source_translations.异常发生的指令地址: Instruction address where the exception occurred
source_translations.在禁用 APC 的状态下执行了需要 APC 的操作。: An operation requiring APCs was performed while APCs were disabled.
source_translations.子类型为 3（LIST_ENTRY 损坏）时，通常是某个驱动释放对象后没有摘链，: When the subtype is 3 (LIST_ENTRY corruption), a driver usually freed an object without unlinking it; reproduce with Driver Verifier.
source_translations.本应常驻内存的驱动代码/数据被放在了分页段。: Driver code/data that must stay resident was placed in a pageable section.
source_translations.线程在 IRQL = DISPATCH_LEVEL 且 Timeout 为 NU: A thread waited at IRQL = DISPATCH_LEVEL with a NULL Timeout, which leaves the CPU stuck at DISPATCH_LEVEL forever. Parameter 2 points to the IRQL value, parameter 3 points to the wait object, and parameter 4 points to the timeout value.
source_translations.分配位图损坏，内存管理器即将覆盖一段已在使用中的虚拟地址。: The allocation bitmap is corrupt, and the memory manager was about to overwrite a range of virtual addresses that is already in use.
source_translations.驱动分发例程改变了线程的 APC 禁用计数，即 KeEnterCriticalR: A driver dispatch routine changed the thread's APC disable count: KeEnterCriticalRegion / KeLeaveCriticalRegion (or mutex acquire/release, FsRtlEnterFileSystem / FsRtlExitFileSystem) were not paired. Parameter 2 is the dispatch routine address; parameters 3 and 4 are the counts after and before the call.
source_translations.扩展控制流防护（XFG）间接调用检查失败：调用目标的函数签名哈希与调用点不符；比: An eXtended Flow Guard (XFG) indirect call check failed: the function signature hash of the call target does not match the call site. XFG is stricter than CFG, and most false positives come from incompatible hooks and legacy detours.
source_translations.内部标志位被破坏。: An internal flag has been corrupted.
source_translations.导入表被修改（IAT 挂钩）。: The import table has been modified (IAT hooking).
source_translations.访问超出了栈段界限（栈段错误）。: An access exceeded the limits of the stack segment (stack segment fault).
source_translations.一般保护错误：未被其它异常覆盖的保护性违规，例如写只读段、加载非法段选择子、访问: General protection fault: a protection violation not covered by any other exception, such as writing to a read-only segment, loading an invalid segment selector, or accessing a non-canonical address.
source_translations.对一个并未映射到系统地址的 MDL 调用了 MmUnmapLockedPages: MmUnmapLockedPages was called on an MDL that is not mapped to a system address. Parameter 3 is the MDL flags, and parameter 4 is the missing MDL flag.
source_translations.工作集链表已损坏。: The working set list is corrupt.
source_translations.驱动对缺少必要标志的 MDL 调用 MmMapLockedPages（例如 MD: A driver called MmMapLockedPages on an MDL that lacks a required flag (for example, the MDL is not locked). Parameter 3 is the MDL flags, and parameter 4 is the expected but missing flag.
source_translations.通用硬件错误（不属于其它任何错误源类型，典型为 ACPI GHES 上报）。: Generic hardware error that does not belong to any other error source type, typically reported through ACPI GHES.
source_translations.判定非零 PTE 的页保护属性时发现该 PTE 已损坏。参数 2 为 PTE 指: The PTE was found to be corrupt while determining the page protection of a non-zero PTE. Parameter 2 is the PTE pointer, parameter 3 is the PTE contents, and parameter 4 is the VAD.
source_translations.同 0x0B：在已损坏的池分配上释放配额。: Same as 0x0B: quota was released on a corrupted pool allocation.
source_translations.同 0x51：驱动越界写后再释放（池跟踪）。参数 2 为分配基址，参数 3 为哈: Same as 0x51: a driver wrote past the end of an allocation and then freed it (pool tracking). Parameter 2 is the allocation base address, parameter 3 is the hash entry, and parameter 4 is the number of charged bytes.
source_translations.CastGuard 检出非法的 C++ 向下转型：static_cast 到了实: CastGuard detected an invalid C++ downcast: a static_cast was applied to an object that is not actually of that type.
source_translations.内核在非 DISPATCH_LEVEL 的 IRQL 上释放了排队自旋锁。参数: The kernel released a queued spin lock at an IRQL other than DISPATCH_LEVEL. Parameter 3 is the spin lock number, and parameter 4 is the old IRQL.
source_translations.加密库自检或内部一致性检查失败。: A cryptographic library self-test or internal consistency check failed.
