source_translations.扩展处理器控制寄存器被修改（如 XCR0）。: An extended processor control register has been modified (for example, XCR0).
source_translations.导入地址表被改写，最常见于 IAT 钩子与新式加固机制冲突。: The import address table has been rewritten; this most often occurs when IAT hooks conflict with newer hardening mechanisms.
source_translations.某个 PFN（参数 2）的链接已损坏、脱离了其顶层进程，说明 PFN 结构被越界: The links of a PFN (parameter 2) are corrupt and detached from its top-level process, indicating that the PFN structure was damaged by an out-of-bounds write.
source_translations.违反了漏洞利用防护的载荷限制策略，例如禁止加载远程映像或非微软签名的二进制；多由: An exploit protection payload restriction policy was violated, for example a policy that blocks loading remote images or binaries not signed by Microsoft. This is usually triggered by system and enterprise policy rather than by a program defect.
source_translations.PTE 中编码的工作集索引已损坏。仅出现在旧版 Windows。: The working set index encoded in the PTE is corrupt. This occurs only on older versions of Windows.
source_translations.已加载模块链表被修改（典型的隐藏驱动手法）。: The loaded module list has been modified, a common technique for hiding a driver.
source_translations.线程在 IRQL > DISPATCH_LEVEL 时等待。KeWaitForS: A thread waited at IRQL > DISPATCH_LEVEL. KeWaitForSingleObject/MultipleObjects require IRQL <= DISPATCH_LEVEL. Parameter 2 points to the IRQL value, parameter 3 points to the wait object, and parameter 4 points to the timeout value.
source_translations.以不安全的方式访问了注册表。: The registry was accessed in an unsafe manner.
source_translations.MDL、内存映射与 DMA 类检查失败；具体子类型未收录。: An MDL, memory mapping, or DMA check failed; the specific subtype is not listed here.
source_translations.驱动在 DPC 例程中计入池配额，而 DPC 中当前进程上下文是不确定的。: A driver charged pool quota inside a DPC routine, where the current process context is indeterminate.
source_translations.栈缓冲区溢出（旧式 /GS 检查）。局部数组越界写覆盖了返回地址所在区域。: Stack buffer overrun (legacy /GS check). An out-of-bounds write to a local array overwrote the area holding the return address.
source_translations.异步检测到扇区 CRC 错误（磁盘完整性检查）。参数 2 为 IRP 副本（原: A sector CRC error was detected asynchronously (disk integrity check). Parameter 2 is a copy of the IRP (the original IRP has already completed), parameter 3 is the lower device object, and parameter 4 is the number of the failing sector.
source_translations.调用方把等待模式指定为 UserMode，但等待对象位于内核栈上——栈可被换出，: The caller specified UserMode as the wait mode, but the wait object resides on the kernel stack. The stack can be paged out, which invalidates the object. Parameter 2 is the address of that object.
source_translations.非法 PDO：需要 PDO 的 API 收到了随机内存、FDO、或尚未通过 Qu: Invalid PDO: an API that requires a PDO received random memory, an FDO, or an uninitialized PDO that has not yet been reported to PnP through QueryDeviceRelations/QueryBusRelations. Parameter 2 is the purported PDO, and parameter 3 is the driver object.
source_translations.LSS 相关的未处理异常；官方头文件里的拼写本身就少一个字母，做名称比对时不要改: An unhandled LSS-related exception. The spelling in the official header is itself missing a letter, so do not correct it when comparing names.
source_translations.驱动在非 DISPATCH_LEVEL 的 IRQL 上调用 KeRelease: A driver called KeReleaseSpinLock at an IRQL other than DISPATCH_LEVEL, commonly because the spin lock was released twice. Parameter 2 is the current IRQL, and parameter 3 is the spin lock address.
source_translations.在 DllMain 内部发起了非法调用。: An illegal call was made from within DllMain.
source_translations.访问低完整性标签的对象被拒；头文件标注为遥测且不致命。: Access to an object with a low integrity label was denied. The header marks this as telemetry and non-fatal.
source_translations.驱动卸载时没有注销其 WMI 回调函数。参数 2 为驱动起始地址，参数 3 为回: A driver unloaded without deregistering its WMI callback. Parameter 2 is the driver start address, and parameter 3 is the callback address.
source_translations.保留值，官方未定义具体含义。: Reserved value; no specific meaning is officially defined.
source_translations.【非微软 0x7F 表，取自 Intel SDM 架构向量 2】不可屏蔽中断。W: [Not part of the Microsoft 0x7F table; taken from Intel SDM architectural vector 2] Non-maskable interrupt. On Windows an NMI is normally reported as bug check 0x80 NMI_HARDWARE_FAILURE, so seeing it under 0x7F is an unusual path.
source_translations.RTL_BALANCED_NODE 红黑树节点损坏，与 LIST_ENTRY 损: RTL_BALANCED_NODE red-black tree node corruption. Same class as LIST_ENTRY corruption, usually a use-after-free or an unsynchronized concurrent modification.
source_translations.低权限应用容器下访问被拒；头文件标注为遥测且不致命。: Access denied under a low-privilege AppContainer. The header marks this as telemetry and non-fatal.
source_translations.调用 RtlQueryRegistryValues 时指定了 RTL_QUERY: RtlQueryRegistryValues was called with RTL_QUERY_REGISTRY_DIRECT but without RTL_QUERY_REGISTRY_TYPECHECK, and the target value does not reside in a trusted system hive. This is the classic defect that tampered registry data can exploit.
source_translations.检测到越界的缓冲区访问。: An out-of-bounds buffer access was detected.
source_translations.LIST_ENTRY 双向链表自洽性检查失败：多为链表节点被越界写，或节点已释放: LIST_ENTRY doubly linked list consistency check failed. Usually a list node was overwritten out of bounds, or a node was freed while still linked.
source_translations.执行了协处理器指令但协处理器不可用（设备不可用/FPU 上下文切换异常）。注：官: A coprocessor instruction was executed while the coprocessor was not available (device not available / FPU context switch fault). Note: the official page prints this as NXP_NOT_AVAILABLE, which is a typo.
source_translations.模块填充区被修改（常被用来藏 shellcode）。: Module padding was modified (a common hiding place for shellcode).
source_translations.中断服务例程返回时改变了 IRQL。参数 2 为 ISR 地址，参数 3/4 为: An interrupt service routine returned at a changed IRQL. Parameter 2 is the ISR address; parameters 3/4 are the IRQL before and after execution.
source_translations.驱动在用户模式下以 IRQL > APC_LEVEL 调用 MmMapLocke: A driver called MmMapLockedPages for user mode at IRQL > APC_LEVEL. Parameter 3 is the MDL address; parameter 4 is the access mode.
source_translations.页表页损坏：参数 2 为最后处理的 PTE，参数 3 为实际非零 PTE 数，参: Page table page corruption. Parameter 2 is the last PTE processed; parameter 3 is the actual number of non-zero PTEs; parameter 4 is the expected number of non-zero PTEs. Deprecated after Windows 10 1803.
source_translations.驱动试图删除一个未初始化的 lookaside 链表。参数 2 为该链表地址。: A driver attempted to delete an uninitialized lookaside list. Parameter 2 is the address of the list.
source_translations.PDO 在仍挂在 devnode 树上时被释放：其对象管理器引用计数降到 0。通: A PDO was freed while still attached to the devnode tree: its object manager reference count dropped to 0. Typically a driver returned the PDO from a query IRP without taking a reference on it. Parameter 2 is the PDO.
source_translations.驱动用了操作系统不支持的方式切换内核栈。扩展内核栈的唯一受支持方式是 KeExp: A driver switched kernel stacks in a way the operating system does not support. The only supported way to extend the kernel stack is KeExpandKernelStackAndCallout.
source_translations.驱动在中断被禁用后调用了 Fast I/O 分发例程。: A driver called a Fast I/O dispatch routine with interrupts disabled.
source_translations.通用数据区（与 0x0 同名，非笔误，官方表两处都是该描述）。: Generic data area (same name as 0x0; not a typo, the official table uses this description in both entries).
source_translations.释放池时给出了非法地址。参数 2 为被判定的虚拟地址，参数 3 为区域大小。: An invalid address was passed to a pool free. Parameter 2 is the virtual address that was checked; parameter 3 is the region size.
source_translations.控制流防护的间接调用命中了被抑制的导出目标；头文件标注为遥测且不致命，只上报不终: A Control Flow Guard indirect call reached a suppressed export target. The header marks this as telemetry and non-fatal: it is reported without terminating the process and is rarely the root cause of a crash.
source_translations.驱动在 IRQL > APC_LEVEL 时获取快速互斥体。参数 2 为当前 I: A driver acquired a fast mutex at IRQL > APC_LEVEL. Parameter 2 is the current IRQL; parameter 3 is the fast mutex address.
source_translations.驱动在 IRQL > APC_LEVEL 时调用 KeEnterCritical: A driver called KeEnterCriticalRegion at IRQL > APC_LEVEL. Parameter 2 is the current IRQL.
source_translations.池 tag 中不含任何字母或数字，导致池问题无法追踪。参数 2 为该错误 tag: The pool tag contains no letters or digits, which makes pool problems impossible to track. Parameter 2 is the offending tag; parameter 3 is the pool type; parameter 4 is the caller address.
source_translations.执行 BOUND 指令时发现操作数超出指定范围（BOUND 用于确保带符号数组索: A BOUND instruction found its operand outside the specified range (BOUND verifies that a signed array index falls within bounds).
source_translations.驱动对页面来自非分页池的 MDL 调用 MmUnlockPages——这类页面本: A driver called MmUnlockPages on an MDL whose pages come from nonpaged pool; such pages must never be unlocked. Parameter 2 is the MDL address; parameter 3 is the MDL flags.
source_translations.关键 MSR 被修改（如 LSTAR/SYSENTER，典型的系统调用挂钩）。: A critical MSR was modified (for example LSTAR/SYSENTER, the classic system call hook).
source_translations.驱动在 IRQL > DISPATCH_LEVEL 时调用 MmAllocate: A driver called MmAllocatePagesForMdl(Ex) or MmFreePagesFromMdl at IRQL > DISPATCH_LEVEL. Parameter 2 is the current IRQL; parameter 3 is DISPATCH_LEVEL.
source_translations.内核在非 DISPATCH_LEVEL 的 IRQL 上释放了自旋锁。参数 3: The kernel released a spin lock at an IRQL other than DISPATCH_LEVEL. Parameter 3 is the spin lock address; parameter 4 is the old IRQL.
source_translations.驱动以用户态地址为参数调用了内核模式的 ZwXxx 例程。参数 2 为调用点，参: A driver called a kernel-mode ZwXxx routine with a user-mode address as a parameter. Parameter 2 is the call site; parameter 3 is the user-mode address.
source_translations.同 0x51：驱动越界写后再释放（池跟踪）。参数 2 为分配基址，参数 3 为池: Same as 0x51: a driver wrote past the end of an allocation and then freed it (pool tracking). Parameter 2 is the allocation base address; parameter 3 is the pool header.
source_translations.分配请求被标记为 MUST_SUCCEED，而该池类型早已不再受支持。参数 2: The allocation request was marked MUST_SUCCEED, a pool type that has long been unsupported. Parameter 2 is the pool type; parameter 3 is the number of bytes requested; parameter 4 is the pool tag.
source_translations.同步对象位于会话地址空间中。会话空间里的对象可能被其它会话或无会话空间的系统线程: The synchronization object resides in session address space. Objects in session space can be operated on by another session or by system threads that have no session space, so they are not permitted. Parameter 2 is the object address.
source_translations.代码完整性问题：映像中存在同时可写又可执行的节。参数 2 为映像文件名，参数 3: Code integrity violation: the image contains a section that is both writable and executable. Parameter 2 is the image file name; parameter 3 is the section header address; parameter 4 is the section name.
source_translations.控制流防护写检查失败：受保护的只读数据被写入。: Control Flow Guard write check failure: protected read-only data was written.
source_translations.构建 MDL 期间该虚拟地址被异步解除映射。参数 2 为 MDL，参数 3 为: The virtual address was unmapped asynchronously while the MDL was being built. Parameter 2 is the MDL; parameter 3 is the PTE pointer. Seen only on older versions of Windows.
source_translations.驱动在 IRQL > APC_LEVEL 时释放分页池。参数 2 为当前 IRQ: A driver freed paged pool at IRQL > APC_LEVEL. Parameter 2 is the current IRQL, parameter 3 is the pool type, and parameter 4 is the pool address.
source_translations.驱动对标志不正确的 MDL 调用 MmMapLockedPages，例如该 MD: A driver called MmMapLockedPages on an MDL with incorrect flags, for example an MDL that is already mapped to a system address or that was never locked. Parameter 3 is the MDL flags, and parameter 4 is the offending flag bits.
source_translations.驱动用无效句柄调用了 ObReferenceObjectByHandle。参数: A driver called ObReferenceObjectByHandle with an invalid handle. Parameter 2 is the handle that was passed in, and parameter 3 is the object type.
source_translations.同 0x01：池头已被破坏。参数 2 指向池头，参数 3 为池头内容。: Same as 0x01: the pool header is corrupted. Parameter 2 points to the pool header, and parameter 3 is the pool header contents.
source_translations.对 ntdll 的补丁应用失败。: Failed to apply a patch to ntdll.
source_translations.以 tag 为 “BIG” 分配池，与内核内部保留 tag 冲突。参数 2 为池: A pool allocation used the tag "BIG", which collides with a tag reserved for kernel internal use. Parameter 2 is the pool type, parameter 3 is the number of bytes requested, and parameter 4 is the caller address.
source_translations./GS 栈 cookie 与函数入口保存的值不符——货真价实的栈缓冲区溢出；查崩: The /GS stack cookie does not match the value saved on function entry - a genuine stack buffer overrun. Inspect the local arrays and the memcpy/strcpy calls in the faulting function to pin it down.
source_translations.驱动调用 MmMapLockedPagesSpecifyCache 时把 Bug: A driver called MmMapLockedPagesSpecifyCache with BugCheckOnFailure set to TRUE. It should be set to FALSE so that the driver handles the failure itself. Parameter 2 is the MDL address, and parameter 3 is the MDL flags.
source_translations.持有工作集同步锁期间发生了非法缺页。参数 2 为被引用的虚拟地址。典型原因是在持: An illegal page fault occurred while the working set synchronization lock was held. Parameter 2 is the virtual address that was referenced. The typical cause is touching pageable memory while holding a lock or running at elevated IRQL.
source_translations.驱动在 IRQL < DISPATCH_LEVEL 时调用 KeAcquireS: A driver called KeAcquireSpinLockAtDpcLevel at IRQL < DISPATCH_LEVEL. Parameter 2 is the current IRQL, and parameter 3 is the spin lock address.
source_translations.驱动请求了 0 字节的池分配。参数 2 为当前 IRQL，参数 3 为池类型，参: A driver requested a zero-byte pool allocation. Parameter 2 is the current IRQL, parameter 3 is the pool type, and parameter 4 is the byte count.
source_translations.驱动卸载前没有调用 EtwUnregister。参数 2 为 EtwRegist: A driver failed to call EtwUnregister before unloading. Parameter 2 is the EtwRegister call site, parameter 3 is the start address of the driver being unloaded, and on Windows 8 and later parameter 4 is the ETW RegHandle.
source_translations.通知回调行为不正确：驱动在处理 PnP 通知时没能保持 IRQL 或 APC 禁: Incorrect notification callback behavior: a driver failed to preserve the IRQL or the APC disable count while handling a PnP notification. Parameter 2 is the driver object, parameter 3 is the IRQL after the callback returned, and parameter 4 is the APC disable count after it returned.
source_translations.【非微软 0x7F 表，取自 Intel SDM 架构向量 18】机器检查异常，: [Not from the Microsoft 0x7F table; taken from Intel SDM architectural vector 18] Machine check exception, a hardware-level error reported by the CPU. Modern Windows normally surfaces this as 0x124 WHEA_UNCORRECTABLE_ERROR.
source_translations.非法 ID：枚举器返回的 ID 含非法字符或未正确以空字符结尾（ID 只能用 0: Invalid ID: the enumerator returned an ID that contains illegal characters or is not properly null-terminated (IDs may use only characters in the ranges 0x20-0x2B and 0x2D-0x7F). Parameter 2 is the PDO that was queried for the ID, parameter 3 is the ID buffer, and parameter 4 indicates the ID kind (1 = DeviceID, 2 = UniqueID, 3 = HardwareIDs, 4 = CompatibleIDs).
source_translations.解除先前 secure 的内存时出错，常见于在错误的进程上下文中调用 MmUns: An error occurred while unsecuring previously secured memory, commonly because MmUnsecureVirtualMemory was called in the wrong process context.
source_translations.死锁：检测到锁层次违规（死锁检测选项）。参数 2 为最终引发死锁的资源地址，可用: Deadlock: a lock hierarchy violation was detected (deadlock detection option). Parameter 2 is the address of the resource that finally caused the deadlock; use !deadlock for details.
source_translations.类型 1 进程链表损坏（常见于隐藏进程的 Rootkit）。: Type 1 process list corruption (commonly caused by rootkits that hide processes).
source_translations.内核 CET 影子栈辅助路径失败，属于内核侧检查。: The kernel CET shadow stack assist path failed; this is a kernel-side check.
source_translations.NativeAOT 形态的 .NET 运行时抛出异常后走 fastfail 终止: A NativeAOT-flavored .NET runtime raised an exception and then terminated through fastfail.
source_translations.总线关系中出现 NULL PDO：总线上有一个或多个设备返回了空 PDO。参数: NULL PDO in bus relations: one or more devices on the bus returned a NULL PDO. Parameter 2 is the PDO of the device stack that returned the invalid bus relations, parameter 3 is the total number of PDOs returned, and parameter 4 is the zero-based index of the first NULL PDO.
source_translations.同 0x780：映射系统缓存视图的 PTE 已损坏。仅出现在旧版 Windows: Same as 0x780: the PTE mapping the system cache view is corrupted. Seen only on older versions of Windows.
source_translations.控制栈（影子栈）内容非法。: The contents of the control stack (shadow stack) are invalid.
source_translations.试图切换到非法的纤程上下文。: An attempt was made to switch to an invalid fiber context.
source_translations.IRP 完成例程改变了线程的 APC 禁用计数，即临界区进出未配对。参数 2 为: An IRP completion routine changed the thread's APC disable count, meaning critical region entry and exit were not paired. Parameter 2 is the completion routine address, and parameters 3 and 4 are the counts after and before the call.
source_translations.写防护检查检测到非法的内存写入。: A write guard check detected an invalid memory write.
source_translations.驱动在 APC 未禁用时获取 pushlock。参数 2 为当前 IRQL，参数: A driver acquired a pushlock without APCs disabled. Parameter 2 is the current IRQL, parameter 3 is the APC disable count, and parameter 4 is the pushlock address.
source_translations.加载配置目录被修改（含 CFG 相关数据）。: The load configuration directory was modified (this includes the CFG-related data).
source_translations.驱动卸载时仍有未释放的池分配。参数 2 为驱动名，参数 4 为未释放分配总数（含: A driver unloaded while it still had unfreed pool allocations. Parameter 2 is the driver name, and parameter 4 is the total number of unfreed allocations (paged plus nonpaged). Run !verifier 3 drivername.sys to list the leak sites.
source_translations.锁状态非法：未持有就释放、重复释放，或锁对象内存被覆盖。: Invalid lock state: the lock was released without being held, released twice, or the lock object memory was overwritten.
source_translations.映射该系统缓存视图的 PTE 已损坏（文档按 0x780-0x781 区间给出）: The PTE mapping this system cache view is corrupted (documented as the range 0x780-0x781). Seen only on older versions of Windows.
source_translations.在加载器锁持有期间（DllMain 等回调里）调用了被禁止的接口，属于死锁高危行: A forbidden interface was called while the loader lock was held (inside DllMain or similar callbacks), which carries a high risk of deadlock.
source_translations.同 0x8886：待机链表页面优先级不一致，差异值在参数 4。: Same as 0x8886: standby list page priority mismatch; the difference is in parameter 4.
source_translations.资源释放顺序不正确（死锁检测选项）。参数 2 为被释放的资源，参数 3 为本应先: Resources were released out of order (deadlock detection option). Parameter 2 is the resource that was released, and parameter 3 is the resource that should have been released first.
source_translations.处理器中断描述符表（IDT）被修改。: The processor Interrupt Descriptor Table (IDT) was modified.
source_translations.资源在获取之前就被释放（死锁检测选项）。参数 2 为资源地址。: A resource was released before it was acquired (deadlock detection option). Parameter 2 is the resource address.
source_translations.设备对象阻塞 IRP 时间过长（最常见的一种）。参数 2 为设备栈的 PDO，参: A device object blocked an IRP for too long (the most common case). Parameter 2 is the PDO of the device stack, parameter 3 can be cast to nt!_TRIAGE_9F_POWER, and parameter 4 is the blocked IRP. Run !irp on parameter 4 and !devstack on parameter 2 to locate the stalled driver.
source_translations.函数体被修改（内核函数被内联挂钩）。: A function body was modified (a kernel function was inline-hooked).
source_translations.线程在 DISPATCH_LEVEL 上等待且 Timeout 非 0。Time: A thread waited at DISPATCH_LEVEL with a non-zero Timeout. A Timeout != 0 requires IRQL <= APC_LEVEL. Parameter 2 points to the IRQL value, parameter 3 points to the wait object, and parameter 4 points to the timeout value.
source_translations.驱动调用了 MmMapLockedPages；应改用 MmMapLockedPa: The driver called MmMapLockedPages; it should call MmMapLockedPagesSpecifyCache instead, with BugCheckOnFailure set to FALSE. Parameter 2 is the MDL address and parameter 3 is the MDL flags.
source_translations.释放了一个未分配的非分页池地址。参数 2 为起始地址，参数 3 为物理页帧号，参: A nonpaged pool address that was never allocated was freed. Parameter 2 is the start address, parameter 3 is the physical page frame number, and parameter 4 is the highest physical page frame number on the system.
source_translations.解除 I/O 空间物理页映射时，对一个当前未被引用的项做了解引用。参数 2、参数: While unmapping physical pages of I/O space, an entry that is not currently referenced was dereferenced. Parameter 2 and parameter 3 describe the range the caller asked to unmap, and parameter 4 is the I/O physical page that should have been referenced but was not.
source_translations.会话函数或其 .pdata 被修改。: A session function or its .pdata was modified.
source_translations.对齐检查异常：在启用对齐检查时访问了未对齐的数据。: Alignment check exception: unaligned data was accessed while alignment checking was enabled.
source_translations.驱动在内核模式下以 IRQL > DISPATCH_LEVEL 调用 MmMap: The driver called MmMapLockedPagesSpecifyCache in kernel mode at IRQL > DISPATCH_LEVEL. Parameter 3 is the MDL address.
source_translations.一个页表页被破坏。64 位下参数 2 为该页表页 PFN 的地址；32 位下参数: A page table page was corrupted. On 64-bit, parameter 2 is the address of the PFN for that page table page; on 32-bit, parameter 2 points to the count of used PTEs and parameter 3 is that count.
source_translations.写操作时目标虚拟地址被错误地标记为写时复制。参数 2 为出错地址，参数 3 为: On a write operation, the target virtual address was incorrectly marked copy-on-write. Parameter 2 is the faulting address, parameter 3 is the PTE contents, and parameter 4 indicates the virtual address space type.
source_translations.待机链表上两个本应优先级相同的页面优先级不一致（文档按 0x8884-0x888: Two pages on the standby list that should have equal priority have mismatched priorities (documented under the 0x8884-0x8885 range, in the legacy parameter table). The difference is recorded in parameter 4.
source_translations.池分配 / 释放与 IRQL 类检查失败；具体子类型未收录。: A pool allocation/free or IRQL class check failed; the specific subtype is not listed.
source_translations.以 tag = 0 分配池：无法追踪，且可能破坏现有 tag 表。参数 2 为池: Pool was allocated with tag = 0: such allocations cannot be tracked and may corrupt the existing tag table. Parameter 2 is the pool type, parameter 3 is the number of bytes requested, and parameter 4 is the caller address.
source_translations.驱动给 KeLowerIrql 传了非法参数（高于当前 IRQL 或高于 HIG: The driver passed an invalid parameter to KeLowerIrql (higher than the current IRQL, or above HIGH_LEVEL). Parameter 2 is the current IRQL and parameter 3 is the requested IRQL; parameter 4 is 0 if the new IRQL is invalid, or 1 if the IRQL is invalid within a DPC routine.
source_translations.一个 PTE 已被破坏，参数 2 是该 PTE 的地址。常见于驱动野指针写入、D: A PTE has been corrupted; parameter 2 is the address of that PTE. Typical causes are stray driver pointer writes and DMA transfers landing on the wrong physical page.
source_translations.IRP 完成分发器被修改。: The IRP completion dispatcher was modified.
source_translations.驱动正在卸载，其线程却仍在分配池内存。参数含义同 0x60。: The driver is unloading while one of its threads is still allocating pool memory. The parameters have the same meaning as for 0x60.
source_translations.从内核模式调用 ZwNotifyChangeKey 时使用了不受支持的 ApcC: ZwNotifyChangeKey was called from kernel mode with an unsupported ApcContext. Parameter 2 is the call site and parameter 3 is the ApcContext that was passed in.
source_translations.驱动在 IRQL > DISPATCH_LEVEL 时调用 MmProbeAnd: The driver called MmProbeAndLockProcessPages at IRQL > DISPATCH_LEVEL. Parameter 3 is the MDL address and parameter 4 is the process address.
source_translations.驱动向 ObReferenceObjectByHandle 传了 NULL 句柄: The driver passed a NULL handle to ObReferenceObjectByHandle. Parameter 2 is the address of that NULL handle and parameter 3 is the object type.
source_translations.调用方申请超过一页的 must-succeed 池，而该 API 最多允许一页。: The caller requested more than one page of must-succeed pool, but the API allows at most one page.
source_translations.在非法 IRQL 上分配池。参数 2 为当前 IRQL，参数 3 为池类型，参数: Pool was allocated at an illegal IRQL. Parameter 2 is the current IRQL, parameter 3 is the pool type, and parameter 4 is the number of bytes allocated. Paged pool requires IRQL <= APC_LEVEL; nonpaged pool requires IRQL <= DISPATCH_LEVEL.
source_translations.被取消的 IRP 未在预期时间内完成——驱动完成取消 IRP 太慢。参数 2 为: A cancelled IRP did not complete within the expected time: the driver is too slow to complete the cancelled IRP. Parameter 2 is the IRP address and parameter 3 is the number of milliseconds allowed since IoCancelIrp.
source_translations.内存管理器内部结构损坏，且很可能就是 PTE 或 PFN 本身被写坏。: An internal memory manager structure is corrupted, and most likely a PTE or PFN itself was overwritten.
source_translations.工作项位于会话地址空间中，禁止如此。参数 2 为工作项地址。: The work item resides in session address space, which is not allowed. Parameter 2 is the work item address.
source_translations.映像重定位修正表或代码流已损坏。微软明确指出这多半是硬件错误，优先跑内存诊断、检: The image relocation fixup table or the code stream is corrupted. Microsoft states this is usually a hardware error: run memory diagnostics first, and check overclocking and memory timings.
source_translations.调试器断点（INT 3）。常见于代码里残留的 DbgBreakPoint，或未连: Debugger breakpoint (INT 3). Typically a leftover DbgBreakPoint in the code, or a breakpoint instruction executed while no debugger is attached.
source_translations.在一块已损坏的池分配上释放配额。参数 2 为池地址，参数 3 为分配 tag，参: Quota was released on a corrupted pool allocation. Parameter 2 is the pool address, parameter 3 is the allocation tag, and parameter 4 is the bad quota process pointer.
source_translations.非法的文件操作；头文件标注为遥测且不致命。: Illegal file operation; the header marks this as telemetry and non-fatal.
source_translations.已删除的 PDO 被当作关系上报：被移除设备的某个移除关系已经被删除。参数 2: A deleted PDO was reported as a relation: one of the removal relations of the device being removed has already been deleted. Parameter 2 is the PDO involved and parameter 3 is the removal relation.
source_translations.分页层次结构（页表树）已损坏。参数 2 指向引发缺页的虚拟地址。多为越界写或硬件: The paging hierarchy (page table tree) is corrupted. Parameter 2 points to the virtual address that caused the page fault. Usually an out-of-bounds write or a hardware fault damaged the page tables.
source_translations.longjmp 的 jmp_buf 内容非法或已被破坏，含 setjmp 帧返回: The jmp_buf passed to longjmp is invalid or has been corrupted, including the case where longjmp is issued after the setjmp frame has already returned.
source_translations.系统服务函数被修改（SSDT 挂钩）。: A system service function has been modified (SSDT hook).
source_translations.驱动向系统进程用户空间中一个未分配的地址写入。参数 2 为写入地址。典型是驱动在: A driver wrote to an unallocated address in the user-mode space of a system process. Parameter 2 is the address written to. This typically means the driver used a user-mode pointer while in the wrong process context.
source_translations.驱动试图向 Idle 进程计入池配额。: A driver attempted to charge pool quota to the Idle process.
source_translations.驱动在内核模式下以 IRQL > DISPATCH_LEVEL 调用 MmMap: A driver called MmMapLockedPages for kernel mode at IRQL > DISPATCH_LEVEL. Parameter 3 is the MDL address. Parameter 4 is the access mode.
source_translations.倒排函数表被修改（异常展开表挂钩）。: The inverted function table has been modified (exception unwind table hook).
source_translations.EH_MAGIC_NUMBER1：MSVC C++ 抛出对象的标准异常记录: EH_MAGIC_NUMBER1: the standard exception record for an MSVC C++ thrown object
source_translations.栈 cookie 检查检测到栈缓冲区溢出（/GS 违规）。函数内的局部缓冲区被写: The stack cookie check detected a stack buffer overrun (/GS violation). A local buffer in the function was written past its bounds.
source_translations.机器检查异常（MCE）。参数 3/4 为出错 MCA bank 的 MCi_ST: Machine check exception (MCE). Parameters 3 and 4 are the high and low 32 bits of the MCi_STATUS MSR of the failing MCA bank. The vast majority of 0x124 bug checks fall into this class: a fault in the CPU, memory, or motherboard power delivery, with overclocking and inadequate cooling being common triggers.
source_translations.PTE 或工作集链表已损坏。仅出现在旧版 Windows；排查按「驱动越界写」与: A PTE or the working set list is corrupted. Seen only on older Windows versions. Investigate two lines in parallel: an out-of-bounds driver write, and faulty memory hardware.
source_translations.处理前一个异常的过程中又发生了异常。两大常见原因：一是内核栈溢出（撞到保护页后连: An exception occurred while a previous exception was being handled. There are two common causes. First, kernel stack overflow: once the guard page is hit there is no room left even to push a trap frame, which usually means several filter drivers are stacked on the same stack, or a routine is recursing. Second, faulty hardware. Use !thread to inspect the stack limits, then kb 100 to dump the full stack.
source_translations.以错误的用户空间地址调用了 MmUnmapLockedPages。参数 2 为被: MmUnmapLockedPages was called with an incorrect user-mode address. Parameter 2 is the address being unmapped. Parameter 3 is the MDL address.
source_translations.调用了已废弃的系统服务。: An obsolete system service was called.
source_translations.设备未能成功完成其定向电源切换回调。参数 2 为 POP_FX_DEVICE 对: A device failed to complete its directed power transition callback. Parameter 2 is the POP_FX_DEVICE object. Parameter 3 is 1 for a directed power-down and 0 for a directed power-up.
source_translations.设备对象完成了系统电源状态请求的 IRP，却没有调用 PoStartNextPo: A device object completed the IRP for a system power state request without calling PoStartNextPowerIrp. Parameter 3 is the target device object. Parameter 4 is the device object.
source_translations.基于 SCI 的 GHESv2（ACPI 通用硬件错误源）。: SCI-based GHESv2 (ACPI Generic Hardware Error Source).
source_translations.同 0x51：驱动越界写后再释放（池跟踪）。参数 2 为分配基址，参数 4 为池: Same as 0x51: a driver wrote past the end of its allocation and then freed it (pool tracking). Parameter 2 is the base address of the allocation. Parameter 4 is the size of the pool hash table.
source_translations.只读可变数据段（.mrdata）在受保护期间被修改，常见于试图改写导入表或回调表: The read-only mutable data section (.mrdata) was modified while it was protected, commonly by an attempt to rewrite an import table or a callback table.
source_translations.异常分发上下文非法，通常伴随栈或展开数据损坏。: The exception dispatch context is invalid, usually accompanied by corrupted stack or unwind data.
source_translations.驱动在 IRQL > APC_LEVEL 时分配分页内存。参数 2 为当前 IR: A driver allocated pageable memory at IRQL > APC_LEVEL. Parameter 2 is the current IRQL. Parameter 3 is the pool type. Parameter 4 is the size of the allocation in bytes.
source_translations.检测到损坏的 PTE。参数 2 为该 PTE 的地址，参数 3 与参数 4 分别: A corrupted PTE was detected. Parameter 2 is the address of the PTE. Parameter 3 and parameter 4 are the low and high parts of the PTE respectively. This is usually caused by a stray driver write or by faulty memory hardware.
source_translations.内核 Zw API 未在 IRQL = PASSIVE_LEVEL 且启用特殊内: A kernel Zw API was called without IRQL = PASSIVE_LEVEL and special kernel APCs enabled. Parameter 2 is the call site. Parameter 3 is the current IRQL. Parameter 4 is the special kernel APC state.
source_translations.驱动在卸载前没有释放全部池分配（池泄漏）。参数 2/3 为分页与非分页已分配字节: A driver did not free all of its pool allocations before unloading (pool leak). Parameters 2 and 3 are the paged and nonpaged bytes still allocated. Parameter 4 is the number of allocations that were not freed.
source_translations.IRP 释放器被修改。: The IRP deallocator has been modified.
source_translations.内存压缩存储（store）的私有内存区损坏而不可访问。参数 2 为返回状态，参数: The private memory region of the memory compression store is corrupted and inaccessible. Parameter 2 is the returned status. Parameter 3 is a virtual address inside that private region. Parameter 4 is the MDL.
source_translations.系统用掉了最后一个系统缓存视图地址而未予保留。仅出现在旧版 Windows。: The system consumed the last system cache view address without reserving it. Seen only on older Windows versions.
source_translations.处理器全局描述符表（GDT）被修改。: The processor GDT (global descriptor table) has been modified.
source_translations.线程释放了一块已经被释放的池内存。参数 3 指向池头，参数 4 为池头内容。典型: A thread freed a block of pool memory that had already been freed. Parameter 3 points to the pool header. Parameter 4 is the contents of the pool header. This typically comes from mismanaged reference counts or from duplicate cleanup on an error path.
source_translations.驱动在用户模式下以 IRQL > APC_LEVEL 调用 MmUnmapLoc: A driver called MmUnmapLockedPages for user mode at IRQL > APC_LEVEL. Parameter 3 is the virtual address being unmapped. Parameter 4 is the MDL address.
source_translations.系统调用号非法，常见于绕过 ntdll 的直接系统调用在新版本上号变了，或 nt: Invalid system call number. This commonly comes from direct syscalls that bypass ntdll and whose numbers changed on a newer build, or from an ntdll that has been hooked or tampered with. The header marks this code as telemetry and non-fatal.
source_translations.驱动用与该锁类型不匹配的 API 获取锁。参数 2 为锁地址。: A driver acquired a lock using an API that does not match the lock type. Parameter 2 is the address of the lock.
source_translations.驱动在用户模式下以 IRQL > APC_LEVEL 调用 MmMapLocke: A driver called MmMapLockedPagesSpecifyCache for user mode at IRQL > APC_LEVEL. Parameter 3 is the MDL address.
source_translations.驱动 Fast I/O 分发例程改变了线程的 APC 禁用计数，同样是临界区进出: A driver Fast I/O dispatch routine changed the thread's APC disable count, again an unbalanced entry into and exit from a critical region. Parameter 2 is the address of the routine. Parameters 3 and 4 are the counts after and before the call.
source_translations.正在创建的 MDL 有缺陷，几乎必然是调用 MmProbeAndLockPage: The MDL being built is defective. This is almost always a bug in the driver that called MmProbeAndLockPages: typically the MDL is built for write access while a paging read is being serviced. Seen only on older Windows versions.
source_translations.要移除或截断的物理内存范围仍被加载器占用，无法安全移除。参数 2 为 Highe: The physical memory range to be removed or truncated is still in use by the loader and cannot be removed safely. Parameter 2 is HighestPhysicalPage.
source_translations.本地 APIC 被修改。: The local APIC has been modified.
source_translations.同 0x8888：内存管理器内部结构损坏。: Same as 0x8888: memory manager internal structures are corrupted.
source_translations.在不正确的 IRQL 上调用了内核 API。参数 2 为当前 IRQL。: A kernel API was called at an incorrect IRQL. Parameter 2 is the current IRQL.
source_translations.单个 DPC 或 ISR 超出了时间配额。参数 2 为实际 DPC 时间（tic: A single DPC or ISR exceeded its time allotment. Parameter 2 is the actual DPC time in ticks, parameter 3 is the allotted time in ticks, and parameter 4 can be cast to nt!DPC_WATCHDOG_GLOBAL_TRIAGE_BLOCK. The offending component is usually visible directly in the call stack; a DPC should stay under 100us and an ISR under 25us.
source_translations.试图设置非法的寄存器上下文。: An attempt was made to set an illegal register context.
source_translations.MDL 描述的页面仍处于映射状态；驱动必须先解除映射再调用 IoFreeMdl。: The pages described by the MDL are still mapped; the driver must unmap them before calling IoFreeMdl. Parameter 2 is the MDL address, and parameter 3 is the MDL flags.
source_translations.驱动在系统进程上下文中对内核句柄发起用户态引用。参数 2 为句柄，参数 3 为对: A driver issued a user-mode reference to a kernel handle while in the context of a system process. Parameter 2 is the handle, parameter 3 is the object type, and parameter 4 is the AccessMode.
source_translations.当前栈指针不在预期的线程栈范围内，常见于栈被切换、栈帧被破坏或展开信息不一致。: The current stack pointer lies outside the expected thread stack range, typically because the stack was switched, a stack frame was corrupted, or unwind information is inconsistent.
source_translations.内存管理器内部结构损坏（文档按 0x8888-0x8889 区间给出）。属于兜底: Memory manager internal structures are corrupted (documented as the 0x8888-0x8889 range). This is a catch-all subcode; use Driver Verifier special pool to locate the out-of-bounds write.
source_translations.线程释放了一块已经被释放的池内存。参数 3 为池头内容，参数 4 为被释放块的地: A thread freed a block of pool memory that had already been freed. Parameter 3 is the pool header contents, and parameter 4 is the address of the freed block.
source_translations.驱动在 APC 未禁用时释放 pushlock。参数 2 为当前 IRQL，参数: A driver released a pushlock while APCs were not disabled. Parameter 2 is the current IRQL, parameter 3 is the APC disable count, and parameter 4 is the pushlock address.
source_translations.通用会话数据区被修改。: The generic session data area has been modified.
source_translations.同 0x13：驱动释放了一块已经被释放的池内存。: Same as 0x13: a driver freed a block of pool memory that had already been freed.
source_translations.驱动显式要求 4GB 以下的物理内存。参数 2 为请求的最高物理地址，参数 3: The driver explicitly requested physical memory below 4GB. Parameter 2 is the requested highest physical address, and parameter 3 is the number of bytes.
source_translations.驱动在非 APC_LEVEL 的 IRQL 上释放快速互斥体。参数 3 为线程: A driver released a fast mutex at an IRQL other than APC_LEVEL. Parameter 3 is the thread APC disable count, and parameter 4 is the mutex address.
source_translations.调用了超出范围的 switch 跳转表项。: A switch jump table entry outside the valid range was invoked.
source_translations.Ps Win32 callout 被修改。: A Ps Win32 callout has been modified.
source_translations.检测到非法的异常链（SEH 链被破坏）。: An invalid exception chain was detected (the SEH chain is corrupted).
source_translations.ExFreePool 时 Driver Verifier 发现内部池跟踪值有误。: During ExFreePool, Driver Verifier found an incorrect internal pool tracking value. Parameter 2 is the address of the pool block being freed, parameter 3 is the incorrect value, and parameter 4 is the address of that value.
source_translations.【非微软 0x7F 表，取自 Intel SDM 架构向量 19】SIMD 浮点: [Not from the Microsoft 0x7F table; taken from Intel SDM architectural vector 19] SIMD floating-point exception (SSE/AVX).
source_translations.驱动解锁了一个当前并未锁定的系统缓存地址（从未映射或被解锁两次）。仅出现在旧版: A driver unlocked a system cache address that was not currently locked (either never mapped, or unlocked twice). Seen only on older versions of Windows.
source_translations.保护延迟加载导入项时遇到不可恢复的失败。: An unrecoverable failure occurred while protecting delay-load import entries.
source_translations.处理器控制寄存器被修改（如 CR0/CR4 的 WP、SMEP 位被清）。: A processor control register was modified (for example, the WP or SMEP bit in CR0/CR4 was cleared).
source_translations.AddressSanitizer 检出错误后走 fastfail 终止；真正的越: AddressSanitizer detected an error and terminated through fastfail; the actual out-of-bounds or use-after-free details appear in the ASan report itself, not in the exception parameters.
source_translations.系统调试器调用/单步调试异常。: System debugger call or single-step debug exception.
source_translations.对象的引用计数非法（如已归零后又被解引用）。: The reference count of an object is invalid (for example, the object was dereferenced after the count had already reached zero).
source_translations.虚拟化或隔离场景下内存对宿主的可见性发生了非预期变化。: In a virtualization or isolation scenario, the visibility of memory to the host changed unexpectedly.
source_translations.ETW 相关结构被破坏，常见于试图修改 ETW 以躲避监控的代码。: ETW-related structures are corrupted, commonly caused by code that modifies ETW to evade monitoring.
source_translations.一个 PDE 被意外置为无效。仅出现在旧版 Windows。: A PDE was unexpectedly marked invalid. Seen only on older versions of Windows.
source_translations.EH_MAGIC_NUMBER2：编译期声明了异常规格列表（FuncInfo::: EH_MAGIC_NUMBER2: an exception specification list was declared at compile time (FuncInfo::pESTypeList is valid)
source_translations.页哈希不匹配——内核页面内容与签名哈希对不上，可能是代码被改或内存位翻转。: Page hash mismatch -- the contents of a kernel page do not match the signed hash, possibly because the code was modified or a memory bit flipped.
source_translations.SCI 通用错误。注：微软两处文档对 SCI 的展开不一致——0x124 页写作: Generic SCI error. Note: two Microsoft documents expand SCI differently -- the 0x124 page writes it as scalable coherent interface, while the ntddk.h enumeration page writes it as service control interrupt.
source_translations.解除内存保护时找不到目标范围：要么地址传错，要么在错误的进程上下文里调用。参数: The target range could not be found when removing memory protection: either the wrong address was passed in, or the call was made in the wrong process context. Parameter 2 is the virtual address that was evaluated.
source_translations.在一次分页池分配的中间位置调用了释放。参数 4 为距分页池起点的页偏移。典型是指: A free was issued in the middle of a paged pool allocation. Parameter 4 is the page offset from the start of paged pool. Typically the pointer was adjusted by arithmetic before being passed to ExFreePool.
source_translations.SEH 异常处理链不自洽，是 x86 上栈溢出改写 SEH 链的经典特征。: The SEH exception handler chain is inconsistent, a classic signature of a stack overflow overwriting the SEH chain on x86.
source_translations.代码完整性问题：调用方指定了可执行的 MDL 映射，应使用 MdlMapping: Code integrity issue: the caller requested an executable MDL mapping and should use MdlMappingNoExecute instead. Parameter 2 is the address of the offending driver code. Parameter 3 is the page priority combined with the MdlMapping* flags.
source_translations.调用内核函数时把用户态地址当作参数传入。参数 2 为该用户态地址，参数 3 为范: A user-mode address was passed as a parameter to a kernel function. Parameter 2 is the user-mode address. Parameter 3 is the size of the range in bytes.
source_translations.同 0x13A：ExFreePool 时池跟踪内部值有误。参数 3 为错误值的地: Same as 0x13A: an internal pool tracking value was incorrect during ExFreePool. Parameter 3 is the address of the incorrect value. Parameter 4 is the expected correct value.
source_translations.查询虚拟地址时发现 PFN 与当前 PTE 指针不一致。参数 2 为对应 PTE: While querying a virtual address, the PFN did not match the current PTE pointer. Parameter 2 is the corresponding PTE. Parameter 3 is the PTE contents. Parameter 4 is the VAD. Seen only on older versions of Windows.
source_translations.删除了一个尚未从 WMI 注销的设备对象。参数 2 为设备对象地址。: A device object was deleted while it was still registered with WMI. Parameter 2 is the address of the device object.
source_translations.返回地址校验失败，与影子栈及返回地址保护相关。: Return address validation failed; related to shadow stacks and return address protection.
source_translations.VTGuard 检测到试图使用非法的虚函数表：C++ 对象被写坏后，虚方法调用用: VTGuard detected an attempt to use an invalid virtual function table: a C++ object was corrupted and a virtual method call then used the damaged this pointer. Typically a use-after-free or an out-of-bounds write into the object.
source_translations.驱动释放了一个并非由分配调用返回的地址。参数 2 为该错误地址。: A driver freed an address that was never returned by an allocation call. Parameter 2 is the offending address.
source_translations.内部接口收到了不可能出现的参数值，通常意味着调用方的数据结构已经损坏。: An internal interface received a parameter value that should be impossible, which usually means the caller's data structures are already corrupted.
source_translations.检测到非法的映像基址。: An invalid image base address was detected.
source_translations.已换出的内核线程栈的 PTE 被破坏，通常是别的组件越界写到了这块换出栈结构。: The PTEs of a paged-out kernel thread stack were corrupted, usually because another component wrote out of bounds into the paged-out stack structure.
source_translations.驱动为一段不在内存中（非驻留）的虚拟地址构建 MDL，这是非法的。参数 2 为: A driver built an MDL for a virtual address range that is not resident in memory, which is illegal. Parameter 2 is the MDL. Parameter 3 is the PTE pointer.
source_translations.驱动释放的池块中含有仍然活动的 lookaside 链表。参数 2 为该链表地址: A driver freed a pool block that still contained an active lookaside list. Parameter 2 is the address of the list. Parameters 3 and 4 are the start address and the size of the pool allocation.
source_translations.驱动解锁了一个当前未加锁的可分页节（从未加锁或被解锁两次）。典型是 MmLock: A driver unlocked a pageable section that was not currently locked, either never locked or unlocked twice. Typically an unbalanced MmLockPagableCodeSection / MmUnlockPagableImageSection pair.
source_translations.驱动把页面来自分页池的 MDL 传给了 MmBuildMdlForNonPage: A driver passed an MDL whose pages come from paged pool to MmBuildMdlForNonPagedPool. Parameter 3 is the MDL address. Parameter 4 is the MDL flags.
source_translations.释放了一个无效的连续内存地址——MmFreeContiguousMemory 的: An invalid contiguous memory address was freed: the caller of MmFreeContiguousMemory passed a bad pointer. Parameter 2 is the starting address.
source_translations.IoReleaseRemoveLock 的 tag 与此前 IoAcquireR: The tag passed to IoReleaseRemoveLock does not match the tag used by the preceding IoAcquireRemoveLock (I/O verification option). Parameter 2 is the address of the IO_REMOVE_LOCK structure (on builds that are not checked builds, this is the shadow structure created by Driver Verifier). Parameter 3 is the tag used for this release.
source_translations.系统累计在 IRQL >= DISPATCH_LEVEL 上停留过久。参数 2: The system spent too much cumulative time at IRQL >= DISPATCH_LEVEL. Parameter 2 is the watchdog period. Parameter 3 can be cast to nt!DPC_WATCHDOG_GLOBAL_TRIAGE_BLOCK. Parameter 4 is reserved. The crash site is frequently not the offending code, so use ETW tracing to identify the driver with abnormal execution time.
source_translations.代码完整性问题：调用方指定了可执行的池类型，应使用 NonPagedPoolNx: Code integrity issue: the caller requested an executable pool type and should use NonPagedPoolNx instead. Parameter 2 is the address of the offending driver code. Parameter 3 is the pool type. Parameter 4 is the pool tag, if one was supplied.
source_translations.页帧号非法，属于内核侧检查。: The page frame number is invalid; this is a kernel-side check.
source_translations.删除系统页面时发现 PFN 与当前 PTE 指针不一致。参数 2 为期望 PTE: While deleting a system page, the PFN did not match the current PTE pointer. Parameter 2 is the expected PTE. Parameter 3 is the actual PTE contents. Parameter 4 is the PTE recorded in the PFN. Most often a driver wrote out of bounds and corrupted page table structures.
source_translations.向一个把非法参数视为致命错误的函数传入了非法参数。: An invalid parameter was passed to a function that treats invalid parameters as fatal.
source_translations.在 IRQL >= DISPATCH_LEVEL 时调用了 KeWaitXxx: A KeWaitXxx routine was called at IRQL >= DISPATCH_LEVEL. Parameter 3 is the wait object. Parameter 4 is the timeout parameter.
source_translations.设备未能在规定时间内完成定向电源切换（DFx）。参数 2 为设备栈 PDO，参数: A device failed to complete a directed power transition (DFx) within the allotted time. Parameter 2 is the PDO of the device stack. Parameter 3 is the POP_FX_DEVICE object.
source_translations.堆元数据损坏，由段堆或 NT 堆的加固检查检出，与 0xC0000374 同源。: Heap metadata corruption, detected by the hardening checks in the segment heap or the NT heap; same origin as 0xC0000374.
source_translations.执行 DIV/IDIV 时除数为零。内存损坏、其它硬件问题或软件缺陷都可能导致。: A DIV or IDIV instruction executed with a divisor of zero. Memory corruption, other hardware problems, or a software defect can all cause this.
source_translations.对不在 PFN 数据库中的页面调用 MmProbeAndLockPages，典型: MmProbeAndLockPages was called on pages that are not in the PFN database, typically a driver trying to lock its own dual-ported RAM. This is not only unnecessary, it also corrupts memory on machines with discontiguous physical memory. Parameter 2 is the MDL address. Parameter 3 is the physical page being locked. Parameter 4 is the highest physical page in the system.
source_translations.出现了不应发生的调用，走到了理论上不可达的分支。: A call that should never happen occurred, reaching a branch that is theoretically unreachable.
source_translations.已终止的线程仍持有该锁。参数 2 为持有者线程地址。: A terminated thread still owns the lock. Parameter 2 is the address of the owning thread.
source_translations.页表与 PFN 数据库不同步。若参数 3 与参数 4 只相差一个二进制位，基本可: The page tables are out of sync with the PFN database. If parameter 3 and parameter 4 differ by only a single bit, the cause is almost certainly a memory bit-flip hardware fault.
source_translations.同 0x13A：ExFreePool 时池跟踪内部值有误。参数 3 为错误值的地: Same as 0x13A: an internal pool tracking value was incorrect during ExFreePool. Parameter 3 is the address of the incorrect value. Parameter 4 is a pointer to the memory page in error.
source_translations.被释放的池块中含有仍然活动的定时器。参数 2 为定时器项，参数 3 为池类型，参: The pool block being freed still contained an active timer. Parameter 2 is the timer entry. Parameter 3 is the pool type. Parameter 4 is the address of the pool being freed. KeCancelTimer must be called before the block is freed.
source_translations.驱动以格式错误的 UNICODE_STRING 为参数调用了内核模式 ZwXxx: A driver called a kernel-mode ZwXxx routine with a malformed UNICODE_STRING parameter. Parameter 2 is the call site. Parameter 3 is the address of the structure.
source_translations.Driver Verifier 检测到系统关机超过 20 分钟仍未完成。参数 2: Driver Verifier detected that system shutdown has not completed after more than 20 minutes. Parameter 2 is the address of the shutdown thread that may be deadlocked.
source_translations.线程请求了 0 字节的池分配。参数 3 为池类型（0=非分页，1=分页），参数: The thread requested a pool allocation of 0 bytes. Parameter 3 is the pool type (0 = nonpaged, 1 = paged), and parameter 4 is the pool tag. This usually indicates a length calculation underflow (for example, size - header evaluating to 0).
source_translations.驱动对一个并不处于临界区的线程调用了 KeLeaveCriticalRegion: A driver called KeLeaveCriticalRegion on a thread that was not in a critical region, meaning the Enter/Leave calls are unbalanced.
source_translations.工作集空闲链表损坏，微软判定多为硬件错误。仅出现在旧版 Windows。: The working set free list is corrupted; Microsoft attributes this mostly to hardware failure. Seen only on older versions of Windows.
source_translations.IRP 完成例程返回时的 IRQL 与被调用时不同。参数 2 为完成例程地址，参: An IRP completion routine returned at a different IRQL than the one it was called at. Parameter 2 is the completion routine address, parameter 3 is the IRQL before the call, and parameter 4 is the IRQL after the call.
source_translations.驱动获取 ERESOURCE 时未禁用 APC。获取前应调用 KeEnterCr: A driver acquired an ERESOURCE without disabling APCs. KeEnterCriticalRegion must be called before acquiring it. Parameter 3 is the APC disable count, and parameter 4 is the resource address.
source_translations.TRIAGE 数据块目录越界，本转储的附加内存块信息已跳过。: The TRIAGE data block directory is out of bounds; additional memory block information for this dump has been skipped.
source_translations.非法的纤程切换：在错误的线程或错误的状态下调用了 SwitchToFiber。: Invalid fiber switch: SwitchToFiber was called on the wrong thread or in the wrong state.
source_translations.为 .mrdata 重新加只读保护失败。: Failed to reapply read-only protection to the .mrdata section.
source_translations.自死锁：当前线程只以共享方式持有该资源，却又递归地要求独占获取（死锁检测选项）。: Self-deadlock: the current thread holds the resource shared and then recursively requests exclusive acquisition (deadlock detection option). Parameter 2 is the resource address.
source_translations.试图把一个用户态地址当成内核池释放。参数 2 为起始地址，参数 3 为系统地址空: An attempt was made to free a user-mode address as kernel pool. Parameter 2 is the starting address, and parameter 3 is the start of system address space. Typically a user buffer pointer was passed to ExFreePool by mistake.
source_translations.驱动以 unsafe 方式获取互斥体时 IRQL 不等于 APC_LEVEL。参: A driver acquired a mutex using the unsafe variant while the IRQL was not APC_LEVEL. Parameter 3 is the APC disable count, and parameter 4 is the mutex address.
source_translations.对象类型结构被修改。: An object type structure has been modified.
source_translations.被释放的池块中含有仍然活动的 ERESOURCE。参数 2 为该 ERESOUR: The pool block being freed contains an ERESOURCE that is still active. Parameter 2 is the ERESOURCE entry, parameter 3 is the pool type, and parameter 4 is the address of the pool being freed. ExDeleteResourceLite must be called before freeing (same class as 0xD2, only the detection point differs).
source_translations.内核通知 callout 被修改。: A kernel notification callout has been modified.
source_translations.驱动在错误的地址上释放池，或给内存例程传了非法参数。参数 3 为池地址。: A driver freed pool at the wrong address, or passed an invalid parameter to a memory routine. Parameter 3 is the pool address.
source_translations.驱动用重叠的源/目标缓冲区调用了 memcpy，应改用 memmove。参数 2: A driver called memcpy with overlapping source and destination buffers; memmove should be used instead. Parameters 2/3/4 are the destination, the source, and the byte count.
source_translations.驱动试图锁定一个并不存在的可分页节。: A driver attempted to lock a pageable section that does not exist.
source_translations.引用计数出现不可能的值（通常是减到 0 之后再减），指向提前释放或重复 Rele: A reference count reached an impossible value (usually decremented again after already reaching 0), pointing to a premature free or a duplicate Release.
source_translations.同 0x51：驱动越界写后再释放（池跟踪）。参数 2 为分配基址，参数 3 为链: Same as 0x51: a driver wrote past the end of an allocation and then freed it (pool tracking). Parameter 2 is the allocation base address, and parameter 3 is the list index.
source_translations.ExFreePool 调用方给出的池块地址与 Driver Verifier 记: The pool block address supplied by the ExFreePool caller differs from the address recorded by Driver Verifier. Parameter 2 is the pool block address supplied by the caller, and parameter 3 is the pool block address recorded by Driver Verifier.
source_translations.设置线程上下文的请求被安全策略拒绝。: A request to set a thread context was denied by security policy.
source_translations.驱动释放了一块已经被释放的池内存。参数 3 指向池头，参数 4 为池头内容。: A driver freed a block of pool memory that had already been freed. Parameter 3 points to the pool header, and parameter 4 is the contents of the pool header.
source_translations.在硬盘上检测到 CRC 错误（仅在开启 Driver Verifier 磁盘完整: A CRC error was detected on the hard disk (reported only when Driver Verifier disk integrity checking is enabled). Parameter 2 is the read/write IRP, parameter 3 is the lower device object, and parameter 4 is the number of the failing sector.
source_translations.枚举了已删除的 PDO：枚举器返回了一个此前已用 IoDeleteDevice: A deleted PDO was enumerated: the enumerator returned a PDO that had already been deleted with IoDeleteDevice. Parameter 2 is the PDO that has DOE_DELETE_PENDING set.
source_translations.关键浮点控制寄存器被修改。: A critical floating-point control register has been modified.
source_translations.热补丁回调执行失败。: A hotpatch callback failed to execute.
source_translations.调试例程被修改。: A debug routine has been modified.
source_translations.longjmp 目标不在编译期登记的合法目标表内（CFG 对 longjmp 的: The longjmp target is not in the table of valid targets registered at compile time (CFG hardening for longjmp).
source_translations.Irp->RequestorMode 为 KernelMode 的 IRP 里却: An IRP whose Irp->RequestorMode is KernelMode contains a user-mode address. Parameter 2 is the IRP address, and parameter 3 is that user-mode address.
source_translations.释放了一个无效的池地址。参数 2 为起始地址。: An invalid pool address was freed. Parameter 2 is the starting address.
source_translations.释放了一个未分配的分页池地址。参数 2 为起始地址。: A paged pool address that was never allocated was freed. Parameter 2 is the starting address.
source_translations.影子栈（Intel CET）校验失败：返回地址与影子栈中的副本不一致，即返回地址: Shadow stack (Intel CET) validation failed: the return address does not match its copy on the shadow stack, meaning the return address was overwritten, possibly by an incompatible hook that tampered with the stack.
source_translations.模块加载时 /GS 全局安全 cookie 初始化失败或被改写。: The /GS global security cookie failed to initialize, or was overwritten, while the module was being loaded.
source_translations.进程退出时因残留引用而无法删除全部页表页，通常说明该进程的页表结构已损坏。: Not all page table pages could be deleted at process exit because of lingering references, which usually means the page table structures of the process are corrupted.
source_translations.用无效地址释放池；该码也可能表示池头本身已损坏。参数 2 为被释放的地址。: Pool was freed with an invalid address; this code can also indicate that the pool header itself is corrupted. Parameter 2 is the address being freed.
source_translations.WOW64 线程状态被破坏（64 位系统上的 32 位进程）。: The WOW64 thread state has been corrupted (a 32-bit process on a 64-bit system).
source_translations.待机链表上两个本应优先级相同的页面优先级不一致（Windows 7 及以后；文档: Two pages on the standby list that should have the same priority have mismatched priorities (Windows 7 and later; documented as the 0x8886-0x8887 range). The difference is recorded in parameter 4.
source_translations.代码完整性问题：映像中存在未按页对齐的节。参数 2 为映像文件名，参数 3 为节: Code integrity issue: the image contains a section that is not page-aligned. Parameter 2 is the image file name, parameter 3 is the section header address, and parameter 4 is the section name.
source_translations.LIST_ENTRY 双向链表损坏（例如同一项被 RemoveEntryList: A LIST_ENTRY doubly linked list is corrupt (for example, the same entry was passed to RemoveEntryList twice). Common root causes: a driver corrupted a kernel synchronization object such as a KEVENT or KTIMER, freed a structure that was still linked into the list, or manipulated the list from multiple threads without a lock. Walk the list forward and backward with dl/dlb to locate the break.
source_translations.驱动用与该锁类型不匹配的 API 释放锁。参数 2 为锁地址。: A driver released a lock using an API that does not match the lock type. Parameter 2 is the lock address.
source_translations.驱动的中断服务例程破坏了扩展线程上下文（如 XMM/AVX 寄存器状态）。参数: A driver interrupt service routine corrupted the extended thread context (for example, XMM/AVX register state). Parameter 2 is the ISR address; parameters 3 and 4 are the addresses of the extended context saved before and after execution.
source_translations.释放了一个未分配的分页池地址。参数 2 为起始地址，参数 3 为距分页池起点的页: An attempt was made to free a paged pool address that was never allocated. Parameter 2 is the starting address, parameter 3 is the page offset from the start of paged pool, and parameter 4 is the size of paged pool in bytes.
source_translations.调试切换例程被修改。: The debug switch routine has been modified.
source_translations.驱动写越过分配末尾后再释放该内存（仅在开启池跟踪时报出）。参数 2 为分配基址，: A driver wrote past the end of an allocation and then freed that memory (reported only when pool tracking is enabled). Parameter 2 is the base address of the allocation, parameter 3 is the address of the out-of-bounds reference, and parameter 4 is the number of bytes charged.
source_translations.请求了致命程序退出（如 __fastfail 主动终止）。: A fatal program exit was requested (for example, a deliberate termination through __fastfail).
source_translations.空闲池 SLIST 上的某个页面被写坏。典型是驱动释放后继续写（write-af: A page on the free pool SLIST was corrupted. Typically a driver kept writing after freeing the memory (write-after-free), or the preceding page was overrun. Parameter 2 is the address of the free pool block, parameter 3 is the actual value, and parameter 4 is the expected value. Seen only on older versions of Windows.
source_translations.IRQL、自旋锁与同步对象类检查失败；具体子类型未收录。: An IRQL, spin lock, or synchronization object class check failed; the specific subtype is not documented here.
source_translations.池头已被破坏。参数 2 指向池头，参数 3 为池头前半部分内容。典型是相邻块被越: The pool header has been corrupted. Parameter 2 points to the pool header, and parameter 3 is the contents of the first half of the pool header. This is typically caused by a buffer overrun from an adjacent block.
source_translations.驱动用 ExFreePool 而不是 IoFreeIrp 释放 IRP。参数 2: A driver freed an IRP with ExFreePool instead of IoFreeIrp. Parameter 2 is the IRP address.
source_translations.换页读入操作 CRC 校验失败。参数 2 为页面文件偏移，参数 3 为实际 CR: A page-in operation failed its CRC check. Parameter 2 is the page file offset, parameter 3 is the actual CRC, and parameter 4 is the expected CRC. This points to a failure of the disk holding the page file, of the storage controller, or of memory, rather than to driver logic.
source_translations.会话配置被修改。: The session configuration has been modified.
source_translations.释放的虚拟地址从来不属于任何池。参数 2 为被释放地址。多为指针被覆盖，或对基址: The virtual address being freed never belonged to any pool. Parameter 2 is the address that was freed. This usually means the pointer was overwritten, or that an offset was applied to the base address before it was freed.
source_translations.加密库发生错误。: An error occurred in the cryptographic library.
source_translations.驱动试图删除一个未初始化的 ERESOURCE。参数 2 为该结构地址。: A driver attempted to delete an ERESOURCE that was never initialized. Parameter 2 is the address of the structure.
source_translations.驱动在 IRQL < DISPATCH_LEVEL 时调用 KeReleaseS: A driver called KeReleaseSpinLockFromDpcLevel at IRQL < DISPATCH_LEVEL. Parameter 2 is the current IRQL, and parameter 3 is the spin lock address.
source_translations.IRP 分配器被修改。: The IRP allocator has been modified.
source_translations.电源状态切换在等待与即插即用子系统同步时超时。参数 2 为超时秒数，参数 3 为: A power state transition timed out while waiting to synchronize with the Plug and Play subsystem. Parameter 2 is the timeout in seconds, parameter 3 is the thread currently holding the PnP lock, and parameter 4 can be cast to nt!_TRIAGE_9F_PNP.
source_translations.调度器取到了非法的下一个线程对象。: The scheduler obtained an invalid next thread object.
source_translations.加载器没有正确初始化栈安全 cookie。典型场景：驱动只按 Windows 8: The loader did not correctly initialize the stack security cookie. A typical case is a driver built only for a Windows 8 target that is then loaded on an earlier version of Windows.
source_translations.驱动对部分 MDL（IoBuildPartialMdl 创建）调用了 MmUnm: A driver called MmUnmapLockedPages on a partial MDL created by IoBuildPartialMdl. Parameter 3 is the MDL flags, and parameter 4 is the unexpected partial MDL flag.
source_translations.驱动调用分发器被修改（IoCallDriver 路径被挂钩）。: The driver call dispatcher has been modified (the IoCallDriver path is hooked).
source_translations.期望内核指针却拿到了非内核指针，属于内核侧检查。: A non-kernel pointer was supplied where a kernel pointer was expected; this is a kernel-side check.
source_translations.会话导入表被修改。: The session import table has been modified.
source_translations.同步对象的地址无效或位于可分页内存中。参数 2 为该对象地址。: The address of the synchronization object is invalid or resides in pageable memory. Parameter 2 is the object address.
source_translations.驱动以 unsafe 方式释放互斥体时 IRQL 不等于 APC_LEVEL。参: A driver released a mutex with the unsafe variant while IRQL was not equal to APC_LEVEL. Parameter 3 is the APC disable count, and parameter 4 is the mutex address.
source_translations.同 0x13A：ExFreePool 时池跟踪内部值有误。参数 3 为错误值，参: Same as 0x13A: an internal pool tracking value was incorrect during ExFreePool. Parameter 3 is the incorrect value, and parameter 4 is the address of that value.
source_translations.处理器试图执行非法指令。通常是指令指针被破坏后指向了错误位置；最常见的根因是内存: The processor attempted to execute an illegal instruction. The instruction pointer was usually corrupted and now points to the wrong location; the most common root cause is faulty memory hardware.
source_translations.类型 3 进程链表损坏。: The type 3 process list is corrupt.
source_translations.被释放的设备对象上还有未完成的电源请求。参数 2 为该设备对象。: The device object being freed still has outstanding power requests. Parameter 2 is that device object.
source_translations.引导加载器损坏（仅 Intel Itanium 平台，历史遗留值）。仅出现在旧版: The boot loader is corrupt (Intel Itanium platforms only; a legacy value). Seen only on older versions of Windows.
source_translations.虚拟化宿主行为异常：客户机检测到宿主返回了不合理的结果。: The virtualization host behaved unexpectedly: the guest detected that the host returned an implausible result.
source_translations.驱动在 IRQL > DISPATCH_LEVEL 时调用 MmMapIoSpa: A driver called MmMapIoSpace at IRQL > DISPATCH_LEVEL. Parameter 3 is the physical address (the low 32 bits on 32-bit systems), and parameter 4 is the number of bytes.
source_translations.RemoveLock 即使在 IoReleaseRemoveLockAndWai: A RemoveLock cannot be reinitialized even after IoReleaseRemoveLockAndWait, because threads may still be using it. The RemoveLock should reside in the device extension and be initialized exactly once. Parameter 2 is the Driver Verifier internal structure, and parameter 3 is the structure supplied by the driver.
source_translations.访问了守卫页（PAGE_GUARD）：线程栈自动扩展由内核内部处理、不会落进转储: A guard page (PAGE_GUARD) was accessed. Automatic thread stack growth is handled internally by the kernel and never reaches a dump, so seeing this in a dump almost always means a custom guard page (write barrier, memory pool, anti-debug) was touched.
source_translations.用错误的 tag 释放池内存——这块内存可能根本属于别的组件。参数 2 为池地址: Pool memory was freed with the wrong tag; the block may belong to an entirely different component. Parameter 2 is the pool address, parameter 3 is the tag used at allocation, and parameter 4 is the tag used at free.
source_translations.堆内部抛出了预期之外的异常，绝大多数情况下仍然是堆元数据被破坏。: An unexpected exception was raised inside the heap. In the vast majority of cases this still means the heap metadata is corrupted.
source_translations.从可分页或可交易内存构建了未加锁的 MDL。参数 2 为当前 IRQL，参数 3: An unlocked MDL was built from pageable or transacted memory. Parameter 2 is the current IRQL, parameter 3 is the MDL address, and parameter 4 is its virtual address.
source_translations.系统 BIOS 在睡眠状态切换过程中破坏了低端物理内存。参数 2 为被破坏的物理: The system BIOS corrupted low physical memory during a sleep state transition. Parameter 2 is the number of corrupted physical pages, and parameters 3/4 are the first and last physical pages. This is a firmware problem; update the BIOS first.
source_translations.驱动在 IRQL > DISPATCH_LEVEL 时调用 MmUnlockPa: A driver called MmUnlockPages at IRQL > DISPATCH_LEVEL. Parameter 3 is the MDL address.
source_translations.设备对象完成了系统电源状态请求的 IRP，却没有调用 PoStartNextPo: A device object completed the IRP for a system power state request without calling PoStartNextPowerIrp. Parameter 2 is the target device object, parameter 3 is the device object, and parameter 4 is the driver object.
source_translations.资源被多次初始化（死锁检测选项）。参数 2 为资源地址。: A resource was initialized more than once (deadlock detection option). Parameter 2 is the resource address.
source_translations.驱动在 IRQL > DISPATCH_LEVEL 时调用 MmProbeAnd: A driver called MmProbeAndLockSelectedPages at IRQL > DISPATCH_LEVEL. Parameter 3 is the MDL address and parameter 4 is the process address.
source_translations.代码完整性问题：调用方指定了可执行的页保护，应清除 PAGE_EXECUTE*: Code integrity violation: the caller specified an executable page protection and must clear the PAGE_EXECUTE* bits. Parameter 2 is the address of the offending driver code and parameter 3 is the WIN32_PROTECTION_MASK.
source_translations.访问了一个不存在的内存段。: A nonexistent memory segment was accessed.
source_translations.驱动在 IRQL > DISPATCH_LEVEL 时分配非分页内存。参数 2: A driver allocated nonpaged memory at IRQL > DISPATCH_LEVEL. Parameter 2 is the current IRQL, parameter 3 is the pool type, and parameter 4 is the number of bytes requested.
source_translations.在 APC 被禁用的状态下执行了需要 APC 的操作。: An operation that requires APCs was performed while APCs were disabled.
source_translations.驱动对一个从未成功加锁的 MDL 调用 MmUnlockPages。参数 2 为: A driver called MmUnlockPages on an MDL that was never successfully locked. Parameter 2 is the MDL address and parameter 3 is the MDL flags.
source_translations.传给 IoDisconnectInterruptEx 的连接类型非法：必须与此前: The connection type passed to IoDisconnectInterruptEx is invalid; it must match the type returned by the earlier successful IoConnectInterruptEx call. Parameter 2 is the connection type that was passed in.
source_translations.EH_MAGIC_NUMBER3：编译期记录了异常处理模式（FuncInfo::: EH_MAGIC_NUMBER3: the exception handling model was recorded at compile time (FuncInfo::EHFlags is valid, distinguishing /EHs from /EHa)
source_translations.【非微软 0x7F 表，取自 Intel SDM 架构向量 14】页错误。实践中: [Not from the Microsoft 0x7F table; taken from Intel SDM architectural vector 14] Page fault. In practice kernel page faults surface through dedicated stop codes such as 0xA/0x50/0xD1, so one appearing under 0x7F means the trap already failed on the exception dispatch path.
source_translations.工作项位于可分页内存中，而内核会在 DISPATCH_LEVEL 使用它，必须放: The work item resides in pageable memory, but the kernel uses it at DISPATCH_LEVEL, so it must be allocated from nonpaged memory. Parameter 2 is the work item address.
source_translations.递减 I/O 空间区域引用计数时找不到该区域的记账节点，通常是该范围从未锁定或已: While decrementing the reference count of an I/O space region, the tracking node for that region could not be found, usually because the range was never locked or was already unlocked. Parameter 2 is the base I/O frame, parameter 3 is the page count, and parameter 4 is the I/O frame whose node is missing.
source_translations.MmGetSystemAddressForMdl* 的调用方想把全缓存物理页映射: The caller of MmGetSystemAddressForMdl* attempted to map fully cached physical pages as noncached. That would create conflicting TLB attributes and is rejected; the bug check is raised because the MDL requested a bug check on failure. Seen only on older Windows versions.
source_translations.驱动对象损坏（分发例程表被改写）。: Driver object corruption (the dispatch routine table was overwritten).
source_translations.调用了被判定为不安全的扩展或插件入口。: An extension or plug-in entry point judged unsafe was called.
source_translations.驱动传入的 MDL 里含有未加锁（或无效）的物理页。参数 2 为 MDL 指针，: The MDL supplied by the driver contains unlocked (or invalid) physical pages. Parameter 2 is the MDL pointer, parameter 3 points to the invalid PFN, and parameter 4 is that PFN value. Typically the MDL was passed to MmUnlockPages too early, or was reused after being freed.
source_translations.不可纠正的 Itanium 机器检查中止。参数 3 为 SAL 日志长度（字节）: Uncorrectable Itanium machine check abort. Parameter 3 is the SAL log length in bytes and parameter 4 is the SAL address.
source_translations.溢出标志 OF 置位时执行了 INTO，处理器调用了溢出中断处理程序。: INTO was executed while the overflow flag OF was set, so the processor invoked the overflow interrupt handler.
source_translations.驱动把用户态句柄当作内核模式句柄引用。参数 2 为句柄值，参数 3 为当前进程地: A driver referenced a user-mode handle as a kernel-mode handle. Parameter 2 is the handle value, parameter 3 is the current process address, and parameter 4 is the address of the driver code that made the bad reference.
source_translations.读 IRP 的不变量 MDL 缓冲区在分发期间被修改，或缓冲区由 dummy 页: The invariant MDL buffer of a read IRP was modified during dispatch, or the buffer is backed by dummy pages (I/O verification). Parameter 2 is the device object, parameter 3 is the IRP, and parameter 4 is the system space mapping address of that MDL.
source_translations.驱动试图重复初始化一个 lookaside 链表。参数 2 为该链表地址。: A driver attempted to initialize a lookaside list that was already initialized. Parameter 2 is the address of that list.
source_translations.驱动在 IRQL > APC_LEVEL 时调用 KeLeaveCritical: A driver called KeLeaveCriticalRegion at IRQL > APC_LEVEL. Parameter 2 is the current IRQL.
source_translations.驱动在 IRQL > DISPATCH_LEVEL 时调用 MmProbeAnd: A driver called MmProbeAndLockPages at IRQL > DISPATCH_LEVEL. Parameter 2 is the current IRQL, parameter 3 is the MDL address, and parameter 4 is the access mode.
source_translations.BMC（基板管理控制器）上报的错误信息，多见于服务器平台。: Error information reported by the BMC (baseboard management controller), most often seen on server platforms.
source_translations.执行体回调对象被修改。: An executive callback object was modified.
source_translations.Driver Verifier 发现其捕获的原始 I/O 回调表被破坏——典型是: Driver Verifier found that the original I/O callback table it captured has been corrupted, typically because some component is hooking the driver object. Parameter 2 is the driver object pointer and parameter 3 points to the captured original I/O callbacks.
source_translations.Driver Verifier 扩展状态存储检测到损坏。参数 2 指向描述该违规: The Driver Verifier extended state store detected corruption. Parameter 2 points to a string describing the violation. Parameters 3/4 are the associated data (0 when unused).
source_translations.缓冲区访问越界，由带边界信息的内部接口检出。: An out-of-bounds buffer access was detected by an internal interface that carries bounds information.
source_translations.导出抑制的调用目标无法被转为合法调用目标（CFG 导出抑制）。: An export-suppressed call target could not be converted into a valid call target (CFG export suppression).
source_translations.驱动对标志不正确的 MDL 调用 MmProbeAndLockProcessPa: A driver called MmProbeAndLockProcessPages on an MDL with incorrect flags. Parameter 3 is the MDL flags. Parameter 4 is the offending flag bits.
source_translations.驱动对引用计数为 0 的对象调用了 ObReferenceObject 或 Ob: A driver called ObReferenceObject or ObDereferenceObject on an object whose reference count is 0. Parameter 2 is the object address. Parameter 3 is -1 for a dereference and 1 for a reference.
source_translations.CRCDISK 的校验和副本不匹配，可能是分页 I/O 错误（磁盘完整性检查）。: The CRCDISK checksum copy does not match, possibly a paging I/O error (disk integrity checking). Parameter 2 is the IRP or its copy. Parameter 3 is the lower device object. Parameter 4 is the failing sector number.
source_translations.设置线程上下文的内容非法，常见于注入或热补丁类代码修改线程上下文。: The thread context being set is invalid. This is commonly seen when injection or hot-patching code modifies a thread context.
source_translations.不可纠正的 PCI Express 错误。常见于显卡/NVMe/扩展卡链路不稳、: Uncorrectable PCI Express error. Common causes are an unstable GPU / NVMe / add-in card link, poor slot contact, or PCIe power management (ASPM) problems.
source_translations.IoReleaseRemoveLockAndWait 的 tag 与此前 IoA: The tag passed to IoReleaseRemoveLockAndWait does not match the tag from the earlier IoAcquireRemoveLock (I/O verification option). Parameters 3/4 are the mismatched tag and the previous tag.
source_translations.占位值：调用方传入的 __fastfail 代码本身不合法。: Placeholder value: the __fastfail code supplied by the caller is itself invalid.
source_translations.驱动释放的池块中含有仍然活动的 ERESOURCE。参数 2 为该结构地址，参数: A driver freed a pool block that still contains an active ERESOURCE. Parameter 2 is the address of the structure. Parameters 3/4 are the start address and size of the pool allocation.
source_translations.应用主动致命退出：abort、std::terminate、未捕获异常经 CRT: The application terminated itself deliberately: abort, std::terminate, uncaught exceptions caught by the CRT fallback, and the CRT invalid parameter handler all funnel here. It means the program chose to exit rather than memory being corrupted, so look one frame up to find the logic that triggered it.
source_translations.驱动在 IRQL > APC_LEVEL 时调用 MmUnmapIoSpace。: A driver called MmUnmapIoSpace at IRQL > APC_LEVEL. Parameter 3 is the virtual address. Parameter 4 is the number of bytes.
source_translations.驱动把一个未对齐的 ERESOURCE 传给 ExAcquireResource: A driver passed an unaligned ERESOURCE to ExAcquireResourceExclusive. Parameter 4 is the resource address.
source_translations.驱动给 KeRaiseIrql 传了非法参数（低于当前 IRQL 或高于 HIG: A driver passed an invalid argument to KeRaiseIrql (below the current IRQL or above HIGH_LEVEL), commonly caused by an uninitialized IRQL variable. Parameter 2 is the current IRQL. Parameter 3 is the requested IRQL.
source_translations.Adminless 模式下的访问被拒；头文件标注为遥测且不致命。: Access was denied in Adminless mode. The header marks this as telemetry and non-fatal.
source_translations.驱动试图映射一个未加锁的物理页——该页内容与属性随时可能变化，属于调用方代码缺陷: A driver tried to map an unlocked physical page. The contents and attributes of such a page can change at any time, so this is a defect in the calling code. Parameter 2 is the PFN of the physical page.
source_translations.释放了一个未分配的非分页池地址。参数 2 为起始地址。: A nonpaged pool address that was never allocated was freed. Parameter 2 is the starting address.
source_translations.驱动试图释放一个非法的池地址。: A driver tried to free an invalid pool address.
source_translations.平衡树结构不自洽，多为节点内存被破坏。: The balanced tree structure is inconsistent, usually because node memory has been corrupted.
source_translations.驱动对由 IoBuildPartialMdl 创建的部分 MDL 调用了 MmU: A driver called MmUnlockPages on a partial MDL created by IoBuildPartialMdl. Parameter 3 is the MDL flags. Parameter 4 is the unexpected partial MDL flag.
source_translations.用户态地址访问与 Zw 调用类检查失败；具体子类型未收录。: A user-mode address access or Zw call class check failed. The specific subtype is not documented here.
source_translations.MDL 未标记为 I/O，却包含非内存页地址。参数 2 为 MDL 地址，参数: The MDL is not marked as I/O yet contains an address that is not a memory page. Parameter 2 is the MDL address. Parameter 3 points to that non-memory page within the MDL. Parameter 4 is its page number.
source_translations.同 0x8884：待机链表页面优先级不一致，差异值在参数 4。: Same as 0x8884: the standby list page priority is inconsistent. The differing value is in parameter 4.
source_translations.驱动调用 MmMapLockedPages 前没有锁定 MDL 页面。参数 2: A driver called MmMapLockedPages without first locking the MDL pages. Parameter 2 is the MDL address. Parameter 3 is the number of pages to map. Parameter 4 is the first unlocked page frame number.
source_translations.驱动释放 ERESOURCE 时未禁用 APC。参数 3 为 APC 禁用计数，: A driver released an ERESOURCE without APCs disabled. Parameter 3 is the APC disable count. Parameter 4 is the resource address.
source_translations.ExFreePool 释放的字节数与 Driver Verifier 记录的不同: The number of bytes freed by ExFreePool differs from the number recorded by Driver Verifier. Parameter 2 is the pool block address. Parameter 3 is the number of bytes freed. Parameter 4 points to the byte count recorded by Driver Verifier.
source_translations.空闲链表上缓存的内核栈被写坏。参数 2 为虚拟地址，参数 3 为该虚拟地址的 c: A kernel stack cached on the free list was corrupted. Parameter 2 is the virtual address. Parameter 3 is the cookie for that virtual address. The current call stack may only be the victim, so enable Driver Verifier special pool to catch the real culprit.
source_translations.驱动对标志不正确的 MDL 调用 MmProbeAndLockPages，例如把: A driver called MmProbeAndLockPages on an MDL with incorrect flags, for example by passing in an MDL built by MmBuildMdlForNonPagedPool. Parameter 2 is the MDL address. Parameter 3 is the MDL flags. Parameter 4 is the offending flag bits.
source_translations.驱动在 IRQL > DISPATCH_LEVEL 时释放非分页池。参数 2 为: A driver freed nonpaged pool at IRQL > DISPATCH_LEVEL. Parameter 2 is the current IRQL. Parameter 3 is the pool type. Parameter 4 is the pool address.
source_translations.获取了一个未初始化的资源（死锁检测选项）。参数 2 为资源地址。: An uninitialized resource was acquired (deadlock detection option). Parameter 2 is the resource address.
source_translations.旧式 /GS 栈保护检查失败的通用值（未细分子类型），等同于栈上缓冲区被写越界。: The generic value for a legacy /GS stack protection check failure (no subtype breakdown), equivalent to a stack buffer overrun.
source_translations.VTGuard 虚表守卫校验失败：对象的虚表指针被改写，是释放后使用或类型混淆的: VTGuard virtual table guard check failed: the object's virtual table pointer was overwritten, a classic signature of use-after-free or type confusion.
source_translations.驱动在内核模式下以 IRQL > DISPATCH_LEVEL 调用 MmUnm: A driver called MmUnmapLockedPages in kernel mode at IRQL > DISPATCH_LEVEL. Parameter 3 is the virtual address being unmapped. Parameter 4 is the MDL address.
source_translations.驱动试图重复初始化一个 ERESOURCE。参数 2 为该结构地址。: A driver tried to initialize an ERESOURCE that was already initialized. Parameter 2 is the address of the structure.
source_translations.longjmp 跳向了非法目标。: longjmp jumped to an invalid target.
source_translations.设备驱动错误源——由驱动通过 WHEA 主动上报的硬件错误。: Device driver error source: a hardware error reported by a driver through WHEA.
source_translations.同 0x42：释放的虚拟地址从来不属于任何池。: Same as 0x42: the freed virtual address never belonged to any pool.
source_translations.间接调用防护（CFG/kCFG）检测到非法的控制转移。函数指针被覆盖或指向了非法: Indirect call guard (CFG/kCFG) detected an invalid control transfer. A function pointer was overwritten or points to an invalid target.
source_translations.驱动在 IRQL > DISPATCH_LEVEL 时调用 KeSetEvent: A driver called KeSetEvent at IRQL > DISPATCH_LEVEL. Parameter 2 is the current IRQL, parameter 3 is the address of the event object.
source_translations.驱动在 IRQL > DISPATCH_LEVEL 时调用 KeAcquireS: A driver called KeAcquireSpinLock at IRQL > DISPATCH_LEVEL. Parameter 2 is the current IRQL, parameter 3 is the address of the spin lock.
source_translations.ARM64 指针认证校验返回地址失败：返回地址被改写或签名不匹配。: ARM64 pointer authentication failed to validate the return address: the return address was overwritten or the signature does not match.
source_translations.驱动创建 lookaside 链表时指定的块大小小于最小支持值。参数 2 为该链: A driver created a lookaside list with a block size smaller than the minimum supported value. Parameter 2 is the address of the list, parameter 3 is the specified size, parameter 4 is the minimum size.
source_translations.加载器完整性校验失败，加载了不符合策略的映像；头文件标注为遥测且不致命。: Loader integrity check failed and an image that does not comply with policy was loaded. The header file marks this subcode as telemetry and non-fatal.
source_translations.编译器插入的范围检查失败，例如 switch 跳转表索引越界。: A compiler-inserted range check failed, for example a switch jump table index that is out of bounds.
source_translations.IoPageFrameNode 为空。参数 2 为 PageFrameIndex: IoPageFrameNode is NULL. Parameter 2 is the PageFrameIndex.
source_translations.ARS PMEM（地址范围擦洗，持久性内存）错误源。: ARS PMEM (Address Range Scrub, persistent memory) error source.
source_translations.对只读数据做了不安全的修改。: An unsafe modification was made to read-only data.
source_translations.纤程本地存储数据非法或被破坏。: Fiber local storage data is invalid or corrupted.
source_translations.编译器插入的数组边界检查发现了非法的数组索引操作。: A compiler-inserted array bounds check detected an invalid array indexing operation.
source_translations.驱动的分发例程返回时中断仍处于禁用状态。参数 2 为分发例程地址。: A driver dispatch routine returned with interrupts still disabled. Parameter 2 is the address of the dispatch routine.
source_translations.向量化异常处理器链被破坏，常见于注入类软件挂了 VEH 之后被卸载或内存被回收。: The vectored exception handler chain is corrupted. This is common after injection software installs a VEH and is then unloaded or has its memory reclaimed.
source_translations.被删除的锁仍被某个线程持有。参数 2 为锁地址，参数 3 为持有者线程地址。: A lock that was deleted is still held by a thread. Parameter 2 is the address of the lock, parameter 3 is the address of the owning thread.
source_translations.试图切换到非法的 jmp_buf 上下文。: An attempt was made to switch to an invalid jmp_buf context.
