source_translations.驱动调用 MmMapIoSpace 前没有锁定 MDL 页面。参数 2 为物理地: A driver called MmMapIoSpace without first locking the MDL pages. Parameter 2 is the start of the physical address range, parameter 3 is the number of bytes mapped, parameter 4 is the first unlocked page frame number.
source_translations.驱动试图对一个映射非法的 MDL 修改保护属性。: A driver attempted to change the protection attributes of an MDL whose mapping is invalid.
source_translations.在非法 IRQL 上释放池。参数 2 为当前 IRQL，参数 3 为池类型，参数: Pool was freed at an invalid IRQL. Parameter 2 is the current IRQL, parameter 3 is the pool type, parameter 4 is the pool address. This commonly happens when paged pool is freed inside a DPC.
source_translations.重复 PDO：同一个驱动实例枚举出了多个设备 ID 与唯一 ID 完全相同的 P: Duplicate PDO: the same driver instance enumerated multiple PDOs with identical device IDs and unique IDs. Parameter 2 is the newly reported PDO, parameter 3 is the existing PDO that was duplicated. This usually indicates a defect in the bus driver enumeration logic.
source_translations.写 IRP 的不变量 MDL 缓冲区内容在传输期间被修改（I/O 验证）。参数: The contents of the invariant MDL buffer of a write IRP were modified during the transfer (I/O verification). Parameter 2 is the device object, parameter 3 is the IRP, parameter 4 is the system space mapping address of the MDL.
source_translations.扩展处理器状态（XSAVE 区域）非法。: The extended processor state (XSAVE area) is invalid.
source_translations.驱动在中断被禁用的状态下调用了 IoCallDriver。参数 2 为 IRP: A driver called IoCallDriver with interrupts disabled. Parameter 2 is the address of the IRP.
source_translations.驱动的 Fast I/O 分发例程返回时中断仍处于禁用状态。参数 2 为该例程地: A driver Fast I/O dispatch routine returned with interrupts still disabled. Parameter 2 is the address of that routine.
source_translations.代码完整性问题：映像的导入地址表位于可执行节中。参数 2 为映像文件名，参数 3: Code integrity issue: the import address table of the image resides in an executable section. Parameter 2 is the image file name, parameter 3 is the IAT directory, parameter 4 is the section name.
source_translations.控制流防护（CFG）判定间接调用目标不是合法函数入口：要么函数指针或虚表被改写，: Control Flow Guard (CFG) determined that the indirect call target is not a valid function entry point: either a function pointer or vtable was overwritten, or hooking and injection software altered the call target.
source_translations.由错误的线程释放资源（死锁检测选项）。参数 2 为资源地址，参数 3 为获取该资: A resource was released by the wrong thread (deadlock detection option). Parameter 2 is the address of the resource, parameter 3 is the thread that acquired the resource, parameter 4 is the current thread.
source_translations.调用栈由栈内存扫描重建（无符号），崩溃线程 %1 帧、全部线程共 %2 帧；: The call stack was rebuilt by scanning stack memory (no symbols): %1 frames on the faulting thread, %2 frames across all threads;
source_translations.MINIDUMP_PROCESS_VM_COUNTERS_2 前 112 字节必: The first 112 bytes of MINIDUMP_PROCESS_VM_COUNTERS_2 must match the official layout
source_translations.Revision 2 的 PrivateUsage 必须位于 0x58，比 Re: PrivateUsage in revision 2 must sit at 0x58, 16 bytes later than in revision 1
source_translations.顺序为近似值且可能含残留帧，归因只采用崩溃线程的帧。: the order is approximate and stale frames may appear; blame attribution uses only the faulting thread's frames.
source_translations.落在 NULL 页范围（作计数/标志更常见；若确为地址则是空指针加偏移）: Falls in the NULL page range (usually a count or flag; if it really is an address, it is a null pointer plus an offset)
source_translations.未记录（该字段仍是 PAGE 填充，转储写入器没有填写）: Not recorded (the field still holds the PAGE fill; the dump writer never wrote it)
source_translations.捕获时的指令指针（多为 KeBugCheckEx 内部，非故障点）: Instruction pointer at capture time (usually inside KeBugCheckEx, not the fault site)
source_translations.故障指令地址（停止码参数给出）: Faulting instruction address (from the bug check parameters)
source_translations.64 位内存列表的数据区偏移累加越界，: The data-region offset accumulation for the 64-bit memory list went out of bounds;
source_translations.TRIAGE 肇事驱动字段（未能归属到模块，仅供参考）: TRIAGE broken-driver field (could not be attributed to a module; for reference only)
source_translations.下面的线程、模块与内存信息仍然有效，但没有崩溃点可供归因。: the thread, module and memory information below is still valid, but there is no crash point to attribute.
source_translations.也可能只是栈上尚未被覆盖的残留值——需要结合是否反复出现来判断。: or these may simply be stale values not yet overwritten — judge by whether they recur.
source_translations.位图物理内存布局（活动内存转储）: Bitmap physical memory layout (active memory dump)
source_translations.先看“肇事模块候选”：第一名是第三方驱动时，优先更新、回滚或临时卸载它；: Start with the blame candidates: when the top entry is a third-party driver, update, roll back or temporarily unload it first;
source_translations.其余内存段已跳过。: the remaining memory ranges were skipped.
source_translations.崩溃点落在已卸载的模块 %1 内：驱动卸载后仍有代码在执行，: The crash point lies inside unloaded module %1: code was still executing after the driver was unloaded,
source_translations.崩溃线程栈所在页不在转储中（栈指针 %1），无法重建调用栈。: The pages holding the faulting thread stack are not present in the dump (stack pointer %1), so the call stack cannot be rebuilt.
source_translations.无法把内核虚拟地址翻译到物理页，驱动列表与调用栈不可用。: kernel virtual addresses cannot be translated to physical pages, so the driver list and call stack are unavailable.
source_translations.无法枚举驱动与重建调用栈。: drivers cannot be enumerated and the call stack cannot be rebuilt.
source_translations.未建立物理内存映射: No physical memory mapping was built
source_translations.未能建立物理内存映射（文件可能被截断或采用未知布局），: Could not build a physical memory mapping (the file may be truncated or use an unknown layout);
source_translations.本转储不含异常记录：多半是主动生成的快照（任务管理器/ProcDump），而不是: This dump contains no exception record: it is most likely a snapshot taken on purpose (Task Manager/ProcDump) rather than a crash site;
source_translations.栈上出现了已卸载模块 %1 的地址。这可能说明它卸载后仍被回调，: Addresses belonging to unloaded module %1 appear on the stack. It may still be receiving callbacks after unload,
source_translations.沿 PsLoadedModuleList 未取得任何通过校验的驱动条目: No driver entry along PsLoadedModuleList passed validation
source_translations.流数量 %1 超过解析上限，仅展示前 %2 条。: The stream count %1 exceeds the parsing limit; only the first %2 are shown.
source_translations.第一名是系统模块或候选为空时，说明证据还不足以定位到某个驱动，别急着动它。: when the top entry is a system module or the list is empty, the evidence is not yet enough to point at a specific driver, so do not act on it hastily.
source_translations.经典物理内存布局（按内存段顺序排列）: Classic physical memory layout (runs stored in order)
source_translations.解析过程中发生异常，文件可能已损坏或结构异常：%1: An exception occurred while parsing; the file may be corrupt or structurally invalid: %1
source_translations.解析过程中发生未知异常，文件可能已损坏或结构异常。: An unknown exception occurred while parsing; the file may be corrupt or structurally invalid.
source_translations.调用栈不可重建。: the call stack cannot be rebuilt.
source_translations.转储头中的 CONTEXT 未提供栈指针，无法定位崩溃线程栈，: The CONTEXT in the dump header provides no stack pointer, so the faulting thread stack cannot be located;
source_translations.转储头未提供可用的页目录基址（DirectoryTableBase），: The dump header does not provide a usable page directory base (DirectoryTableBase);
source_translations.达到条目上限 %1，剩余部分未展开: Reached the %1-entry limit; the remainder was not expanded
source_translations.这几个停止码本身只说明“异常没人处理”，参数 1 的 NTSTATUS 才是真正: These stop codes only mean “nobody handled the exception”; the NTSTATUS in parameter 1 is the real cause, so read that first.
source_translations.这是典型的“卸载时未取消挂起操作”缺陷。: which is the classic “pending operations not cancelled on unload” defect.
source_translations.连续 %1 项结构校验失败，已停止遍历: %1 consecutive entries failed structure validation; traversal stopped
source_translations.链表在第 %1 项处进入未落盘内存: The list reached memory that is not present in the dump at entry %1
source_translations.链表头所在内存页不在转储中: The page holding the list head is not present in the dump
source_translations.链表结构与预期布局不符: the list structure does not match the expected layout
source_translations.页表不可用或链表头地址为空: Page table unavailable, or the list head address is null
source_translations.驱动链表出现环，已在重复节点处停止: The driver list contains a cycle; stopped at the repeated node
source_translations.驱动链表头 %1 所在内存页不在转储中，无法枚举驱动。: The page holding driver list head %1 is not present in the dump, so drivers cannot be enumerated.
source_translations.驱动链表遍历未走完：已取得 %1 项，丢弃 %2 项。%3: Driver list traversal did not complete: %1 entries obtained, %2 discarded. %3
source_translations.\n\n（窗口内共有 %1 个转储，这里列出的是最新的一个。）: (%1 dumps fall inside the window; the newest one is shown here.)
source_translations.1. 崩溃前你在 KSword 里做了什么：打开了哪个页面、点了哪个功能、: 1. What you were doing in KSword before the crash: which page was open, which feature you invoked,
source_translations.2. 是否可以稳定复现，以及复现的具体步骤；: 2. Whether it reproduces reliably, and the exact steps to reproduce;
source_translations.3. 当时 R0 驱动是否已启用，是否刚做过加载/卸载操作；: 3. Whether the R0 driver was enabled at the time, and whether a load/unload had just been performed;
source_translations.4. 系统版本与 KSword 版本；: 4. The Windows version and the KSword version;
source_translations.5. 附上本页的“导出报告”结果，必要时附转储文件本身。: 5. Attach the “Export report” output from this page, and the dump file itself if needed.
source_translations.MinidumpDock 解析结果指向 KSword 自身组件:: MinidumpDock result points at KSword's own component:
source_translations.[MainWindow] 保存转储检查状态失败:: [MainWindow] failed to save dump check state:
source_translations.[MainWindow] 转储分析页未能初始化，无法自动解析:: [MainWindow] dump analysis page failed to initialize; cannot auto-analyze:
source_translations.不再检查新的崩溃转储（可在设置-功能中重新开启）: Stop checking for new crash dumps (re-enable under Settings → Features)
source_translations.但仍建议上报由开发者复核。: but reporting it for developer review is still recommended.
source_translations.关闭后不再自动检查，仍可随时在“转储分析”页手动打开转储文件: When off, no automatic check runs; you can still open dumps manually from the Dump Analysis page
source_translations.反馈渠道：QQ 群，或 GitHub Issues。: Reporting channels: the QQ group, or GitHub Issues.
source_translations.启动后检查系统近 24 小时内是否产生过新的崩溃转储，有则询问是否立即解析。: On startup, check whether the system produced a new crash dump in the last 24 hours and offer to analyze it.
source_translations.启动时检查新的崩溃转储: Check for new crash dumps on startup
source_translations.崩溃现场命中了已卸载的 KSword 驱动，通常意味着卸载时有回调或挂起操作未取: The crash site matched an unloaded KSword driver, which usually means a callback or pending operation was not cancelled on unload.
source_translations.归因结果把 KSword 组件列为肇事模块候选，这是最强的关联信号。: Attribution lists a KSword component among the blame candidates, which is the strongest signal of involvement.
source_translations.检查只读取文件名与时间，不会打开转储内容；同一个转储只会询问一次。: The check only reads file names and timestamps, never dump contents; each dump is asked about only once.
source_translations.检测到系统在最近 24 小时内产生了新的崩溃转储：\n\n: A new crash dump was produced on this system within the last 24 hours:
source_translations.疑似调用栈上出现了 KSword 组件的地址。栈扫描存在误报，: Addresses of a KSword component appear on the suspected call stack. Stack scanning produces false positives,
source_translations.目标进程/驱动/文件是什么；: and what the target process/driver/file was;
source_translations.这属于 KSword 自身的问题，请反馈给开发者。提交时请一并说明：: This is a defect in KSword itself; please report it. Include the following:
source_translations.[MainWindow][ADS] 已把游离的功能页收回主标签区（旧布局配置中不: [MainWindow][ADS] reattached detached feature docks to the main tab area (the saved layout predates them):
source_translations.（完整候选与证据见“肇事模块”页）: (see the Blame page for the full candidate list and evidence)
source_translations.[FileDock] 纯MFT解析扩大扫描后定位到目录, path=: [FileDock] MFT-only parsing located the directory after widening the scan, path=
source_translations.更多候选与逐条证据见“肇事模块”页。: See the Blame page for the remaining candidates and per-item evidence.
source_translations.CPUID 报告 hypervisor 存在: CPUID reports a hypervisor is present
source_translations.HVCI 未启用：内核代码页不受 VTL1 强制保护: HVCI is off: kernel code pages are not enforced by VTL1
source_translations.HVCI 正在强制执行：策略位与运行时证据一致: HVCI is enforcing: policy bits and runtime evidence agree
source_translations.HVCI 运行中，但处于审计模式：违规只被记录，不会被阻断: HVCI is running in audit mode: violations are logged, not blocked
source_translations.VBS 在运行，但 KMCI 策略位未启用：内核代码完整性未受 VTL1 强制: VBS is running but the KMCI policy bit is off: kernel code integrity is not enforced by VTL1
source_translations.⚠ 判定口径：策略位（SystemCodeIntegrityInformatio: ⚠ How this page decides: the policy bit (HVCI_KMCI_ENABLED in SystemCodeIntegrityInformation) only states the configured intent; it does not mean HVCI is enforcing. Actual enforcement also requires a hypervisor to be present and securekernel.exe / skci.dll to be loaded. When the two sides disagree this page says so explicitly, and never reports enabled just because the policy bit is 1.
source_translations.允许加载测试签名驱动: Test-signed drivers are allowed to load
source_translations.刷新后显示 CodeIntegrity 选项掩码、Hyper-V 模块状态与原始: After refresh, shows the CodeIntegrity option mask, Hyper-V module states and raw NTSTATUS
source_translations.区分 HVCI 策略位与运行时证据，识别「策略说开着但实际没跑」，并列出审计模式: Separates the HVCI policy bit from runtime evidence, catches the case where policy claims enabled but nothing is running, and lists downgrades such as audit mode, test signing and CI debug mode
source_translations.只记录不阻断，等同未强制: Logged but not blocked, equivalent to not enforced
source_translations.未启用（VBS 的信任根被削弱）: Disabled (the VBS root of trust is weakened)
source_translations.状态：当前驱动不支持安全姿态审计协议: Status: the loaded driver does not support the security posture audit protocol
source_translations.由策略位与模块状态推导，不作为独立运行证据: Derived from policy bits and module states; not independent runtime evidence
source_translations.策略声称已启用，但缺少运行证据（hypervisor 或 securekerne: Policy claims enabled but runtime evidence is missing (hypervisor or securekernel/skci not observed) - treated as not enabled
source_translations.证据不足：模块快照查询失败（%1），无法判定 HVCI 是否真正运行: Insufficient evidence: module snapshot query failed (%1); cannot determine whether HVCI is actually running
source_translations.非零售构建，签名策略可能不同: Non-retail build; signing policy may differ
source_translations.%1 个模块含本工具未解析的动态重定位符号，其「无法解释」计数偏保守: %1 module(s) contain dynamic relocation symbols this tool does not parse, so their unexplained counts are conservative
source_translations.%1 个模块的磁盘映像未通过信任校验，比对基准本身可疑: The disk image of %1 module(s) failed trust verification, so the comparison baseline itself is suspect
source_translations.仅存在动态重定位位点差异，未见异常改写。: Only dynamic relocation site differences; no abnormal patching found.
source_translations.发现 %1 处无法解释的代码改写；当前未确认 HVCI 处于强制执行状态: Found %1 unexplained code modification(s); HVCI was not confirmed to be enforcing
source_translations.发现无法用动态重定位解释的代码改写。: Found code modifications that dynamic relocation cannot explain.
source_translations.可执行节与重定位后的磁盘净映像一致。: Executable sections match the relocated clean disk image.
source_translations.把每个已加载模块的可执行节与重定位后的磁盘净映像全量逐字节比对，区分动态重定位位: Compares every loaded module's executable sections byte by byte against the relocated clean disk image, separating dynamic relocation sites from unexplained code modifications
source_translations.按模块名过滤，留空扫描全部已加载模块: Filter by module name; leave empty to scan every loaded module

source_translations.R3 采样 Core Audio 会话峰值、状态、音量与端点；R0 多源交叉核验: R3 samples Core Audio session peak, state, volume and endpoint; R0 cross-checks the session PID from multiple sources to corroborate process identity only, and never reads or modifies the audio stream.
source_translations.VMX/EPT 操作可能因异常 VM-exit、错误 MTRR 类型、EPT m: VMX/EPT operations can destabilize or bugcheck the system through unexpected VM-exits, wrong MTRR types, EPT misconfiguration, or conflicts with another VMM.
source_translations.仅为实验性 partial 指令分派：vmcs12/vmcs02、L2 退出反射: Experimental partial instruction dispatch only: vmcs12/vmcs02, L2 exit reflection and shadow EPT are incomplete, so running an L2 guest is neither claimed nor permitted.
source_translations.仅做 TLFS 能力、根/来宾分区与 VP-assist 所有权检查；不接管 V: Checks only TLFS capabilities, root/guest partition and VP-assist ownership; it does not take over the VP-assist page or clean fields, so it is never marked active.
source_translations.仅函数槽可改写；R0 会复核表身份、旧值与目标可执行节，: Only function slots are writable; R0 re-verifies table identity, the old value and the target executable section,
source_translations.从释放文件锁到原子替换之间仍有极短竞态，其它进程的并发写入可能破坏快照校验。: A very short race remains between releasing the file lock and the atomic replace; a concurrent write from another process can invalidate the snapshot checksum.
source_translations.但无法证明函数签名兼容，错误地址会立即造成冻结或蓝屏。: but it cannot prove signature compatibility, and a wrong address freezes or bugchecks the machine immediately.
source_translations.只支持等长替换：字节数必须与原始内容完全一致，不能插入或删除。: Same-length replacement only: the byte count must match the original exactly; insertion and deletion are not supported.
source_translations.只读取证：比较来宾可见的内核虚拟视图与物理别名，并解析 CPUID、DMAR/I: Read-only forensics: compares the guest-visible kernel virtual view against its physical alias and parses CPUID, DMAR/IVRS and public IOMMU interfaces.
source_translations.只读寄存器、不写入，但错误的固件地址仍可能被平台拒绝或触发硬件异常。: Registers are read, never written, but a wrong firmware address can still be rejected by the platform or raise a hardware fault.
source_translations.备份是同目录下带时间戳的独立副本，不会覆盖之前的备份。: The backup is a timestamped copy in the same directory and never overwrites an earlier backup.
source_translations.外层 Hypervisor 可用 EPT/NPT 对执行和读取提供不同视图，因此: An outer hypervisor can present different EPT/NPT views for execute and read, so a result of no anomaly found does not prove the absence of a hook.
source_translations.展示选中句柄的对象头、对象类型归属、解码状态和风险标记。: Shows the object header, object type ownership, decode state and risk flags of the selected handle.
source_translations.异步读取 PEB.KernelCallbackTable，并核对回调地址所属模块: Reads PEB.KernelCallbackTable asynchronously and checks which module each callback address belongs to together with its memory protection.
source_translations.模板只影响展示和结果码语义；v1 只伪造标量返回值，不写 out 参数。Fake: The template only affects presentation and result-code semantics; v1 fakes scalar return values only and never writes out parameters. The fake path reports the event first, then skips the original API and returns the specified RAX.
source_translations.策略位与运行证据不一致时一律按未启用处理，不会因为策略位为 1 就判定为已启用。: When the policy bit and the runtime evidence disagree, the result is always reported as not enabled; a policy bit of 1 alone never counts as enabled.
source_translations.策略位只说明「配置想开」，HVCI 真正生效还需要 hypervisor 在位且: The policy bit only says the configuration asks for it; HVCI is actually in force only when a hypervisor is present and securekernel.exe / skci.dll are loaded.
source_translations.精确匹配导出名，区分 A/W 后缀。: Exact match on the export name, distinguishing the A/W suffix.
source_translations.精确匹配模块名，需要带扩展名。: Exact match on the module name, extension included.
source_translations.读取来源为 NativePEB 或 Wow64PEB 中的用户态内核回调表。: The source is the user-mode kernel callback table in NativePEB or Wow64PEB.
source_translations.非模块可执行地址、不可执行地址和读取失败项会标为异常。: Addresses outside any module image, non-executable addresses and read failures are flagged as abnormal.
source_translations.删除表格选中项对应的注册表子树或值。本分类不会自动备份；更改后通常需要重启 Ex: Deletes the registry subtree or value behind the selected rows. This category is not backed up automatically; changes usually need Explorer or the owning program to restart before they fully take effect.
source_translations.删除表格选中项对应的注册表子树或值。本分类删除前会自动备份，可用「恢复上次删除」: Deletes the registry subtree or value behind the selected rows. This category is backed up automatically before deletion and can be rolled back with Restore last deletion; changes usually need Explorer or the owning program to restart before they fully take effect.
source_translations.启动本地 HTTPS 解析代理。只记录经过本地系统代理的 HTTP/1.1 流量: Starts the local HTTPS inspection proxy. Only HTTP/1.1 traffic that goes through the local system proxy is recorded; QUIC/HTTP/3, direct connections and applications that pin certificates never appear in this table.
source_translations.启动调试输出捕获。经 KswordARK R0 回调捕获 DbgPrint/Db: Starts debug output capture. DbgPrint/DbgPrintEx/KdPrintEx are captured through the KswordARK R0 callback, and only messages passing the current kernel debug filter are shown.
source_translations.开始监控已选择的目标进程。固定启用宽覆盖 ETW Provider，结合进程快照: Starts monitoring the selected target process. A broad ETW provider set is always enabled and combined with process snapshots to maintain the target process tree, keeping only events related to the target.
source_translations.所有测量都在 UI 线程执行，每项测试运行时界面会短暂无响应，属于预期行为。结论: Every measurement runs on the UI thread, so the interface briefly stops responding during each test, which is expected. Results vary with the Windows version and the current appearance settings; this page only reports measured values.
source_translations.把上面填写的 PL1（长时）/PL2（短时）功耗上限写入 CPU，单位瓦。MSR: Writes the PL1 (sustained) / PL2 (short-term) power limits entered above to the CPU, in watts. Once the MSR lock bit is set this page never tries to clear it; firmware, Windows power management or another tuning tool may rewrite these values at any time. AMD SMU/PBO fields are not written.
source_translations.按所选目标替换 IRP_MJ_DEVICE_CONTROL 派遣函数；高风险，可: Replaces the IRP_MJ_DEVICE_CONTROL dispatch routine for the selected target; high risk, may bugcheck. It only changes query results for the selected device and never writes physical memory, firmware or disk directly; the network option currently affects NSI/ARP query results only.
source_translations.枚举常见对象目录中的 SymbolicLink。本页只解析目标，不递归展开；目标: Enumerates SymbolicLink objects in the common object directories. This page only resolves the target and never expands it recursively; when the target points at a Directory, use the Directory recursion page.
source_translations.名称内嵌 NUL 字符：注册表编辑器与 Win32 API 只能看到截断后的名称: The name embeds a NUL character: Registry Editor and the Win32 API only see the truncated name, so lookup and deletion by name both fail
source_translations.名称包含控制字符：常规工具显示与匹配都会失真: The name contains control characters: ordinary tools distort both display and matching
source_translations.内核枚举可见但 Win32 枚举不返回该名称: Visible to kernel enumeration but not returned by Win32 enumeration
source_translations.（无法打开该隐藏子键）: (the hidden subkey could not be opened)
source_translations.该值只能通过内核接口看到，常规注册表 API 无法按名定位；KSword 只报告: This value is only visible through the kernel interface and the ordinary registry API cannot address it by name; KSword reports it without changing it,
source_translations.请用注册表页的原生视图或离线工具处理。: handle it from the registry page native view or with an offline tool.
source_translations.该子键只能通过内核接口枚举，注册表编辑器通常会在打开父键时报错或直接跳过；: This subkey can only be enumerated through the kernel interface; Registry Editor usually fails on the parent key or skips it silently;
source_translations.KSword 只报告不删除。: KSword reports it without deleting it.
source_translations.未能解析 NtEnumerateKey/NtEnumerateValueKey/: NtEnumerateKey/NtEnumerateValueKey/NtOpenKey could not be resolved, so items hidden behind embedded NUL names cannot be detected.
source_translations.这是扫描能力缺失的诊断记录，不是启动项本身。: This is a diagnostic record about a missing scan capability, not a startup item itself.

source_translations.这是扫描覆盖度的诊断记录，不是启动项本身。: This is a diagnostic record about scan coverage, not a startup item itself.
source_translations.；当前进程无法读取该持久化键，内容对本次扫描完全不可见。: ; the current process cannot read this persistence key, so its contents are entirely invisible to this scan.
source_translations.以管理员身份重新扫描；若仍被拒绝，说明该键的 DACL 被显式改写，属于典型的隐: Rescan as administrator; if it is still denied, the key DACL was rewritten on purpose, which is a classic hiding technique.
source_translations.Windows 默认不会在这些持久化键上放置拒绝 ACE；请确认该 ACE 的来: Windows does not place deny ACEs on these persistence keys by default; confirm where this ACE came from.
source_translations.EnumServicesStatusEx 失败，无法与注册表服务定义做交叉比对。: EnumServicesStatusEx failed, so the registry service definitions cannot be cross-checked.
source_translations.注册表存在服务定义（Type=: The registry holds a service definition (Type=
source_translations.），但服务控制管理器的枚举结果里没有它。: ), but the Service Control Manager enumeration does not contain it.
source_translations.SCM 未列出该服务，服务页也就看不到它；可能是被卸载残留的键，也可能是刻意脱管: The SCM does not list this service, so the services page cannot show it either; it may be an uninstall leftover or a deliberately unmanaged load point.
source_translations.确认用途前不要直接删除，驱动类型的键删除后可能导致无法启动。: Do not delete it before confirming its purpose; removing a driver-type key can leave the system unbootable.
source_translations.无法读取 TaskCache\\Tree，幽灵计划任务检测被跳过；请以管理员身份: TaskCache\Tree could not be read, so ghost scheduled task detection was skipped; rescan as administrator.
source_translations.TaskCache\\Tree 叶子缺少 SD 安全描述符（任务计划程序界面与: The TaskCache\Tree leaf has no SD security descriptor (both the Task Scheduler UI and Get-ScheduledTask skip such a task, yet the service still runs it)
source_translations.任务计划程序 API 枚举不返回该路径: The Task Scheduler API enumeration does not return this path
source_translations.TaskCache\\Tasks 下缺少 Actions/Path 定义: Actions/Path definitions are missing under TaskCache\Tasks
source_translations.这类任务对任务计划程序界面不可见，KSword 的计划任务页同样看不到它，因此这: Such a task is invisible to the Task Scheduler UI and to the KSword scheduled task page, so it is only reported here and never acted on;
source_translations.处置需要同时清理 TaskCache\\Tree、TaskCache\\Task: Remediation must clean TaskCache\Tree, TaskCache\Tasks and the XML under System32\Tasks together.
source_translations.TaskCache\\Tasks 下存在该任务定义，但 TaskCache\\T: The task definition exists under TaskCache\Tasks, but no leaf in TaskCache\Tree points at it.
source_translations.没有 Tree 叶子的任务定义不会出现在任何任务列表里；可能是卸载残留，也可能是: A definition without a Tree leaf never shows up in any task list; it may be an uninstall leftover or a deliberately unlinked persistence item.
source_translations.启动文件夹被重定向后，常规的启动文件夹枚举不会看到真正生效的目录；: Once the Startup folder is redirected, ordinary Startup folder enumeration never sees the directory that actually takes effect;
source_translations.恢复默认值前请确认这不是企业策略下发的配置。: confirm this is not a configuration pushed by enterprise policy before restoring the default.
source_translations.位于被重定向的启动目录中，登录时会被执行，但不在系统默认启动文件夹内。: It sits in the redirected Startup directory: it runs at logon yet lives outside the default Startup folder.
source_translations.该文件所在目录来自注册表重定向；处理前先确认重定向本身是否合法。: This file directory comes from a registry redirection; confirm the redirection itself is legitimate before acting.
source_translations.用户级 TreatAs 把该 CLSID 整体重定向到了另一个组件: A per-user TreatAs redirects this CLSID wholesale to another component
source_translations.覆盖了机器级注册；机器级目标=: overrides the machine-wide registration; machine-wide target=
source_translations.进程内 COM 激活优先使用 HKCU 注册，因此该项会在机器级组件之前被加载；: In-process COM activation prefers the HKCU registration, so this entry loads before the machine-wide component;
source_translations.确认它不是软件的正常按用户安装后再处理。: confirm it is not a normal per-user software installation before acting.

source_translations.脚本与加载项文件没有可逆的后端操作；请在确认内容后手工处理，删除组策略脚本还可能: Script and add-in files have no reversible backend operation; review the content and handle them manually. Deleting a Group Policy script may also be restored by the next policy refresh.
source_translations.组策略脚本由策略引擎下发；本地修改会在下一次策略刷新时被还原，应从策略源头处理。: Group Policy scripts are pushed by the policy engine; a local change is reverted on the next policy refresh, so handle it at the policy source.

source_translations.其它非 0x 文本按进程名/PID 从下拉列表筛选目标进程。用户态模块取自当前附: Other non-0x text filters the target list by process name/PID. User-mode modules come from the attached process,

source_translations.内核模块 %1 命中 %2 项，请改用完整路径消歧。: Kernel module %1 matched %2 entries; use the full path to disambiguate.
source_translations.内核模块列表正在刷新，请稍候重试。: The kernel module list is being refreshed; try again shortly.
source_translations.内核模块取自“刷新内核模块”得到的列表。中心地址为 0xFFFF... 高半区时: kernel modules come from the list returned by “Refresh kernel modules”. A center address in the 0xFFFF... high half is read as a kernel virtual address.
source_translations.内核路径带事务与失败回滚，用户态与物理内存路径没有回滚。: The kernel path is transactional and rolls back on failure; user-mode and physical-memory paths do not roll back.
source_translations.勾选后在字符串末尾补一个结尾 0，符合 C 字符串约定。: Append a terminating zero to the string to follow the C-string convention.
source_translations.取消所有列隐藏，恢复完整证据视图: Unhide every column and restore the complete evidence view
source_translations.只保留风险判定不为正常的页记录: Keep only page records whose risk verdict is not Normal
source_translations.只列出命中风险规则的页，风险为正常的页不进表: List only pages that match a risk rule; normal pages are omitted
source_translations.只显示风险标志非零的可执行页，取消勾选可查看全部扫描结果: Show only executable pages with nonzero risk flags; clear to view every scan result
source_translations.只显示驱动判定 riskFlags 非零的证据行: Show only evidence rows whose driver-reported riskFlags are nonzero

source_translations.可输入 0、0x... 数值基址，或“模块名+十六进制偏移”（例如 client: Enter 0, a 0x... numeric base, or “module name + hexadecimal offset” (for example client.dll+C125D9 or CI.dll+1A2B);
source_translations.在已加载内核模块中找不到 %1。可先点击“刷新内核模块”，或改用完整路径。: %1 was not found among loaded kernel modules. Click “Refresh kernel modules” first or use a full path.
source_translations.字符串写入的起始地址，必须落在当前快照范围内。: The starting address for the string write must fall within the current snapshot.
source_translations.字符串只填入本地编辑缓存，确认无误后再点“应用差异到真实内存”。: The string is placed only in the local edit buffer. Verify it, then click “Apply changes to real memory”.
source_translations.字符串长度超出当前快照范围，请扩大读取范围或换一个起始地址。: The string extends beyond the current snapshot. Increase the read range or choose another starting address.
source_translations.尚未加载内核模块列表，请先点击“刷新内核模块”。: The kernel module list has not been loaded; click “Refresh kernel modules” first.
source_translations.尚未读取内存，先在上方设置目标并点击“R0 读取”。: No memory has been read. Set a target above and click “R0 Read”.
source_translations.已切换到内核虚拟内存通道：可用“模块名+偏移”定位内核模块。: Switched to the kernel virtual-memory channel; use “module name + offset” to locate a kernel module.
source_translations.已切换到物理内存通道：读上限 64 KB，写上限每块 4 KB 且没有回滚。: Switched to the physical-memory channel: reads are limited to 64 KB, writes to 4 KB per block, with no rollback.

source_translations.当前没有已读取的内存快照，请先点击“R0 读取”。: There is no memory snapshot yet; click “R0 Read” first.
source_translations.当前过滤条件隐藏了全部 %1 条内核内存证据；请清空过滤或关闭“仅显示风险项”。: The current filter hides all %1 kernel-memory evidence rows; clear it or turn off “Show risks only”.
source_translations.当前过滤条件隐藏了全部 %1 条进程内存证据；请清空文本过滤或取消勾选仅显示风险: The current filter hides all %1 process-memory evidence rows; clear the text filter or turn off risks-only/image-only filtering.
source_translations.当前附加进程 PID=%1 与已加载内核模块中都未找到模块：%2。请刷新模块列表: Module %2 was found neither in attached process PID=%1 nor among loaded kernel modules. Refresh the module list and verify the name.

source_translations.含义: 每让根容器重绘一次，就要付出“整树重绘”这个耗时。若它超过帧预算 %: Meaning: every root-container repaint costs the full-tree figure above. If it exceeds the %1 ms frame budget, any logic that repaints the root container per frame causes visible dropped frames.

Safety boundary: addresses come from the public WDK DEVICE_OBJECT.Timer field. On start/stop, R0 references the DriverObject again by name and validates the DeviceObject through a referenced device snapshot, then compares the PIO_TIMER; it only calls IoStartTimer/IoStopTimer and does not dereference or write private IO_TIMER data.

source_translations.写入组策略 DisableWindowsLocationProvider=1，关: Writes the policy DisableWindowsLocationProvider=1 to turn off the built-in Windows network positioning. Once disabled, apps that rely on real positioning (Maps, Weather, Find My Device) lose precise location; clear the checkbox to restore it.
source_translations.准备操作会为每个活动 CPU 分配物理连续的 VMXON/VMCS 页面，并按: Preparation allocates physically contiguous VMXON and VMCS pages for every active CPU, and builds a contiguous EPT identity map beginning at physical address 0 according to CPUID.80000008 MAXPHYADDR, up to 8 TiB, to cover high-address PCI/ReBAR MMIO. Full RAM leaves are typed from MTRRs; firmware, PCI, and other physical holes use UC; when MAXPHYADDR exceeds 8 TiB, truncation is explicit and resident start is disabled. This step does not execute VMLAUNCH, but it does consume nonpaged memory; unloading the driver or choosing Release Backend reclaims these resources.
source_translations.切换目录读取方式：Windows API、R3 原始卷手动解析、R0 驱动目录解:

Parse as MFT (NTFS only: read $MFT directly at volume offsets, all WinAPI/FSCTL fallbacks disabled),
R0 IRP parsing (a hand-built kernel IRP sends the directory query straight to the base file system device, bypassing the filter layers;
the open still goes through the normal path, so interception done only on CREATE cannot be detected).
The latter two are compared against the regular view; entries visible only via bypass paths are flagged as suspected hidden items.

source_translations.该子键只能通过内核接口枚举，注册表编辑器通常会在打开父键时报错或直接跳过；KSw: This subkey can only be enumerated through the kernel interface; Registry Editor usually fails on the parent key or skips it silently; KSword reports it without deleting it.
source_translations.该操作不可撤销。KSword 将先校验 PID 创建时间和文件 ID，锁定当前映: This operation cannot be undone. KSword first validates the PID creation time and file ID, locks the current image file object, then permanently deletes it after terminating and confirming the original process has exited. A system or critical target may crash immediately, lose data, or leave Windows unbootable. KSword reports the risk without restricting the operation by process category; No file is deleted if identity, path, or exit state cannot be confirmed.
source_translations.该检查依据 Hyper-V TLFS 的 CPUID 叶 0x4000000A: This check uses Hyper-V TLFS CPUID leaf 0x4000000A and the VP-assist MSR to identify eVMCS v1 support, root/guest partition state, and ownership conflicts. It does not replace the VP-assist page, maintain clean fields, or activate eVMCS; the result can only be unsupported, capability-only, or partial.
source_translations.该检查只启用并报告实验性 Nested VMX partial 分派。VMXON: This check enables and reports only the experimental partial Nested VMX dispatcher. VMXON, VMPTRLD, VMREAD/VMWRITE, and other instructions that require operand decoding currently return VMfailInvalid. VMLAUNCH and VMRESUME never run L2. Continuing accepts capability discovery and failure-semantics validation; it does not indicate a usable nested VM.

source_translations.这是实际的高风险 VM-entry：驱动会在一个已自检 CPU 上进入 VMX: This performs a real, high-risk VM entry. The driver enters VMX root on one self-tested CPU, loads a complete VMCS, and executes VMLAUNCH. The one-shot guest executes only VMCALL. The VM-exit entry records the reason, qualification, RIP/RSP, and VM-instruction error, then performs VMCLEAR and VMXOFF and restores CR4. Any VMCS, EPT, firmware, Hyper-V/VBS, nested-virtualization, or processor implementation fault can destabilize or bugcheck the system and may require a restart. Save all work first. When an outer hypervisor is present, an attempt is allowed only from the Nested VMX (partial) entry and only if VMX is actually exposed; this does not mean L2 execution is available.
source_translations.这是进程主动终止，不是被动崩溃：安全检查发现状态已被破坏，为避免继续执行造成更大: This is a deliberate process termination, not a passive crash: a security check found the state already corrupted, Terminated immediately to prevent further damage from continued execution.
source_translations.这是高风险硬件自检：驱动会将系统线程依次绑定到每个 CPU，短暂调整 CR4.V: This is a high-risk hardware self-test: the driver binds a system thread to each CPU in turn, briefly adjusts CR4.VMXE, executes VMXON followed immediately by VMXOFF, and restores the original CR4. An active Hyper-V, VBS, or other VMM, firmware restrictions, or a defective VMX implementation may reject the operation or destabilize the system; in extreme cases it may cause a bug check. Save your work first and make sure you accept the risk of an unexpected restart.

Experimental boundary: operand decoding for Nested VMXON/VMCS operations, a complete vmcs02, L2 exit reflection, and shadow EPT are not implemented. The current partial dispatcher provides failure semantics only. eVMCS follows TLFS capability and ownership discovery but does not take ownership of the VP-assist page or maintain clean fields. Boundary: a one-shot guest still executes VMCALL followed by VMCLEAR/VMXOFF. The resident VMM is available only on GenuineIntel with complete VT-x/EPT/INVEPT, no existing hypervisor, successful all-CPU self-test, and active power/topology/unload guards. Every CPU performs VMXOFF synchronously before leaving S0, and DriverUnload is temporarily removed while resident. AMD and other non-Intel CPUs are rejected by the driver. Unknown exits, EPT misconfiguration, and unimplemented mandatory exits fail closed by devirtualizing. The EPT identity map covers [0, min(CPUID MAXPHYADDR, 8 TiB)); a larger MAXPHYADDR marks EPT truncated and blocks residency. Strict EPT rules are forensic tripwires, and the original access may retry successfully in native mode.
source_translations.常驻 VMM 会让所有已准备 CPU 进入 VMX non-root，并持续拦截: The resident VMM places every prepared CPU in VMX non-root and continuously handles supported exits. The driver permits start only on GenuineIntel with complete VT-x/EPT/INVEPT, no existing hypervisor, a successful all-CPU self-test, and active power/topology/unload guards; AMD and other non-Intel systems are rejected in the driver. The driver cannot unload while resident. S3/S4, Modern Standby, and other transitions out of S0 synchronously stop every VCPU first. VMX/EPT or rollback faults can still cause a bugcheck or require a restart.
source_translations.未接管 VP-assist 页面或 clean fields，因此二者均不得解释: It does not take ownership of the VP-assist page or clean fields, so neither feature may be interpreted as active. Resident capability-only means that the lifecycle guards are ready; it is reported active only after the all-CPU rendezvous succeeds.
source_translations.该操作会把指定物理页对应的 2 MiB EPT 大页拆成 4 KiB 叶并移除权: This operation splits the 2 MiB EPT large page containing the selected physical pages into 4 KiB leaves and removes permissions. It is a forensic tripwire, not reliable access control: a strict hit only logs the event and devirtualizes without injecting an exception; the CPU returns to native execution at the same RIP, so the original access may retry and succeed. Read permission cannot be removed while keeping write; when execute-only EPT is unsupported, execute is removed as well. Any overlapping strict rule overrides an allow-once window. Allow-once is limited to one VCPU and depends on MTF and single-context INVEPT; multicore residency supports strict tripwire rules only.
